jobs.title: Security Guard, Substitute
jobs.description:
Job Description

Wage - $20.77 an hour

Schedule – As needed

MTC is proud to operate the Joliet Job Corps Center in Joliet, IL where our staff provide quality services to our local youth. We value our professional and caring employees who are dedicated to improving people’s lives and we want YOU to join our team!

What you will be doing: Responsible for providing security coverage at campus access gate, performing patrol duties in assigned areas to ensure positive group relations and activities, to protect life and property, in compliance with government and management directives.

Essential Functions

  • Follow company security procedures on all persons and vehicles entering and exiting the campus
  • Advise students and provide guidance for positive attitude and behavior in on center activities
  • Patrol and monitor center grounds and the surrounding vicinities as required ensuring safety and proper behavior of students; resolving potential or occurring problems
  • Protect and secure buildings, center vehicles and property by checking doors, windows, lights, electrical appliances, equipment, locks and emergency equipment; maintain log of findings and corrective action taken; control security vehicle assignments and use
  • Assist in emergency evacuation, control and accountability of students and staff; respond to fire alarms; take necessary steps to report fires; reset fire alarm equipment
  • Issue visitor badges and parking permits; issue staff and student keys and badges; maintain related records
  • Distribute petty cash, maintain accountability logs and receipts, and audit each shift
  • Assist staff and law enforcement personnel in controlling disturbances; conduct investigation of crimes and unauthorized activities as assigned
  • Review student problems with counselors and student personnel officer
  • Assume supervisory responsibility of all safety and security activities when assigned
  • Perform administrative functions such as logs, incident reports and accident documentation; act as center dispatcher as assigned
  • When directed to do so, overtime is expected
  • Regular and predictable attendance is required
  • Participate in student employability programs and activities
  • Support and promote center zero tolerance policies
  • Provide positive, quality customer services to students, staff and other center customers
  • Promote the development of Career Success Standards by modeling appropriate behaviors, mentoring students where necessary and monitoring both positive and negative behaviors through interventions
  • Maintain accountability of students and property; adhere to safety practices
  • Assist, support and communicate with community life departments to ensure high level of service.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent and one year experience working with youth preferred
  • Security related experience is desired
  • Computer proficiency required
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record

Management & Training Corporation (MTC) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, disabled status, veteran status, genetic information, national origin, or any other category protected by federal law. MTC participates in E-Verify. We strive to provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans, in our job application and hiring process. If you are interested in employment opportunities with Management & Training Corporation and need assistance, please contact our staffing department through customersupport@mtctrains.com or 801-693-2888.

jobs.title: Security Patrol Officer - Variable Schedule
jobs.company: Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County
jobs.description:
More than a career...it's a calling!


Founded in 1888, Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a united Christian organization and ministry dedicated to providing love, hope, respect, and a new beginning for homeless women, men, and families. UGM-TC is funded entirely by the generosity of the community and offers a residency program for individuals looking to maximize their potential and transition out of homelessness. Through the programs and services provided, individuals develop essential life skills to become independent, productive members of our community. UGM-TC is God’s healthy place to end homelessness one person at a time. Come serve with us!  




UGM is seeking a flexible Security Patrol Officer able to work a variable schedule regarding hours and days worked based on the organization's changing needs.






Position Summary:


The selected individual will patrol and secure assigned premises as well as identify and mitigate risks to staff and patrons. We are looking for active, dependable individuals that are highly motivated. Former military or law enforcement experience preferred! This position requires individuals to stand/walk for extended periods of time. There will be routine checks and code compliance requirements for the 10-acre campus of Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County.  We also service The Vineyards of Lancaster, registering visitors, taking calls, and ensuring visitors have registered vehicles while conducting routine patrols. 


What You Do: 



  • Patrol buildings and grounds. 

  • Maintain campus security and follow lock protocols. 

  • Provides individual and group escorts to and from parking areas. 

  • Identifies and removes unauthorized individuals from property. 

  • Enforces campus parking policies/cites violations. 

  • Executes Courtesy Patrol policies, procedures, and standards with excellence. 

  • Provides campus directions to facility visitors. 

  • Interacts with police, fire personnel, EMS, patients, visitors, and staff. 

  • Completes incident / offense reports and composes narratives by performing investigations, recording observations, taking statements, gathering information, citing occurrences, and utilizing surveillance activities.  

  • Make eye contact and greet all people with respect. 

  • Responds to calls for service and emergency situations with urgency and professionalism. 

  • Assesses the situation and utilizes appropriate de-escalation measures. 

  • Utilizes critical thinking skills. 

  • Responds to and activates the appropriate emergency response codes.  

  • Supports activities and events by utilizing appropriate crowd control techniques representative of UGM.  

  • Work overnights, weekends, evening hours, and holidays as needed by the organization.  

  • The central job functions of this position are not limited to the duties listed above. 


 


Qualifications / What You Bring:  



  • 3-5 years of security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred. 

  • Familiarity with security equipment.

  • Ability to handle physical workload (walking/standing)

  • Bilingual:  Spanish Speaking a plus

  • Level 2 License preferred

  • Strong attention to detail 

  • An ability to connect with people from diverse backgrounds at varying levels of understanding.  

  • Problem Sensitivity — The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing that there is a problem. 

  • Deductive Reasoning — The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense. 

  • Flexibility of Closure — The ability to identify or detect a known pattern (a figure, object, word, or sound) that is hidden in other distracting material. 

  • Inductive Reasoning — The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events). 

  • A clean driving record.






“As part of the screening process, you may be asked to provide a pastoral reference. Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a Christian organization that seeks to hire people who align with our beliefs in Jesus Christ. We welcome all Christian denominations into the mission.”

jobs.title: Warehouse Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Warehouse Operations Supervisor

Location: Melrose Park, Illinois, United States , On-site

Employment Type: Full-time

Reports To: Warehouse Manager / Operations Manager


About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on and bilingual Warehouse Operations Supervisor to support and oversee daily warehouse operations. This role will be responsible for coordinating warehouse workflows, resolving operational issues, improving warehouse processes, and ensuring stable, accurate, and efficient execution across inbound, storage, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and returns.

This position serves as a key bridge between the warehouse operations team, internal technical teams, external vendors, and 3PL partners. The ideal candidate is highly responsible, operationally detail-oriented, bilingual in English and Mandarin, and comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse environment.


Responsibilities

Warehouse Operations & Team Management

  • Supervise daily warehouse operations, including receiving, put-away, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and returns.
  • Assign daily tasks, monitor workflow, and ensure operational productivity, accuracy, and timeliness.
  • Lead, coach, and support warehouse associates and team leads in daily execution.
  • Partner with HR and warehouse management to recruit, interview, onboard, and train local warehouse employees based on staffing needs.
  • Monitor team performance, provide timely feedback, and promote a disciplined, accountable, and positive warehouse work environment.

Issue Resolution & Cross-functional Coordination

  • Act as the on-site point of contact for daily operational issues, escalations, and process exceptions.
  • Coordinate with internal operations, IT/system teams, equipment vendors, carriers, and 3PL partners to resolve operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot and follow up on system errors, scanner/PDA issues, label printer problems, equipment malfunctions, and other warehouse exceptions.
  • Track issues through closure and help implement preventive actions to reduce repeat problems.

Inventory, Fulfillment & Accuracy Control

  • Oversee inbound receiving accuracy, documentation verification, system updates, and inventory put-away.
  • Support inventory control, cycle counts, bin location accuracy, and discrepancy investigation.
  • Monitor picking, packing, labeling, and shipping quality to ensure order accuracy and on-time fulfillment.
  • Ensure carrier-specific and platform-specific requirements are followed, including FBA and other shipping/labeling standards when applicable.

5S, Safety & Process Improvement

  • Support 5S management, warehouse layout optimization, and on-site improvement projects.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, efficient, and safe warehouse environment.
  • Enforce company safety policies, warehouse procedures, and OSHA-related safety standards.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and propose practical solutions to improve productivity, accuracy, and workflow efficiency.

Data, KPI & Reporting

  • Track daily and weekly operational KPIs, including productivity, order accuracy, inventory accuracy, receiving progress, shipping performance, and exception rates.
  • Prepare operational reports and communicate key issues, risks, and improvement actions to management.
  • Review 3PL/vendor performance data and billing details when applicable.


Requirements

Basic Requirements

  • Authorized to work legally in the United States
  • Fluent bilingual skills in English and Mandarin are required; must be able to speak, listen, read, and write in both languages
  • Spanish language skills are a strong plus
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Automation, or related fields are preferred

Experience & Skills

  • Minimum 2+ years of warehouse, logistics, fulfillment, or supply chain operations experience
  • At least 1 year of warehouse lead, supervisor, or team management experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of warehouse workflows, including inbound, storage, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and returns
  • Experience with WMS, scanners/PDA, label printers, warehouse systems, and basic troubleshooting preferred
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills; ability to work with operational data and reports
  • Experience in e-commerce fulfillment, footwear/apparel, 3PL, or high-volume warehouse operations preferred
  • Forklift certification or forklift operating experience is a plus

Personal Attributes

  • Strong leadership, communication, and coordination skills
  • Hands-on problem solver with a strong sense of ownership
  • Detail-oriented, reliable, and highly responsible
  • Able to work under pressure and respond quickly to operational changes
  • Strong learning ability and willingness to improve warehouse processes
  • Comfortable working on the warehouse floor and communicating with both frontline employees and management teams

Physical & Schedule Requirements

  • Must be able to work on-site in a warehouse environment
  • Must be able to stand, walk, bend, lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 lbs as needed
  • Flexibility to work overtime, weekends, or peak-season schedules based on business needs

Benefits

  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Career growth opportunities within warehouse operations and supply chain

Other duties as assigned

jobs.title: Security Specialist/HARPS Guard I - PT On Call Floater hours
jobs.description:
Position: PART-TIME PT Floater hours


SCHEDULE: on-call floater hours


Specific Tasks. The following tasks are general duties for the HARPS personnel. Contracting Personnel (CP) providing service at JBSA-Lackland and Randolph, AFB shall perform the following tasks below;

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: • Monitor all electromagnetic door locks, door contact switches, duress alarms and answer all telephone calls within the HARPS/Information Desk Control Area. This area is defined as the Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) room, and the adjacent administrative area commonly referred to as the Information Desk. • Personnel will monitor the Identipass, Genetech, and Premisys access control systems. • Initial training for these systems will be provided by a company representative of which the system is being provided by. The contractor will then be responsible to train any new CP thereafter. • The government will phase out any of the systems that will eventually no longer be in use. • Operate, observe and evaluate CCTVs within the HARPS/Information Desk Control Area. • Use the Government provided radio system to notify the Facility Management staff and/or the base installation Security Forces on any alarm or police response situations. • Monitor operations and status of overall security network for the MTF from the centralized console. • Operate HARPS/Information Desk intercom system master station at the console to communicate with entry/exit points or incident locations. • Utilize overhead paging system to notify personnel of emergency codes and alarms. Communicate all information in a clear and concise manner. • Operate video recorder and playback at the request of Facility Management personnel. • Maintain security log and activate control devices for interior and exterior doors. • Receive transfer calls from designated wing agencies and take messages or forward calls to appropriate agencies. • Report and initiate an action report log on any emergency situation and provide comprehensive information to responding agencies and Facility Management staff when appropriate. • Maintain up to date roster of on-call and emergency contact personnel for required areas. • The CP report to an appropriate authority (DCS Supervisors, Security Forces, and Facility Managers) any information or circumstances, which may pose a threat to the security of DoD personnel, contractor personnel, resources, and classified or unclassified defense information. • Maintain Chronology of Events, Access Control logs and Alarm Reports at all times. Event logs will be documented in a professional manner utilizing appropriate grammar and punctuation and include all pertinent information covering the parameters of “Who, What, When, and Where.” Event logs will be sent to Facility Management on a daily basis no later than 0800 hrs. These documents are for official use only. • CP shall perform and document physical checks of assigned buildings, rooms and areas when electronic systems are degraded. This includes manual fire watch procedures when fire alarm systems are down and checks of controlled areas such as pharmacies when Intrution Detection Systems (IDS) are degraded. • Act as the information focal point for all medical groups' personnel, patients and visitors on all resource protection activities and the liaison on these issues to the facility management office.


Qualifications.

  1. Have 12 months of experience as an alarm monitor or dispatcher, either in the military or civilian sector, within the last 3 years.
  2. Skills and Knowledge. Must be able to use, at minimum, Access Control System, Genetech, and Microsoft Programs such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  3. Shall be capable of sitting for an extended period of time during the course of their 8-hour shift, but are able to get up and move about within the area. CP shall be capable of bending, reaching, and lifting a minimum of 30 pounds to move and retrieve records or equipment, and may require prolonged walking and or standing.
  4. Personnel must be able to communicate in a clear and concise manner and demonstrate a calm demeanor during high-stress situations

jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Identity Verification in KATY, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $15.00 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon11:00 PM - 07:00 AMThur11:00 PM - 07:00 AMFri11:00 PM - 07:00 AM

How This Role Works

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer service to tenants, visitors, contractors, and clients at a commercial real estate location by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities when appropriate.
  • Monitor and control access to the property by verifying credentials, documenting visitor and contractor entry, issuing access credentials as authorized, and maintaining visitor logs.
  • Respond to access-control alarms, incidents, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following established escalation and reporting procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of building entrances, common areas, parking areas, and the property perimeter to help identify unauthorized access and unusual activity.
  • Communicate professionally with property management, tenants, and emergency responders, and complete accurate incident reports, daily activity reports, and access-control documentation.

Minimum Requirements

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

jobs.description:
Chicago Role Highlights

At a Glance

  • New Opening: Part-Time Warehouse With Benefits — Part-time Hours Full-time Benefits
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Company: UPS
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

Rewards

  • Earnings: $21-$23/Hour (approx. $23.1k/Year)
  • Benefits: Flexible scheduling available.
  • Earn extra cash with a stable local employer.

Day-to-Day

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

It sounds too good to be true — part-time hours with full-time quality benefits. But at UPS, it has been the reality for decades, and it is one of the primary reasons our part-time workforce has some of the highest retention rates in the logistics industry. Our Part-Time Warehouse positions with benefits are the rare exception in the American labor market — roles where Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision coverage, pension contributions, and paid personal time are available to associates working as few as 17.5 hours per week. When you search for warehouse jobs with benefits near me, nothing else on the market delivers what UPS does at the part-time level.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I took this job because my family needed health insurance and I could not afford individual coverage. UPS's Teamsters medical plan costs me a fraction of what individual insurance costs, covers my entire family, and is genuinely better coverage than what my spouse gets at their full-time job. I work 20 hours a week, I am home by 9:30 AM every morning, and my family's healthcare is completely handled. For anyone searching for warehouse jobs with benefits at part-time hours, UPS is completely in its own league." - Current Part-Time Associate with Benefits, Nashville, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Warehouse Associate with Benefits, you work a structured 3.5 to 5 hour sort shift inside our package center, performing the core loading, sorting, and unloading functions that keep the UPS delivery network running — and accessing a benefits package that most part-time employers do not even attempt to offer.

  • Core Sort Functions: Execute UPS's standard sort operation tasks — unloading trailers, sorting packages on conveyor systems, and loading delivery vehicles in sequence order — building skill and speed across all three functions over time on a consistent part-time schedule.
  • Benefits Enrollment Navigation: Work with UPS's onboarding team to enroll in Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision benefits, understand your pension accrual schedule, and register for the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program within your first weeks on the job.
  • Consistent Schedule Reliability: Maintain consistent attendance across your assigned part-time shift window — the foundation on which your Teamsters union seniority, annual wage progression, and long-term benefits eligibility are all built.

Benefits & Perks

This UPS part-time position includes the full Teamsters union benefits package — medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and eligible dependents, a defined-benefit pension plan, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance covering up to $25,000 in education costs. Weekly paychecks and contractual annual wage progression raises complete a benefits offering that no comparable part-time warehouse job with benefits in this market can match.

jobs.title: Security Guard
jobs.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic security team as a Security Guard and play a vital role in safeguarding our facilities, personnel, and assets. This energetic position requires vigilance, quick thinking, and a commitment to maintaining a safe environment. You will be responsible for monitoring premises through surveillance systems, conducting patrols, managing access control, and responding promptly to emergencies. Your proactive approach will ensure the safety and security of everyone on site while providing excellent customer service to visitors and staff alike.

Duties

  • Conduct regular patrols of the premises to identify potential security risks or breaches.
  • Monitor surveillance equipment such as CCTV cameras to oversee all activity within and around the facility.
  • Control access points using advanced access control systems, verifying identities and authorizations for employees, visitors, contractors, and vendors.
  • Respond swiftly to incidents or emergencies by following established protocols, including fire safety procedures and emergency response plans.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security breaches, accidents, or unusual activities observed during shifts.
  • Perform background checks on new personnel or visitors when required to ensure compliance with security regulations.
  • Utilize conflict management skills to de-escalate tense situations calmly and professionally while maintaining safety for all parties involved.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in physical security, law enforcement, military service, or related fields is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of surveillance technology such as CCTV systems and access control systems.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks including heavy lifting when necessary for patrol equipment or emergency situations.
  • Certification in first aid, CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation), AED (Automated External Defibrillator) operation, and fire safety procedures is preferred.
  • Familiarity with incident report writing and emergency response procedures to ensure accurate documentation and swift action.
  • Skills in conflict de-escalation, conflict management, and law enforcement collaboration to handle challenging situations effectively.
  • Physical fitness to perform patrols, stand for extended periods, and conduct heavy lifting if required.
  • Strong communication skills combined with excellent customer service abilities to interact professionally with staff and visitors while maintaining security standards.

Join us in creating a secure environment where safety is our top priority! We are committed to supporting your growth through comprehensive training opportunities and a vibrant team culture dedicated to excellence in security operations.

Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.via: via Women For Hire- Job Board
jobs.description:
Pay Rate: $20.58 per hour

Schedule: Mon, Weds & Fri 5pm - 11:30pm

The Forklift Operator is responsible for the safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, staging, scanning, and movement of freight. As certified forklift operators within the operation, they provide safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, movement, and documentation of cargo/freight within a multimodal transportation terminal, intermodal yard, warehouse, or dock environment, directly contributing to productivity, workflow coordination, and freight integrity. As the most experienced team members without direct reports, they often assist with mentoring, guiding, and onboarding new Material Handlers and solving complex operational problems on the floor.

Responsibilities

  • Load and unload freight using sit-down/stand-up forklifts and reach trucks, along with other appropriate Material Handling Equipment (MHE), such as pallet jacks, carts, and dollies, and approved physical lifting techniques.
  • Move, stage, sort, and position freight between dock doors, trailers, and designated warehouse areas in accordance with operating procedures.
  • Pick, pack, and prepare items for shipping and delivery.
  • Assist drivers with loading and unloading activities following dock and safety procedures.
  • Label, scan, and track freight using handheld scanning devices and company systems to ensure accuracy and documentation integrity.
  • Identify damaged freight and promptly report issues, unsafe conditions, or equipment concerns to supervisory personnel.
  • Abide by all company safety policies, OSHA requirements, and PPE standards.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized dock environment, including work areas, tools, and MHE.
  • Perform tasks under appropriate supervision while learning equipment operation, safety protocols, and job procedures (for developing roles).
  • Support dock productivity, workflow efficiency, and overall operational goals.
  • Work assigned schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on business needs.
  • Safely and accurately handle oversized, high‑value, or complex freight.
  • Assist with dock coordination, workflow management, and problem resolution.
  • Prioritize freight and coordinate task assignments, sometimes acting in a lead capacity (without direct supervisory responsibility).
  • Serve as a subject‑matter expert on dock operations, equipment, and procedures.
  • Train, mentor, and support the development of other Material Handlers.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

Qualifications

  • Education: High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED)/equivalent preferred but not required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Valid forklift certification/licensure (or ability to obtain before operating equipment) required.
  • Experience: 3+ years of dock or warehouse experience required.
  • Communication: Ability to communicate effectively in English, verbally and in writing, to understand safety and operational instructions, work assignments, and freight documentation.
  • Ability to recognize numbers, labels, barcodes, and freight markings accurately, and to perform basic arithmetic to verify freight counts, quantities, and weights.
  • Basic arithmetic skills to verify freight counts, quantities, and weights.
  • Technology: Willingness and ability to learn and use basic computer systems, handheld scanners, and freight-tracking devices.
  • Equipment: Ability to safely operate material handling equipment (MHE) such as pallet jacks, dollies, hand trucks, order pickers, pallet riders, conveyors, dock plates, dock levelers, sit-down/stand-up forklifts and reach trucks (with company-assisted certification/training), and/or other specialized MHE as required by the site.
  • Ability to maintain regular and predictable attendance.
  • Physical Demands: Extensive standing, walking, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and twisting for 8-12 hours per/shift, with the ability to lift, push, pull, and carry freight up to 50lbs without assistance, with occasional lifting of freight up to 75lbs with assistance or mechanical aids throughout each 8-12 hour shift, multiple times per/week.
  • Vision, hearing, and verbal communication skills sufficient to work safely in a noisy dock environment.
  • Environment: Ability to work safely around moving equipment, vehicles, and freight in a non-climate-controlled environment, including frequent exposure to temperature extremes (both hot and cold), occasional outdoor work and/or exposure to precipitation (rain, sleet, snow, etc.), regular exposure to moving equipment, vehicle traffic, exhaust, dust, and moderate to loud noise.

Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

jobs.description:
At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.

We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: “What would I do if this patient were my mom?” That question drives everything we do.

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.

Position Summary

Responsible for the primary oversight for the operation of the company-wide Corporate Security Operations Center based in Phoenix, AZ or Irving, TX. Perform company-wide security duties including ID badge access control system management, Security Surveillance Video Management System monitoring and investigative reviews, and emergency response for all sites nationally. Provides backup for contract security personnel tasks and duties at the HQ operations.

Job Responsibilities

  • Operates the Corporate Security Operations Center for Caris, working in a global mindset to provide professional security assistance for all of Caris' locations.
  • Performs routine viewing of surveillance monitoring system nationally for all Caris locations and notates and informs the Supervisor and Manager of Corporate Security of any errors or suspicious activity.
  • Creates and assigns permanent and temporary badges nationally for Caris employees, contractors and visitors.
  • Performs reception duties at the front desk when relieving the receptionist.
  • Acts as a first responder to render medical aid and dial 911 in an emergency.
  • Assists in investigate review of video management and badge management systems.
  • Perform patrols of Caris sites, taking notes and observations of hazards, malfunctions or safety / security related issues and contacts the appropriate personnel.
  • Performs clerical duties to assist the Supervisor and Manager of Corporate Security, such as data entry and auditing of Excel spreadsheets.
  • Follow the guidance and instruction from the Supervisor and Manager of Corporate Security.
  • Additional duties as needed and assigned.
  • Reports to Manager, Corporate Security.

Required Qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent experience required.
  • Communication - Proficient verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel, Outlook, and general working knowledge of Internet for business use.
  • Drive outcomes based on persistence and passion for excellence.
  • Ability to deal with confidential and sensitive information with tact and diplomacy.
  • Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Able to maintain timelines of delivery, quality of results, and maintain a calm demeanor in high pressure situations.
  • Ability to work productively and effectively with a wide variety of people, internally and externally.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel, Outlook, and general working knowledge of Internet for business use.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One to three years of security related experience is preferred.

Physical Demands

  • Will work at a computer, perform occasional patrols around multiple sites, up and down stairs and in or outdoors.
  • Must possess ability to sit and/or stand for long periods of time.
  • Must possess ability to perform repetitive motion.
  • Crouching and bending.
  • Capable of lifting 30 lbs.

Training

  • All job specific, safety, and compliance training are assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee.

Other

  • Travel and Response
  • This position requires local travel between sites and some evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • Job may require after-hours response to emergency issues.
  • Periodically scheduled on-call may require after-hours response for technical emergencies not explicitly related to assigned job responsibilities.

Conditions of Employment: Individual must successfully complete pre-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification.

This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Caris Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

jobs.description:
Software Tech Enterprises (STE) is an Information Technology Consulting firm headquartered in Frankfort, IL. STE supports commercial and government clients and provides services in IT Integrated Solutions, Software Development, Cloud Implementation Services, Artifactual Intelligent, Data Analytics, Project Management and other IT services. Our mission is to build value for our customers through optimum information technology methods, strategies, innovations and solutions.


Job Description


Role Description: The Facility Security Officer (FSO) will provide onsite support for all security actions in accordance with NISPOM and other Federal government security regulations. The FSO will serve as a liaison with US government counterparts, conduct security briefings and debriefings, monitor classified controlled areas, and perform periodic self-inspections.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all security operations including personnel clearance processing, tracking, education, reporting, debriefs and any other duties administratively.
  • Process necessary badges, visit requests and certifications for government facilities.
  • Daily use of personnel clearance data systems – DISS/NBIS and E-qip and other security software in the performance of assigned duties. 
  • Prepare, issue and maintain DD254s. 
  • Maintain classified materials receipt, logging, control, and dissemination. 
  • Maintain accountability of classified government-furnished information and equipment.
  • Participate in and perform inspections and audits. 
  • Maintain certification and accreditation of the facilities eligibility as well as personnel.
  • Create and update security plans, procedures, and instructions.
  • Develop and administer a comprehensive education training program.
  • Maintain and coordinate excellent working relationships with government agencies.
  • Assure compliance with all government and company security regulations.
  • This position requires U.S. Security Clearance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Oversee all duties assigned to the Security Clerk front desk for all locations.

CORE COMPETENCIES

jobs.description:
Job Description

California applicants: Please click here to review the Costco Applicant Privacy Notice.

The jobs listed are examples of the typical kinds of positions that Costco may hire for when openings exist. The listing does not mean that any positions are currently open or available at Costco.

Position Summary

Protects company assets from internal and external theft. Reviews individual warehouse inventory numbers and assists in creating / executing a plan of action to reduce shrink. Is familiar with various facets of operation that contribute to shrink and participates in instruction and training with affected employees. Observes and reports potential safety and security hazards. Investigates, detains suspects, completes reports, cooperates with local law enforcement, and testifies in court if necessary. Reports directly to the Warehouse Manager. Provides a high level of member service.

Job Duties

  • Walks the warehouse and perimeter up to 8 hours a day to monitor safety and security concerns. Pushes cart with merchandise and returns items to the floor. Maintains anonymity by shopping amongst members.
  • Follows and maintains knowledge of Costco procedures and applicable laws in performance of duties. Attends meetings and seminars regarding loss prevention.
  • Observes, detects, and investigates internal and external theft threats as well as safety concerns. Retrieves stolen items which shoplifters have concealed; may need to move product to access stolen items.
  • Detains and interviews shoplifters when warranted. Reports potential internal theft situations to the warehouse manager.
  • Prepares reports for internal use and for potential prosecution. Enters cases into case management system Nettrack.
  • Maintains evidence collected and reports files from investigations.
  • Testifies in court concerning theft investigations.
  • Communicates with other area Costco Loss Prevention Clerks and Security people of area businesses to exchange information about current, local theft threats.
  • Ensures proper cleanup and disposal of hazardous materials.
  • Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery.
  • Assists with department duties as necessary.
  • Assists in other departments of the warehouse as necessary.



For additional information about pay ranges, click here.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health benefits - medical/dental/vision/hearing aid/pharmacy/behavioral health/employee assistance, health care reimbursement account, dependent care assistance plan, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance, AD&D insurance, life insurance, 401(k), stock purchase plan to eligible employees.

Apart from any religious or disability considerations, open availability is needed to meet the needs of the business. If hired, you will be required to provide proof of authorization to work in the United States.

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class. Find the role that’s right for you. Apply today. We look forward to meeting you.

To learn more about Mission Technologies, click here for a short video: https://vimeo.com/732533072

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  • Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  • Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  • Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  • Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

HII Mission Technologies is looking for an experienced Facility Manager with Facility Security Office experience. The Ideal candidate will possess mid-level working experience in functional areas such as facility/property management and security officer duties. The individual will be responsible for performing all disciplines within facility maintenance, and security to include personnel security, physical security, document control, visitor control, as well as the protection and tracking of proprietary computing equipment.

The ideal candidate will also be responsible for the opening, closing, and daily management of a 5,000 – 10,000 square foot commercial facility to include managing all logistics management operations within the facility.

The applicant must have a working knowledge and experience with the below responsibilities:

Essential Job Responsibilities

Facility Security Officer Duties:

  • The successful candidate will manage all disciplines of security to include personnel and physical security, document control, visitor control, security education and training, and other duties as directed.
  • Will work closely with program CPSO’s to ensure that program personnel are processed accordingly for special accesses.
  • Will be responsible for the administration and coordination of DOD and other Industrial Security Programs and activities to ensure compliance with government and company security policies and procedures.
  • Will develop and administer security programs and procedures for classified or proprietary materials, documents, and equipment in coordination with government agencies and management personnel.
  • Have in-depth working knowledge to implement and enforce 32-CFR Part 117 and SEAD 3 Reporting Requirements.
  • Reviews and implements federal security regulations that apply to company operations.
  • Obtains rulings, approvals, interpretations, and acceptable deviations for compliance with regulations from government agencies.
  • Prepares manuals outlining regulations such as SOPs, SPPs, ITPs, EAPs and OPSEC.
  • Establishes procedures for record keeping, handling, storing, and for granting personnel and visitor access to restricted records and materials.
  • Prepares and conducts security education classes, incoming/outgoing facility inspections, and security audits.
  • Investigates security violations and prepares reports specifying preventive action to be taken.
  • Ensures individuals stay within scope for current investigations and perform the necessary actions for initial and/or reinvestigation actions and track accordingly to internal processes and procedures.
  • Conducts security self-inspections, physical security surveys, and threat/vulnerability assessments.
  • Ensures accuracy of the security clearance data base and document control using the Access Commander database.
  • Interfaces with government customers on security related issues.
  • Ensures that classified information entrusted to the company is properly safeguarded as outlined in federal controlling instructions.
  • Responsible for preparation, management, and interfacing with the Defense Counterintelligence Security Agency (DCSA) during audits.
  • Thorough knowledge of using/applying US Government online programs such as the National Background Investigation Services (NBIS), eAPP (Electronic Application), Defense Information System for Security (DISS) and the National Industrial Security System (NISS).

Facility and Logistics Management

  • Oversee daily facility operations for a 5,000–10,000 square foot commercial site.
  • Coordinate maintenance and manage vendor contracts for janitorial, HVAC, electrical, and security systems.
  • Develop and monitor facility budgets, track expenditures, and maintain inventory.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and ADA regulations, including NFPA and OSHA standards.
  • Plan and execute facility projects, including renovations and space planning.
  • Manage logistics operations, including shipping, receiving, and other support services.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for facility-related issues, including utilities, waste disposal, and emergency response.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
Company Overview:
Hillwood, a Perot Company, is a premier real estate investment and development company founded on a culture of integrity, respect, excellence and teamwork.
The company is a full-service real estate developer, investor and advisor focused on developing opportunities for investors, partners and communities around the world.
See additional details at www.hillwood.com.
Position Summary:
Hillwood is currently seeking a highly professional and disciplined Security Officer to join its in‑house security team at the corporate headquarters in Dallas, TX.
This veteran‑friendly organization has built an elite security team responsible for providing protective services for the facility, associates, guests, and family.
In addition to competitive pay and benefits, Hillwood supports continued education by supplementing tuition costs beyond available federal and state funding.
This role is ideal for an individual seeking long‑term growth and professional development, with the opportunity to transition into additional roles across the Perot Companies over time.
Responsibilities:
Protective Services and Site Security:
* Provide a safe and secure environment for associates, guests, and visitors by staffing various security posts and working assigned shifts.
* Secure premises and protect personnel through routine patrols of buildings and surrounding property.
* Maintain familiarity with high‑profile individuals and guests as required.
* Transport high‑profile guests and personnel in support of protective operations.
Monitoring, Response and Investigation:
* Monitor surveillance systems, access controls, and alarm systems.
* Respond to alarms, calls for service, and emergency situations.
* Investigate suspicious behavior, incidents, and potential security threats.
* Document and report incidents, observations, and activities accurately and thoroughly.
Communication and Coordination:
* Maintain effective communication with other security officers, supervisors, and internal staff.
* Use radios, mobile devices, and other technology to support security operations.
* Answer telephone calls and provide information during non‑business hours as required.
* Coordinate and work closely with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies when necessary.
Training, Readiness and Professional Standards:
* Maintain required firearm proficiency, emergency medical training, and other security‑related certifications.
* Remain prepared to respond to unexpected emergency situations and special events.
* Support team objectives and contribute to a disciplined, professional security culture.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
Required Skills and Abilities:
* Ability to operate effectively in a structured environment with established procedures, protocols, and expectations.
* Strong situational awareness and sound judgment with the ability to assess risk and respond appropriately to evolving situations.
* Demonstrated professionalism, discipline, and composure when interacting with associates, guests, high‑profile individuals, and external partners.
* Ability to follow post orders, policies, and directives while maintaining flexibility in dynamic or time‑sensitive situations.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly document incidents and observations.
* Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also operating independently when assigned.
* High level of integrity, discretion, and respect for confidentiality.
* Comfort using radios, mobile devices, surveillance systems, and other security‑related technology.
* Dependable, punctual, and able to maintain consistent performance across varying shifts and operational demands.
Education and Experience:
* Hillwood actively supports continued education and encourages team members to pursue a college degree.
* Prior U.S. military service strongly preferred.
* Experience providing security services in U.S. embassies, government facilities, military installations, or similar high‑security environments.
* Background in access control, patrol operations, surveillance, emergency response, or protective services highly desirable.
Physical Requirements:
* Each officer will present themselves in a welcoming manner and conservative appearance.
* Ability to maintain firearm proficiency, emergency medical and other security related training.
* Maintain Texas Class C driver’s license and operate a motor vehicle and other equipment as needed.
* Must maintain a Texas Department of Public Safety Level 4 security officer certification.
* Maintain a clean and presentable appearance without facial hair.
Benefits Highlights:
* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
* Vacation time
* Sick time
* Holidays
* Paid family caregiver leave

* Life Insurance

* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition assistance
* Additional programs to support Associates and their families

jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Allied Universal® is hiring a Director of Operations for the Houston Branch office, reporting the the General Manager. As Director of Operations, you will manage onsite Account Managers, with the majority of them who have commercial real estate clients, to ensure client satisfaction and optimal Security Professional performance at multiple branch security locations and client sites. By promoting strong employee engagement, you will drive operational metrics and deliver world-class services to clients across various vertical markets, including healthcare, commercial real estate, government, and hospitality. Aligning with our iCARE Leadership approach, you will be a guide on our journey to be an employer of choice in the service industry by fostering an exceptional employee experience.

This ideal candidate for this position is someone who has security Management experience with Commercial Real Estate clients, great people skills, and a high technology acumen who works well in a high-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Caring Leadership, Client Engagement, and Operational Oversight:

  • Lead and mentor a team of Account Managers by providing coaching, support, and recognition, while fostering accountability. Encourage a collaborative and inclusive work environment to promote teamwork, open communication, and professional development, while taking ownership of succession planning at all levels
  • Build, maintain, and grow relationships with clients by understanding their security needs and ensuring satisfaction; Develop and implement corrective action plans for Identified opportunities for operational improvement
  • Deliver high-quality service to our clients by strategically overseeing Account Managers, while maintaining industry standards, company policies, and regulatory requirements
  • Analyze, report and drive operational metrics and KPI’s using Allied Universal's Business Intelligence Platform, maximizing efficiency and productivity
  • Identify and mitigate security risks; develop and implement security protocols, training and response plans
  • Establish a culture of safety by developing action plans that aid in the prevention of work-related injuries

Financial Performance And Growth

  • Work with branch leadership to strengthen financial performance within your assigned portfolio by managing budget allocation, driving revenue growth, reducing non-billable overtime, improving cash collections, and controlling expenses
  • Collaborate with leadership to drive organic business growth within existing client operations

By infusing our core values of agility, reliability, caring, teamwork, integrity, safety, and innovation into your leadership approach, you will not only achieve success in your role but also contribute to the positive culture and growth of the organization.

Qualifications (must Have)

  • Must possess one or more of the following:
    • Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, business or a related field with three (3) years of management experience in a high-volume workforce environment or service industry
    • Associate’s degree in criminal justice, business or a related field with five (5) years of management experience in a high-volume workforce environment or service industry
    • High School diploma or equivalent with seven (7) years of management experience in a high-volume workforce environment or service industry
  • Current driver’s license if driving a company vehicle or personal vehicle in the course of conducting business (e.g., client visits, attending networking events)
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience driving operational goals and metrics
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in successfully building and developing teams
  • Leadership skills that foster teamwork, innovation, agility, client relations and achieving desired results
  • Ability to maintain a profitable book of business by cross-collaborating and utilizing results-oriented problem-solving skills to meet both client and employee growth and satisfaction
  • Proficiency in web-based applications and computer systems, including Microsoft Office and (BI) Business Intelligence tools for metrics analysis, reporting, automation, and presentations
  • Dynamic networking skills displaying a commitment to safety and trust by participating in local community, client and industry events
  • Basic understanding of financial principles, including budgeting and financial reporting. Ability to interpret simple financial data and use it to support decision-making
Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)

  • Law enforcement, military and/or contract or proprietary security services experience
  • Experience managing a dispersed workforce in a multi-location operation

What You Will Do

  • Account for all people entering plant
  • Perimeter check of plant to ensure facility is secure

  • Monitor CIMA radio and contact CIMA during incidents
  • Perform safety orientation for visitors/3rd parties

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed. This position may perform other duties as assigned.

Education

What You Need

  • High School Diploma or GED Equivalency

Required Qualifications

  • Must possess and maintain a valid motor vehicle operator's license and a driving record satisfactory to the company and its insurers
  • Must pass and complete Safety training/certification as required by customers to work in their facilities and as required by Kinder Morgan at all locations
  • Must obtain and/or meet all requirements to enter foreign trade zones; such as background checks by both the U.S. Coast Guard and the Department of Homeland Security, i.e. obtain and maintain a Transportation Workers Identification Card (TWIC)
  • The successful candidate will be required to clear a drug screen and a complete background check, after an offer has been extended and prior to being employed
  • PC literacy and software navigation skills in a window-based environment are essential
  • Must be able to effectively communicate verbally with all levels of management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous chemical, refining or terminal experience is preferred

Working Conditions

  • Must be willing to work in outdoors environmentMust be willing to work overtime with little or no notice during the week, weekends, holidays, etc as dictated by operations
  • Ability to work rotating shifts, including day, night, weekends and holidays
  • In order to perform the essential duties, regular work attendance is required

Must be willing and able to work as a part of team, take direction from supervisor(s), prioritize work schedules, focus attention to details, and follow work rules.

Why Join Kinder Morgan

jobs.title: Armed Security Officer Flex Office Building
jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Allied Universal® is hiring a Security Professional Flex Officer. The Security Professional Flex Officer will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Healthcare, Education, Finance and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Security Professional Flex Officer, you’ll use our exclusive shift-pickup platform to view and claim open shifts based on your availability - giving you the freedom to build a schedule that works for you, while gaining valuable site experience across various industries. Whether you're looking to supplement your income or take the first step toward a phenomenal career, this position offers unmatched access to hands-on experience and growth opportunities. The Security Professional Flex Officer may be called upon to work irregular shifts at times with little to no advance notice.

Responsibilities

  • Perform security patrols of designated areas on foot or in vehicle
  • Watch for irregular or unusual conditions that may create security concerns or safety hazards
  • Sound alarms or calls police or fire department in case of fire or presence of unauthorized persons
  • Warn violators of rule infractions, such as loitering, smoking, or carrying forbidden articles
  • Permit authorized persons to enter property and monitors entrances and exits
  • Observe departing personnel to protect against theft of company property and ensures that authorized removal of property is conducted within appropriate client requirements
  • Investigate and prepare reports on accidents, incidents, and suspicious activities; maintain written logs as required by the post
  • Aid customers, employees, and visitors in a courteous and professional manner
  • Make emergency notifications as necessary pursuant to site Post Orders

Qualifications (must Have)

  • Must possess a high school diploma or equivalent or 5 years of verifiable experience
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
  • Valid driver’s license if driving a company or customer-owned vehicle
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws; Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law
  • No prior experience required
  • Be at least 18 years of age, or higher if required by the state (21 years, if armed)
  • Reliability and ability to adapt to different post assignments
  • Be able to operate radio or telephone equipment and/or console monitors
  • Demonstrated ability to interact cordially and communicate with the public
  • Effective oral and written communication skills; able to write informatively, clearly, and accurately
  • Active listening and problem-solving skills
  • Assess and evaluate situations effectively; identify critical issues quickly and accurately
  • Mediate conflict with tact, diplomacy
  • Teamwork
  • Attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)

  • Ability to speak, read, and write in multiple languages (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, French, Arabic)
  • Prior security, military, or law enforcement experience

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, basic life, AD&D, and disability insurance
  • Company's retirement plans
  • Seven holidays annually paid at time and a half, if worked
  • 40 hours of vacation after one year of employment at eligible work assignments; unused vacation is only paid out where required by law

Closing

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Security Officer
jobs.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a dedicated Loss Prevention Security Officer to maintain a safe and secure environment for our guests and staff. In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Patrolling all areas of the property and assisting guests with room access.
  • Monitoring Closed Circuit Television, perimeter alarms, duress alarms, and fire life safety systems.
  • Locking property entrances when necessary and conducting daily physical hazard inspections.
  • Responding to accidents, contacting EMS, or administering first aid/CPR as required.
  • Assisting guests and employees during emergency situations and notifying appropriate individuals of incidents.
  • Defusing disturbances and calling for outside assistance if needed.
  • Completing incident reports to document all Security/Loss Prevention related incidents.
  • Handling interruptions and complaints, and resolving safety hazard situations.
  • Escorting unwelcome individuals from the property while ensuring smooth property operations.
  • Reporting to scenes of vehicle accidents or thefts and calling for assistance using proper codes.
  • Completing daily activity reports and maintaining confidentiality of all Security/Loss Prevention documents.
  • Conducting investigations and gathering evidence through interviews with relevant parties.
  • Following all company policies and procedures, reporting accidents and unsafe conditions to management.
  • Ensuring uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional.
  • Welcoming guests and addressing their service needs with genuine appreciation.
  • Developing and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues to reach common goals.
  • Complying with quality assurance expectations.
  • Staying physically active as the role requires standing, walking, or sitting for long periods.

Candidates should be able to move, lift, carry, push, and pull objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance and have the ability to enter and locate work-related information using computers and systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Experience: No previous work experience required.

Licenses/Certifications: None required.

Location: 2222 N Stemmons Fwy, Dallas, Texas, United States, 75207

jobs.title: Event Security
jobs.description:
Job Summary: Austin FC
Provide security detail as outlined in the post orders and establish working relationships with customers, local law enforcement and fire departments. Security personnel will always perform job duties with a constant awareness of surroundings, making note of all activity that takes place in the assigned area. Security Officers must maintain a professional image and always demonstrate excellent customer service.

Basic Functions:
  • Control of entrances and movement of pedestrian and vehicle traffic.
  • Patrol of buildings and perimeters.
  • Escort of material and personnel.
  • Inspection of security and fire exposures.
  • Special assignments.
Responsibilities:
Duties may vary depending on department size, organizational structure, geographic location and post assignments. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow for certain ADA requirements. Overall general function of officers is to provide security detail as described below (Note: duties may vary depending on post orders):
  • Be on time and report to post in full uniform.
  • Maintain professional image that includes greeting customers, visitors and employees in a polite and friendly manner.
  • Be proactive in knowing all revisions to post orders and general information distributed by the customer and AFS.
  • Patrol physical property or maintain fixed post position, being diligent to report any suspicious activity and investigate accidents and criminal acts.
  • Monitor cameras or equipment in a continuous fashion as outlined in the post orders.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of all emergency policies, procedures and regulations to be able to respond to alarms, incidents and emergency situations.
  • Complete Daily Activity Reports, Log Book entries, Incident Reports and all relevant reports related to job assignment.
  • Make recommendations to management on better safety and loss prevention processes as identified during daily routine.
  • Have knowledge of any life safety systems, fire panels, CCTV system computer, and other such equipment to complete job assignments. Ensure continuous and safe operation of all elevators and access doors. Know authorized contractor personnel who are responsible for maintenance and upkeep of equipment.
  • Ensure training and compliance guidelines are met as outlined by AFS and other agencies regulating the customer / market.
  • Communicate on a daily basis with Security Supervisor any new Security Issues or changes that need to be considered or implemented.
Skills and Abilities:
  • A security officer is to be honest, alert and well-disciplined as the custodians of employee and customer property and safety.
  • Constant and dedicated vigilance.
  • Strong customer service skills, exemplifying Andy Frain Services Mission Statement.
  • Ability to be a hands-on, results oriented employee, handling multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to facilitate progressive change, work as part of a team and follow directions.
  • Work with a sense of urgency.
  • Strong oral and written communications skills.
This description portrays in general terms the type and level(s) of work performed and is not intended to be all-inclusive, nor the specific duties of any one incumbent. Andy Frain Services reserves the right to modify, supplement, delete or augment the duties and responsibilities specified in the position description, in the Company's sole and absolute discretion. Duties other than those expressly specified may be assigned from time to time.

jobs.title: Basic Security Fundamental Support Instructor II (Swim Tester / Lifeguard)
jobs.description:
Type: Full Time

Location: NTTC Lackland/ San Antonio, Texas

Overtime Exempt: No

Reports To: ARMADA HQ

Duties & Responsibilities

  • The Basic Security Fundamental Support Instructor II (Swim Tester / Lifeguard) administers Navy Second Class Swimmer testing for designated Master‑at‑Arms students in accordance with NETC P1552/16 swim testing standards.
  • The Basic Security Fundamental Support Instructor II (Swim Tester / Lifeguard) conducts all poolside safety checks, verify facility readiness, ensure required safety equipment is present, and confirm communication capabilities.
  • Perform lifeguard duties during all swim testing events and evaluate students in accordance with Navy Swimming and Water Survival Instructor Manual guidelines.
  • Complete the Record of Swim Qualification and ensure accurate documentation of all results.
  • Coordinate with NTTC Lackland administrative staff to record successful or unsuccessful test completions in FLTMPS and in student service records.
  • Assist with scheduling pool access and work directly with NTTC and Joint Base San Antonio swimming facility personnel.
  • Deliver CPR instruction and support other non‑weapons training modules within MA "A" School after obtaining CUIT qualifications.
  • Ensure compliance with medical pre‑screening requirements, swimmer safety policies, and high‑risk training precautions.
  • The Basic Security Fundamental Support Instructor II (Swim Tester / Lifeguard) maintains all required certifications and ensures documentation is properly filed in the Instructor Training Jacket (ITJ).
  • Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities (KSAs)

  • Knowledge of Navy swim testing procedures, water survival standards, and CPR instruction requirements.
  • Ability to perform lifeguard duties, administer swim qualifications, and evaluate student safety and performance.
  • Strong understanding of aquatic safety practices, rescue procedures, and emergency response techniques.
  • Ability to coordinate with medical, administrative, and facility personnel to ensure compliance with screening, documentation, and reporting processes.
  • Strong communication skills for delivering CPR instruction and supporting training modules.
  • Ability to maintain physical readiness to perform water‑based rescue, testing, and instructional tasks.

Minimum/General Experience

  • Possess current certification as a lifeguard. Lifeguard certification requires one of the following:
    • American Red Cross Lifeguard Training
    • YMCA Lifeguard Training
