jobs.description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon’s Global Security Department, a department that supports the U.S. MTO Management & Executive Protection Team in Fort Worth, TX.

The Watch Officer for the Global Security Operations Center is responsible for executing operational tasks that support secure, efficient, and compliant security operations. This role ensures seamless physical security for Alcon’s property, assets, and employees by following established procedures, applying advanced skills, and using sound judgment.

Specifics Include:

  • Dispatches and coordinates responses impacting Alcon’s assets globally.
  • Monitors the access control system and supports badge access functions.
  • Monitors intelligence providers, global news, and open-source media for events that could impact Alcon’s operations and disseminates relevant information to leadership.
  • Actively seeks and communicates information on incidents that may affect global sites.
  • Uses SOPs, training, research resources, and critical thinking skills to escalate events appropriately to Watch Officer Lead(s) and GSOC manager.
  • Produces clear, concise written incident reports summarizing events, impacts, and response status.
  • Maintains continuous and accurate documentation of events throughout the shift.
  • Understands Alcon’s global footprint to anticipate operational and organizational needs.
  • Receives, evaluates, and disseminates information from on-site security, global points of contact, employees, and other sources, engaging Watch Officer Lead(s) when needed.
  • Works effectively with security team members and intelligence analyst in a collaborative environment.
  • Suggests program improvements to Watch Officer Lead(s) or the GSOC Manager.
  • Tracks and reports on metrics related to operational output and deliverables.
  • Performs tasks related to designing, developing, and maintaining security processes and system integrations.
  • Supports actions and tasks related to incident management, risk and intelligence, protective services, investigations, and aviation security.
  • Follows product concerns, crisis management protocols, escalation plans, and required training.
  • Responds appropriately to safety and security assistance requests, and coordinates with local law enforcement.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Work Hours: Weekend shift consists of three 12‑hour shifts totaling 36 hours, running from 6:00 PM CST to 6:00 AM CST each day from Friday evening through Monday morning
  • Travel Requirements: 0%
  • Location: Onsite
  • Sponsorship & Relocation: Not Available

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience in incident response, security operations or a related field required, with a demonstrated history of excellence and reliability.
  • Ability to utilize critical thinking skills to operate effectively with a medium degree of autonomy and moderate supervision.
  • Intelligence analysis and/or threat assessment knowledge.
  • General understanding of site security operations.
  • Intermediate communication skills.
  • Intermediate attention to detail and ability to follow protocols with the drive to progress and learn.
  • Able to provide clear and concise verbal briefings.
  • Familiarity with global affairs and events, with the ability to contextualize against Alcon’s global footprint.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Knowledge of Google Earth and Maps.
  • Effective problem-solving skills.
  • Fast learner and ability to coordinate several initiatives simultaneously.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize work with little supervision.
  • Ability to adhere to timelines and deadlines with effective time management skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain positive professional rapport with other Watch Officers, Watch Officer Lead(s), GSOC Manager, R&I Director, the greater security leadership, and client stakeholders.
  • Accurate typing and written skills.

HOW YOU CAN THRIVE:

  • Collaborate with teammates to share standard processes and findings as work evolves
  • See your career like never before with focused growth and development opportunities
  • Join Alcon’s mission to provide outstanding, innovative products and solutions to improve sight, improve lives, and grow your career!
  • Alcon provides robust benefits package including health, life, retirement, flexible time off and much more.

jobs.description:
Starting Rate of Pay: $22.77/ hour

Shift Time: 0500-1000, 1700-2200

Position Overview

Transport freight across dock area to/from trailers for loading to trailers.

Essential Functions

  • Perform freight handling using appropriate motorized and manual equipment, including but not limited to: forklift, pallet jack and hand truck.
  • Verify documentation matches freight description (e.g. type, weight, hazardous materials), using current electronic or manual system.
  • Secure freight inside trailers using appropriate tools and supplies (e.g. pallets, straps, rope).
  • Recoup/repair damaged freight when necessary.
  • Verify and complete required documentation and reports.
  • Assist customers with freight and freight documentation as needed.
  • Perform hostling duties if required.
  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.
  • Perform other duties as required.

DISCLAIMER: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, essential functions and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent, preferred.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Prior experience in warehousing, freight handling and/or fork lift operations preferred.
  • If hostler/yard mule duties required, experience preferred.
  • Ability to count and perform basic math, with or without a calculator.
  • Basic written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to lift/carry hand freight of varying weights several times a week, to lift dock plates weighing approximately 100 pounds, and to open trailer doors requiring approximately 75 pounds of lift force, up to several times per day or more.
  • Ability to bend, twist, squat, pushing/pulling freight throughout shift.
  • Ability to work independently and/or as a team member.
  • Previous dock/warehouse experience preferred.

Working Conditions

  • Dock environment; exposure to varied weather conditions, exhaust, fumes, dust, noise.
  • Hours may vary due to operational need.
  • Frequent contact with service center personnel; fast-paced, deadline oriented.

jobs.via: via Frito Lay Jobs - Search Hires Today
jobs.description:
Job Description

Inventory Control Associates are an important part of Frito-Lay's distribution network, helping ensure products move efficiently through every stage of warehouse operations. In this role, you'll assist with receiving deliveries, managing inventory, fulfilling customer orders, and preparing shipments while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and operational performance. If you're motivated by hands-on work and enjoy working as part of a collaborative team in a dynamic warehouse environment, this position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to our daily operations.

What You'll Do

  • Receive and unload inbound freight, ensuring products and materials are handled safely and efficiently.

  • Pick, organize, and stage products for outbound orders according to established warehouse procedures.

  • Use forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material-handling equipment after completing required training and certification.

  • Relocate inventory within the warehouse and place products in assigned storage locations using proper handling practices.

  • Verify product quantities, labels, and shipment documentation to maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Participate in inventory counts, replenishment efforts, and general warehouse organization projects.

  • Assemble, wrap, and secure pallets to support safe storage and transportation of products.

  • Maintain a clean and organized workspace by performing routine housekeeping and safety inspections.

  • Comply with all company policies, food safety requirements, and standard operating procedures.

  • Work alongside warehouse associates, supervisors, and transportation partners to meet daily productivity and customer service goals.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Flexibility to work varying schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as operational needs require.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, pull, and move warehouse products throughout the workday.

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, climb, kneel, and perform repetitive physical activities during extended shifts.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently follow established work instructions and safety procedures.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-focused work environment.

  • Prior experience in warehousing, distribution, logistics, manufacturing, or material handling is a plus but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse responsibilities throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in warehouse conditions that may include temperature changes, moving equipment, and moderate to high noise levels.

  • Safely operate powered industrial equipment while following all workplace safety requirements.

Skills & Competencies

  • Commitment to safe work practices

  • Effective communication and collaboration

  • Reliability and personal accountability

  • Accuracy in inventory handling

  • Organization and time management

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving

  • Ability to adapt and perform in a high-volume warehouse environment

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, depends on skilled warehouse employees to keep products moving efficiently across its distribution network. As a Inventory Control Associate, you'll support the receiving, storage, and shipment of products while helping maintain safe, efficient operations and delivering the quality and service our customers rely on every day.

Q: Does Frito-Lay require background checks or drug tests?

A: Many positions may require a background check, and some roles may also include drug testing depending on the position and location.

Q: What benefits does Frito-Lay offer employees?

A: Depending on the position and eligibility, benefits may include medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage, tuition reimbursement, and other employee programs. Certain positions may also offer bonuses or additional incentives.

Q: What kind of training do new Frito-Lay employees receive?

A: New employees typically receive on-the-job training specific to their position, including job procedures, safety requirements, equipment use, and performance expectations.

Q:Are forklift jobs easy to get?
A: Fairly accessible — many warehouses hire with little to no experience if you get certified (a short course, often 1-2 days). Demand stays steady since most large warehouses/distribution centers need forklift operators.

jobs.title: Inventory Control Associate
jobs.via: via Frito Lay Jobs - Search Hires Today
jobs.description:
Job Description

Inventory Control Associates are an important part of Frito-Lay's distribution network, helping ensure products move efficiently through every stage of warehouse operations. In this role, you'll assist with receiving deliveries, managing inventory, fulfilling customer orders, and preparing shipments while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and operational performance. If you're motivated by hands-on work and enjoy working as part of a collaborative team in a dynamic warehouse environment, this position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to our daily operations.

What You'll Do

  • Receive and unload inbound freight, ensuring products and materials are handled safely and efficiently.

  • Pick, organize, and stage products for outbound orders according to established warehouse procedures.

  • Use forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material-handling equipment after completing required training and certification.

  • Relocate inventory within the warehouse and place products in assigned storage locations using proper handling practices.

  • Verify product quantities, labels, and shipment documentation to maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Participate in inventory counts, replenishment efforts, and general warehouse organization projects.

  • Assemble, wrap, and secure pallets to support safe storage and transportation of products.

  • Maintain a clean and organized workspace by performing routine housekeeping and safety inspections.

  • Comply with all company policies, food safety requirements, and standard operating procedures.

  • Work alongside warehouse associates, supervisors, and transportation partners to meet daily productivity and customer service goals.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Flexibility to work varying schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as operational needs require.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, pull, and move warehouse products throughout the workday.

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, climb, kneel, and perform repetitive physical activities during extended shifts.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently follow established work instructions and safety procedures.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-focused work environment.

  • Prior experience in warehousing, distribution, logistics, manufacturing, or material handling is a plus but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse responsibilities throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in warehouse conditions that may include temperature changes, moving equipment, and moderate to high noise levels.

  • Safely operate powered industrial equipment while following all workplace safety requirements.

Skills & Competencies

  • Commitment to safe work practices

  • Effective communication and collaboration

  • Reliability and personal accountability

  • Accuracy in inventory handling

  • Organization and time management

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving

  • Ability to adapt and perform in a high-volume warehouse environment

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, depends on skilled warehouse employees to keep products moving efficiently across its distribution network. As a Inventory Control Associate, you'll support the receiving, storage, and shipment of products while helping maintain safe, efficient operations and delivering the quality and service our customers rely on every day.

Q: Can work schedules change at Frito-Lay?

A: Yes. Schedules can vary based on the position, location, staffing needs, and business demand. Distribution, warehouse, and delivery roles may require flexibility, including early mornings, weekends, holidays, or schedule changes.

Q: What kind of training do new Frito-Lay employees receive?

A: New employees typically receive on-the-job training specific to their position, including job procedures, safety requirements, equipment use, and performance expectations.

Q:Does Frito-Lay pay overtime?
A: Yes — 71% of surveyed employees said they receive overtime pay for their role at Frito-Lay. Some part-time reviewers note overtime access can be limited.

Q:Is Frito-Lay weekly pay?
A: Yes, based on employee reviews, pay was described as weekly.

What You'll Do

About UPS & Our Culture

Friday evening through Sunday night — that is when the UPS weekend operation runs at its highest volume, and it is when our Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers earn some of the strongest hourly rates in our entire package center network. If your Monday-through-Friday schedule is locked and you are hunting for weekend warehouse jobs that actually pay well, offer union benefits, and leave every weekday untouched, UPS weekend shifts were designed specifically for you. We are one of the only employers in the logistics industry offering weekend warehouse jobs near me with full Teamsters union representation, meaning your weekend hours come with the same contractual protections and pay guarantees as any full-time role.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I have a full-time desk job Monday through Friday and I work UPS weekends to pay down my mortgage faster. The weekend differential on top of the union wage makes the hourly rate genuinely excellent, and I get my full weekdays completely untouched. In two years I have built a serious financial cushion on this schedule. If you are looking for legitimate weekend warehouse jobs near me that respect your weekday life, UPS is it." - Current Weekend Package Handler, Indianapolis, IN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handler, you work Friday evening through Sunday sort shifts inside our package center, processing the weekend's elevated residential delivery and pickup volume that builds throughout the week and peaks on Saturday and Sunday sort windows.

  • Weekend Volume Processing: Sort, load, and unload the high-density package volume that accumulates through the week, operating at peak throughput across Friday night, Saturday, and Sunday shifts to clear the facility for Monday morning delivery routes.
  • Weekend Surge Handling: Navigate the additional volume generated by weekend e-commerce orders and residential pickups, adapting quickly to higher-than-weekday sort targets that UPS weekend shifts routinely reach.
  • Trailer Loading & Unloading: Pull inbound packages from arriving trailers and build outbound loads in package cars and linehaul lanes, using UPS-approved stacking methods to maintain load quality standards across all weekend shifts.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers receive a weekend shift differential on top of the Teamsters base union wage. Full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance apply regardless of your part-time weekend schedule. Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday. Your entire Monday-through-Friday schedule remains completely untouched.

Responsibilities

  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.

About UPS & Our Culture

Precision is the promise UPS makes to every customer, and our Quality Control team is the internal force that keeps that promise intact. QC Associates audit the sort operation in real time — catching misloads, verifying scan compliance, and inspecting load quality before a single truck leaves the building. If you are searching for analytical UPS warehouse jobs that reward a sharp eye and a methodical mindset over raw physical speed, Quality Control is the most intellectually engaging role on the sort floor. These are warehouse jobs that directly protect the UPS service guarantee and drive some of the strongest internal logistics careers in our operations network.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"QC work suits my personality perfectly. I am not the fastest loader in the building, but I can spot a misload in three seconds and I find the audit process genuinely satisfying. Management noticed my accuracy rate and I was moved into a quality trainer role within a year. The UPS internal track rewards precision just as much as speed, and that is something most warehouse jobs never offer." - Current Quality Control Associate, Minneapolis, MN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Quality Control Warehouse Associate, you conduct real-time audits of sort accuracy, load quality, and scan compliance across the active sort floor inside our package center, catching errors before they generate service failures for UPS customers.

  • Misload Auditing: Systematically scan packages inside loaded package cars against the assigned route manifest, identifying any package loaded into the wrong vehicle and immediately correcting the misload before the driver departs.
  • Scan Compliance Verification: Audit sort belt scan rates in real time, identifying packages that bypassed the scan tunnel without a valid read and manually scanning them into the system to maintain chain-of-custody accuracy.
  • Load Quality Inspection: Walk loaded package cars before departure to verify that load quality meets UPS standards — no overhanging packages, heavy items on shelves not floors, fragile items in protected positions — documenting violations and coaching loaders immediately.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Quality Control Associates receive Teamsters union wages, full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program. The analytical nature of this role creates a direct pathway into UPS operations management and industrial engineering career tracks.

Saturday and Sunday belong to UPS — and we pay exceptionally well for them. Our Weekend Fulfillment Worker positions are specifically designed for professionals, students, parents, and side-hustle seekers who need every weekday completely untouched. These weekend fulfillment center jobs deliver Teamsters union wages plus a weekend differential on just two days of work, making them one of the highest-value part-time income opportunities in the logistics market. jobs.title: Flexible Night Sort Warehouse Associate(Chicago)
jobs.description:
Opportunity in Chicago

At a Glance

  • Based in: Chicago, IL (a key business district)
  • Employer: UPS (Hiring in Chicago)
  • Compensation: $22-$25/Hour (approx. $28.4k/Year)
  • Flexible Role in Chicago: Night Sort Warehouse Associate
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.
  • Project-based work with clear objectives.
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

At United Protective Services, our people are our greatest asset. We are looking for reliable, positive people who want to serve others, and grow in their security careers. In return, we provide training, support, and opportunities you need to succeed.

Job Skills / Requirements

Join Our Team – Security Site Supervisor Needed Immediately

High-Profile Class A Commercial Property

Position: Security Site Supervisor Schedule: Monday – Friday | 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM Compensation: Salary Position (Compensation discussed during the interview)

United Protective Services is seeking an experienced, professional, and motivated Security Site Supervisor to lead daily security operations at a prestigious Class A commercial property. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual who thrives in a leadership role, values exceptional customer service, and is committed to building a high-performing security team.

The ideal candidate is a confident leader with strong organizational and computer skills who can effectively supervise officers, maintain operational excellence, and foster positive relationships with both clients and tenants.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Supervise and lead the daily operations of the onsite security team.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring, and accountability to security officers while promoting a positive team culture.
  • Ensure officers are properly trained, professional in appearance, and consistently meeting performance expectations.
  • Deliver outstanding customer service to property management, tenants, visitors, and vendors.
  • Monitor daily operations to ensure all patrols, inspections, and assigned tasks are completed accurately and on time.
  • Review, approve, and maintain Daily Activity Reports (DARs), incident reports, and other security documentation.
  • Utilize security software and Microsoft Office applications to complete administrative responsibilities and maintain accurate records.
  • Coordinate closely with Property Management and company leadership regarding security operations, incidents, staffing, and special projects.
  • Respond to emergencies, security incidents, and customer concerns in a professional and decisive manner.
  • Conduct routine property inspections to identify safety hazards, maintenance concerns, and security vulnerabilities.
  • Assist with scheduling, officer training, performance coaching, and operational planning as needed.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of security experience required.
  • Previous security supervisory or leadership experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience supervising security personnel in a commercial office environment preferred.
  • Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and the ability to learn security reporting software.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven leadership abilities with a strong focus on coaching, accountability, and team development.
  • Exceptional customer service and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Active Texas Level II Security License required (Level III preferred).

What We're Looking For

  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join United Protective Services?

  • Monday through Friday schedule with weekends off.
  • Leadership opportunity at a premier commercial property.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Stable, long-term assignment.
  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement.
  • Supportive leadership team and professional work environment.
If you're ready to lead a team, provide exceptional customer service, and make a meaningful impact at one of Houston's premier commercial properties, we encourage you to apply today.

Job Summary:

As a Fortune 50 company with over 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and a leader in American retail. Working at Target provides the opportunity to help families experience the joy of everyday life. We are deeply committed to supporting our communities, investing in the places we live, work, and play. Our team values relationships, fosters talent growth, and thrives together as one. At our core, we prioritize care, growth, and success together.

Roles and Duties:

  • Maintain a safe workplace by adhering to all safety policies and guidelines.
  • Join safety training meetings to improve your competence in handling tasks swiftly in a warehouse setting.
  • Organize, transfer, and distribute products to both stores and individuals.
  • Ensure the meticulous handling of goods for store shipment and guest drop-offs.
  • Streamline inventory movement and proficiently manage freight within the warehouse.
  • Keep your work area clean, organized, and free from any unnecessary mess.
  • Arrive at work on time and ensure that tasks are executed with precision and according to the established schedule.
  • Play a role in problem-solving endeavors to sustain operational enhancements.
  • Illustrate a beneficial and courteous manner when working by yourself or in a group.

Requirements:

  • Able to frequently lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs.
  • Able to occasionally lift and carry items up to 60 lbs.
  • Capacity to maintain an upright position, move about, exert pressure, pull, crouch, flex, and stretch during shifts.
  • Retain a constructive and professional mindset during teamwork or individual assignments.
  • Essential numerical proficiencies, such as counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Proficient in understanding and interpreting labels, tickets, and other forms of product documentation correctly.
  • Independently manage computer systems or handheld devices with minimal supervision once adequately trained.
  • Effective communication through speech and writing.
  • Aptitude in understanding, verbally expressing, and interpreting English to heed safety guidelines, policies, and instructions.

Additional Requirements:

  • Proficient in receiving education and operating motorized machinery responsibly (such as Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit-Down & Stand-Up Forklift).
  • Skilled in working effectively at heights up to 40 feet when the situation demands.
  • Skilled in working for extended periods in temperature-regulated settings, which may include refrigeration and freezing conditions.

Benefits:

Target team members may qualify for a comprehensive benefits package, subject to plan terms and employment eligibility. Employees also receive a 10% Target discount, plus an extra 20% off select wellness products, including fruits, vegetables, healthy foods, activewear, and tobacco cessation products.

Note:

Based on business needs and role requirements within Warehouse Operations, candidates may be considered for either a Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate position. The specific job responsibilities for each role are outlined in the application process.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Distribution Center Associate are an important part of the Frito-Lay team, helping keep products moving safely and efficiently throughout our warehouse and distribution network. In this role, you'll receive, store, organize, and transport products while supporting daily warehouse operations and preparing orders for customer delivery. Your work helps ensure inventory accuracy, operational efficiency, and the timely distribution of our products.

We're looking for reliable individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, take pride in delivering quality work, and are committed to maintaining a safe workplace while supporting their team.

Responsibilities

  • Receive, unload, and move products, pallets, and materials throughout warehouse and shipping areas.

  • Pick, pack, stage, and prepare customer orders according to established procedures and delivery schedules.

  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other warehouse equipment after successfully completing required training and certification.

  • Store and transport products using proper handling techniques while following inventory rotation and storage guidelines.

  • Confirm product quantities, labels, and shipment documentation to help maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Support inventory management by assisting with cycle counts, stock replenishment, and product organization.

  • Assemble, wrap, and prepare pallets to ensure products are secure and ready for shipment.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area by completing routine housekeeping and sanitation responsibilities.

  • Follow all company safety policies, food safety standards, and warehouse operating procedures.

  • Collaborate with warehouse associates, supervisors, and transportation teams to meet productivity, shipping, and customer service goals.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Available to work flexible schedules, including weekends, holidays, overtime, and varying shifts based on business needs.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, and pull warehouse materials throughout the workday.

  • Capable of standing, walking, bending, reaching, climbing, kneeling, and performing repetitive physical activities for extended periods.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

  • Previous experience in warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or material handling is preferred but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse duties throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in an environment with changing temperatures, moderate to high noise levels, and active warehouse equipment.

  • Safely operate material-handling equipment while complying with all workplace safety requirements.

Skills & Competencies

  • Safety-focused mindset

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Reliability and consistent attendance

  • Accurate product handling and inventory control

  • Effective time management and organization

  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities

  • Ability to perform efficiently in a fast-paced warehouse environment

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, relies on dedicated warehouse professionals to keep our supply chain moving. As a Distribution Center Associate, you'll play a key role in ensuring products are received, stored, prepared, and shipped accurately, helping deliver the quality snacks our customers expect while supporting safe and efficient warehouse operations.

Q: What is the difference between a Route Sales Representative and a warehouse role?

A: Route Sales Representatives visit stores, manage inventory, stock products, and maintain customer relationships. Warehouse employees focus on receiving, organizing, picking, packing, and preparing products for distribution.

Q: What kind of training do new Frito-Lay employees receive?

A: New employees typically receive on-the-job training specific to their position, including job procedures, safety requirements, equipment use, and performance expectations.

Q: How physically demanding are Frito-Lay production jobs?

A: Production and warehouse positions can be physically demanding and may involve prolonged standing, repetitive movements, lifting, bending, and working extended shifts. Employees are also expected to follow strict workplace safety procedures.

Q:How often do Frito-Lay employees get paid?
A: Most reviews indicate Frito-Lay pays weekly.

jobs.title: Building Security Supervisor - 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At the United Center, we bring excitement to life through sports, entertainment, and community. Home to the Chicago Bulls (NBA) and Chicago Blackhawks (NHL), we've welcomed over 70 million fans and host more than 200 events annually, from premier sporting events and concerts to family shows and special industry events. In the role as the Building Security Supervisor – Third Shift, you will help our team bring the next round of stories to life on the United Center campus.

Ready to take center stage?

The Building Security Supervisor – Third Shift will monitor Building Security Team Members working on a specific shift to ensure a safe environment for the United Center and all its Team Members.

3rd Shift Building Security Supervisor: 11PM-8AM

What You’ll Do

  • Supervise Security Officers, ensuring proper performance and compliance with duties and security procedures.
  • Monitor alarms, cameras, and conduct patrols to ensure staff adherence and security of the property.
  • Track time and attendance, address performance or attendance issues, and communicate key information to management.
  • Conduct pre-shift briefings, provide training to Security personnel, and oversee security across all United Center buildings.
  • Be available for overnight shifts and additional responsibilities as needed.

What You’ll Need

  • Ability to supervise security team members during assigned shifts.
  • Ability to read and interpret safety rules, manuals, and write reports. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Security programs.
  • Ability to solve problems, and handle situations with limited standardization.
  • One-year certificate from college or technical school, or 3–6 months related experience or training.
  • PERC Card certification, CPR & AED, and valid driver’s license.
  • Stand, walk, and sit up to 1/3 of the workday: Lift up to 10 pounds for up to 1/3 of the day.

The pay range for this role is $25.50 per hour. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. The total compensation package for this position may also include 401K retirement plan with company match, paid time off and commuter benefits. Additional perks include access to our state-of-the-art gym with free fitness classes, catered meals, fun events and free parking.

We are trusted by some of the most well-known companies and properties in the country while remaining dedicated to building personalized security solutions that solve the needs of every customer we support. Marksman Security LLC

Is Hiring Immediately for

Full Time Lobby Security Officer

jobs.company: University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
jobs.description:
MD Anderson Cancer Center is a leading institution focused on cancer care, research, education, and prevention. As a Public Safety Officer, you will help ensure a safe and welcoming environment so patients, families, and employees can focus on care, research, and education. Public Safety Officers are essential to maintaining security and supporting the mission of MD Anderson Cancer Center.

The ideal candidate will have a high school diploma or equivalent, one year of relevant work experience, and a valid Texas driver's license. Preferred qualifications include International Association for Healthcare Security and Safety (IAHSS) certification. Candidates should demonstrate strong communication skills, sound judgment under pressure, and a commitment to public safety.

Minimum $18.00 - Midpoint $20.54 - Maximum $23.08 per hour based on a 40-hour work week. This is a full-time position with rotating shifts that may include days, evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. The primary work location is the MD Anderson Cancer Center campus in the Texas Medical Center.

Why Us?

Join a mission-driven team where your work directly supports patient care and safety. MD Anderson offers competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth and specialized training in healthcare security.

  • Employer-paid medical coverage starting day one for employees working 30+ hours/week, plus optional group dental, vision, life, AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Accruals for PTO and Extended Illness Bank, plus paid holidays, wellness, childcare, and other leave options.
  • Tuition Assistance Program after six months of service and access to extensive wellness, fitness, and employee resource groups.
  • Defined-benefit pension through the Teachers Retirement System, voluntary retirement plans, and employer-paid life and reduced salary protection programs.

Responsibilities

  • Provide information, directions, and assistance to patients, visitors, and staff
  • Patrol campus by vehicle and on foot to monitor for suspicious activity and safety hazards
  • Enforce institutional and parking regulations; issue permits and citations as needed
  • Serve as a Campus Security Authority in compliance with the Clery Act
  • Respond to emergencies and maintain calm, professional judgment under pressure
  • Support institutional policies and ensure a safe environment for all individuals on campus

Education

  • Required: High School Diploma or Equivalent

Work Experience

  • Required: 1 year Relevant work experience.
  • Preferred: Customer interaction role.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Required: TDL - Texas Drivers License Valid and current Texas driver's license with a minimum of three year's history of verifiable driving history. With less than three years of driving history, but with a minimum of one year of driving history, a waiver may be requested. Upon Hire
  • Preferred: IAHSS - Certification As A Security Officer One or more levels of certification (Certified Healthcare Security Officer, Certified Advanced Healthcare Security Officer, or Certified Healthcare Security Supervisor) from the International Association for Healthcare Security & Safety Upon Hire

Other Requirements:

Must pass pre-employment skills test as required and administered by Human Resources.

The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center offers excellent benefits, including medical, dental, paid time off, retirement, tuition benefits, educational opportunities, and individual and team recognition.

Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Part Time Security Screener in New Braunfels, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Tech/Media/Telecom, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As a Screener in a dynamic technology, media, and telecommunications location, you will help maintain a welcoming, professional environment by screening visitors, monitoring access points, and reporting security-related concerns. Your visible presence and exceptional communication skills will help deter incidents while supporting a positive experience for everyone onsite. Join Allied Universal’s agile, reliable, and innovative team, where a caring culture, teamwork, and integrity guide every interaction.

Position Type: Part Time

 Pay Rate: $17.00 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeThur10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSat02:00 PM - 10:00 PM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to employees, visitors, and vendors at a technology, media, and telecommunications location by carrying out site-specific security-related procedures and access screening protocols.
  • Screen personnel, visitors, deliveries, and permitted items in accordance with site policies, escalating prohibited or suspicious items through established procedures.
  • Monitor entry points and credential presentation, maintain visitor records as required, and help to deter unauthorized access.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following emergency response activities and reporting requirements.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of designated screening areas, entrances, and the surrounding business perimeter; working environments and conditions may vary by location.

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.

  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. jobs.description:
Job Description and Responsibilities

Become part of one of the largest and fastest-growing privately held security companies in the U.S! Since 1998, Sunstates Security has built a national reputation for delivering exceptional services while fostering high-quality work environments for our team. We are dedicated to hiring, developing, and retaining a professional workforce that reflects our commitment to excellence.

We believe in strategic reinvestment in our people by offering a benefits package that exceeds industry standards, pathways for career advancement, extensive internal training, and employee recognition programs. Our team members are provided with the tools, knowledge, and hands-on management support necessary for long-term success.

Our commitment to a superior workplace culture is reflected in our most recent national accolades. Sunstates Security is proud to be recognized as a 2026 Forbes Dream Employer, an honor based on independent employee feedback and workplace excellence. Additionally, we have been named a 2026 Training MVP by Training Magazine, marking the third consecutive year we have accepted this prestigious recognition. We also continue to be celebrated for our steady growth and stability on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

At the heart of everything we do are our core values of honor, integrity, and trust. If you are searching for a rewarding career with a proactive security partner that protects some of the country’s leading organizations, we invite you to explore the possibilities at Sunstates Security. Join a successful, growing team where your talent is appreciated and have opportunities to advance your professional career.

HIRING IMMEDIATELY

Sunstates Security is hiring Flex Unarmed Security Officers in the Irving, TX area. All days and shifts are available! These positions offer a pay rate of $21.00/hr, with weekly pay. 



Job Requirements

Requirements:

  • Must have a valid Texas Level II Security License in hand.
  • Must have reliable transportation to and from work.
  • Must be available to work any shift, any days , including weekend and holidays.
  • A Flex position is on call.
  • Must have High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Must have good communication skills.
  • Good customer service skills and professional appearance.

Flex Officer Explanation

The Flex Officer position is crucial to our company’s operational and financial success. The flex officer provides trained, competent support by working shifts which become open due to illness, call-offs, weather, vacation, or other causes. This enables Sunstates to provide continual, uninterrupted service to our customers, while also protecting the health and work balance of our personnel.

Scheduling Expectations

The scheduling parameters and expectations for a flex officer are different from those of an employee assigned to a fixed post. As a flex:

  • You will be trained at various posts and /or facilities based on operational need. While you may work at a specific post or location for several weeks due to need, this will not be a permanent assignment.
  • Your schedule (shifts, days off, hours per week, etc.) will vary based on operational need.
  • You will be assigned to, or offered the opportunity to accept, shifts as they become available due to staffing needs.
  • Some of your shifts will be scheduled in advance and posted with the new week’s schedule. Sometimes you will be called with short notice and asked to come in to cover for someone who is unable to work their shift.
  • You are expected to work any shift for which you are scheduled in advance which falls within the availability described on this sheet. If you know you will be unavailable on an upcoming date or time that would normally fall within your availability described on this sheet, you must communicate this with your supervisor, so they know not to schedule you.

For short-notice call-ins, you are expected to work at least 80% of the shifts for which you are called. If you refuse more than 20% of shifts for which you are called in, this could negatively impact your employment status with the company.

A Security Officer may perform a multitude of duties as specified by the Post Orders and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). The Security Officer will read and become extremely knowledgeable of Post Orders and SOP and will be able to act quickly and efficiently according to such directives.



Benefits

Industry-leading employee benefits that include weekly pay, 401k savings plan with a company match, affordable medical, dental & vision benefits, employee referral bonuses, paid time off, premium holiday pay, tuition reimbursement, and more – available for qualified candidates!

jobs.title: Security Operations Performance Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview
We are seeking a confident, experienced, and dedicated professional to help lead and manage our Security Operations Department. The Security Operations Performance Coordinator (SOPC) will be assisting with the oversight and coordination of security operations and the scheduling of security personnel across various security post sites. Your proactive approach will help foster a secure environment, empowering our teams to operate confidently, effectively, and professionally. This role focuses on maintaining seamless staffing, security officer responsibilities, performance, regulatory compliance, and client relationships. ($46.5K - 55K+)

Key Responsibilities Include:

  • Relationship and Management: Cultivating strong relationships by serving as a primary interface with Senior Management, Scheduling Staff, security personnel, and clients.
  • Site Management: Conducting regular site visits, ensuring post sites are properly maintained, staffed, secured, and addressing security issues in a timely and appropriate manner. Documenting deficiencies noted during site visits and following up with Senior Management. Providing Senior Management and clients with documentation of corrective actions taken, reports, and follow-up measures.
  • Leadership and Management: Monitoring and analyzing security operations performance data to identify areas for improvement and implement strategic enhancements
  • Developing and maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ensuring compliance.
  • Making quality decisions, processing critical incidents, coordinating with onsite management and offsite response with security teams, facilities, emergency services, clients, and Senior Management.
  • Manage incident reporting processes, documenting events clearly and accurately for review and follow-up.
  • Personnel Accountability & Training: Ensuring security officers meet required performance standards, which involves:
  • Maintaining punctuality.
  • Adhering to uniform and gear requirements.
  • Completing scheduled tours.
  • Submitting accurate and detailed reports.
  • Enforcing consistent use and training on mobile applications for security personnel's time and attendance recording in the field.
  • Providing necessary or recurring training for security personnel.
  • Addressing security officer infractions/concerns and providing corrective and/or disciplinary measures.
  • Ensuring strict compliance with post orders, private security, federal, state, and municipal laws and regulations, retraining mandates, and licensing requirements.
  • Talent and Customer Management:Driving client satisfaction and retention by building a reliable team of qualified security personnel for assignments, maintaining standards, assuring compliance with policies and procedures, and proactively managing customer relationships.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in management and operations within security, law enforcement, military, or related industries is required, with a preference for candidates who have effectively and efficiently supervised and managed, leading by example.
  • Thorough comprehension of Texas private security statutes, in addition to federal, state, and municipal laws and regulations, is required.
  • Must have an active State of Texas Commissioned Security License (Level III) or higher, OC Spray Certification, and supervisor/management training.
  • A minimum of 3 years of proven experience in Client Relationships.
  • Associate's degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Emergency Management, or a related field (Bachelor’s degree preferred).
  • A high degree of self-motivation (self-starter), a proactive approach, and effective problem-solving abilities.
  • Required ability to adjust schedules regularly and work hours necessary to meet all operational demands.
  • The ability to maintain composure and professional conduct when interacting with executives, clients, staff, authorities, and the public.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to effectively multitask.
  • Able to speak and write English clearly to effectively communicate with the public, clients, and direct personnel.
  • Standard computer/technology proficiency (Microsoft Suites, Google Docs, etc.).
  • Must be 18 years of age or older, and have the legal right to work in the United States.
  • Must have and provide a clean driving record immediately upon hire.
  • Must be willing to participate in the Company’s pre-employment screening process, including drug screening and background investigation.
  • Have unwavering ethical standards and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

Pay: $46,500.00 - $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule
  • Paid time off
  • Referral program

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Warehouse Part Time Days
jobs.description:
Your Impact at Lowe’s

As a Receiver/Stocker, you help keep the store clean, safe, and ready for customers by accurately receiving freight, stocking shelves, and organizing merchandise and top stock. You’ll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success.

This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. And when a customer or teammate needs help, you’ll be there with a friendly, professional attitude.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe’s is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe’s associate, you’ll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Your Day at Lowe’s

You’ll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace. You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver SMART customer service by assisting customers, answering questions, and offering support during projects
  • Stock merchandise by unloading freight, down-stocking, organizing shelves, and setting up pallets
  • Support store operations by verifying deliveries, completing dock prep, and using equipment like pallet jacks and forklifts
  • Maintain a safe, clean environment by following proper procedures for hazardous materials, equipment use, and housekeeping
  • Operate store equipment including scanners, Zebra phones, balers, and other tools as needed
  • Pitch in as a team player to complete other assigned tasks

Additional responsibilities for Pro Fulfillment Stores include:
  • Use the Orders App to pick and stage Flatbed Delivery orders
  • Load delivery orders, ensuring quality, accuracy, and safe loading practices
  • Rotate orders by delivery date and resolve customer order issues
  • Proactively communicate with customers to ensure delivery satisfaction
  • Execute Delivery Readiness best practices

Minimum Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable

Preferred Qualifications
  • 3 months Experience operating forklift/power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment
  • 6 months Experience in a warehouse performing inventory handling and stocking

Lowe’s commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we actively seek and encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel, but occasional travel may be needed for meetings, training sessions, or to support nearby stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

About Lowe's

Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week, with total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion. Lowe’s employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

Pay Range: $17.05 - $17.85 per hour

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. For information regarding our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Associate Benefits (https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/joining-our-team)

We offer exceptional benefits and wellness programs for eligible full-time and part-time associates, tailored for many different lifestyles. Our benefits range from health, vision and dental insurance to paid vacation, tuition assistance and parental and family-building benefits. Plus, we offer learning and development opportunities to help our associates grow their skills and achieve their goals.

Overview

Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Part Time Unarmed Patrol Customer Relations in Fort Worth, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Manufacturing & Industrial, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer at a manufacturing and industrial location, you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, support access control activities, and provide exceptional customer service. Using clear communication and computer or tablet tools, you will help create a welcoming environment while reflecting Allied Universal's agile, reliable, innovative, caring, team-oriented, and integrity-driven values.

Position Type: Part Time

Pay Rate: $21.00 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTimeSat06:00 AM - 06:00 PMSun06:00 AM - 06:00 PM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to employees, visitors, contractors, and/or drivers while carrying out site-specific procedures and appropriate emergency response activities at an industrial manufacturing location.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of production areas, administrative spaces, parking areas, access points, and the facility perimeter to help identify unusual conditions and help deter unauthorized activity.
  • Monitor access control points, verify credentials as directed, and maintain accurate visitor, contractor, and vehicle entry records.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, documenting observations and notifying appropriate site contacts.
  • Report maintenance concerns, hazards, suspicious activity, and other security-related issues according to site procedures.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Access control and badge experience is preferred.
  • Comfortable using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.

  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only.

  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

POSITION SUMMARY INFORMATION: DUTIES AND REQUIREMENTS

Job Summary:

The Armed Security Guard is responsible for providing essential, high-level armed security services at an assigned U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Service (USCIS) government facility. This role involves maintaining a visible presence, controlling access, screening visitors, and responding to incidents in strict compliance with federal contract requirements and Agency Security Classification (ASC) procedures. Guards work on-site, typically as part of a two-person team.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Perform continuous access control duties, including screening visitors and personnel using walk-through magnetometers and hand-held detection wands.
  • Conduct regular facility checks, monitor surveillance systems, and ensure the overall security and integrity of the assigned USCIS site.
  • Respond promptly and appropriately to all security incidents, emergencies, and alarms according to established post orders and emergency response plans.
  • Accurately and thoroughly document all activities, incidents, and security breaches in daily and incident reports.
  • Provide professional and courteous service while enforcing security protocols for all agency personnel and visitors.
  • Maintain proficiency in the proper setup, calibration, and operation of all assigned security equipment, including screening devices.
  • Ensure personal compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, and all site-specific Post Orders.
  • Work effectively with the assigned partner guard and communicate clearly with the designated Regional Security Manager regarding any operational or personnel issues.

Required Education, Certifications, Licenses, and Experience:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English proficiently.
  • Must have minimum of two (2) years of armed, relevant security experience from a military, law enforcement, or commercial armed guard background.
  • Must legally own and possess a registered approved 9mm semiautomatic pistol or .45 ACP handgun.
  • Must possess and maintain an active State Security Guard License for the state of the assigned post.
  • Must possess and maintain an active State Firearms License (or equivalent permit/qualification) for the state of the assigned post.
  • Must maintain current firearm qualifications, first-aid/CPR certifications, and complete annual use-of-force training and de-escalation training consistent with federal, state, and local requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience in the operation, calibration, and maintenance of walk-through metal detectors (magnetometers) and hand-held detection wands.
  • Must be able to stand and patrol for extended periods and perform duties requiring physical exertion in response to security incidents.
  • Must successfully complete USCIS Office of Security and Integrity (OSI) suitability screening and background checks prior to assignment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for reporting and interaction with the public.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and reliable transportation to the assigned site.

Work Environment:

Employees may be exposed to extreme cold or hot weather conditions, fumes, or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, and loud noise.

Physical Requirements:

Employees may be required to remain in a stationary position, stand, push, pull, climb, kneel, crawl, balance, squat, bend, and reach during shifts. Employees may be also required to use gear to move items around, including, but not limited to, carts and dollies. Employees may also be occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 49 pounds.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Job Description:

The 2023 US Best Managed Company Award recognizes companies that outperform their competition in the four critical areas of management: strategic planning, effective execution, culture, and governance/financial performance. As a recipient of this accolade, Coke Florida has distinguished itself as a leader among U.S. private organizations.

What We Offer:

If you are a full-time employee at Coke Florida, you are eligible to enroll in our Total Rewards Program and take advantage of its many offerings:

  • The all-inclusive plans for wellness consist of medical, dental, and vision coverage that aims to provide complete health support to the employees
  • The employer-sponsored 401K plan includes a healthy company match, ensuring employees receive even higher returns on their contributions
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • The company provides its employees with 11 paid holidays and a vacation pay for three weeks annually
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • EAPs may offer a variety of services, including counseling, legal and financial advice, substance abuse treatment, and referrals to community resources
  • Competitive compensation

The Winter Haven Coke Florida site necessitates a Warehouse Lead, and we are hiring for the first shift.

What you will do:

The primary responsibility of a Coke Florida Warehouse Supervisor is to oversee the storage and shipping of materials.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Assumes responsibility for a group of 25-30 warehouse workers
  • Developing a team requires coaching, guiding, collaborating, and enhancing the abilities of those who work together
  • Administer the regular functions of the storage establishment
  • Arrange Warehouse Team Members to Meet Demands of Facility
  • Dedicate a section of your storage area for the proper rotation of goods
  • Assist with the regulation of inventory levels and mitigate the likelihood of product loss
  • Oversee the handling and storage of goods during transportation and upon arrival
  • Secure company assets
  • Adopting cost-cutting measures can help organizations manage labor and OPEX budgets effectively

Attention to detail is essential, as you will be dealing with important information and sensitive client data:

  • The minimum educational requirement for this position is either a high school diploma or its equivalent, the GED
  • This role requires a minimum of two years' relevant experience in the warehouse or distribution field
  • Experience in managing both human and financial resources is a must-have for this position
  • Employers require candidates to possess leadership skills and have at least two years' experience in a warehouse or distribution supervisor role
  • The skill to manage a manual or powered pallet jack proficiently is a fundamental necessity for all individuals responsible for transporting goods
  • You must have forklift certification before starting your job

Having a broad range of skills, knowledge, and experience can make you an invaluable addition to the team. Expanding your expertise in different areas, such as marketing, data analysis, or project management, can show that you are adaptable, flexible, and capable of handling various tasks and projects:

  • Advanced Excel experience
  • Familiarity with the efficient management of inventory systems and aptitude with SAP software preferred

The role requires a significant amount of physical effort, which means:

  • The talent to repeatedly raise, carry, and position bulky objects weighing up to 50 pounds without any help is mandatory
  • The position demands that the individual has the strength to push and pull items weighing no more than 50 pounds. The tasks should be executed while bending at the knees, kneeling, squatting, and reaching at different levels
  • The competency to use manual transport equipment (e.g. pallet jack or hand truck) to move product loads repeatedly for a distance of at least 100 yards without any assistance
  • The skill to repeatedly take hold of and operate objects that come in various sizes and weights that require deft finger movements and coordination between the hands and eyes
  • The capacity to sustain physical efforts for prolonged periods of time is a vital requirement for individuals who are involved in jobs that necessitate continuous manual labor
  • Flexibility in Reading Small, Medium, and Large Print
  • Demonstrating the ability to stand for a minimum of 8 hours while at work, and potentially extending up to 10 hours
  • The requirement to walk a minimum of 4 hours during the workday
  • Frequently perform tasks within an environment that is hot and humid indoors
  • The aptitude to equip an auditory aid to comprehend directions delivered in the English tongue

Other details:

  • Job Family: Warehouse
  • Job Function: Warehouse
  • Pay Type: Salary

Coke Florida may update this job description at any time and assign further duties and responsibilities as necessary.

The employee's ability to perform the essential job functions to satisfaction is a prerequisite to employment at Coke Florida. The company may offer reasonable accommodations to disabled employees to enable them to perform their job duties, provided it does not cause undue burden.

All applicants and employees are treated with respect, dignity, and consideration irrespective of their background or identity.

POSITION SUMMARY

Patrol all areas of the property; assist guests with room access. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions, perimeter alarm system, duress alarms, and fire life safety system. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Complete a Loss Prevention shift summary/daily activity report. Maintain confidentiality of all Security/Loss Prevention and property reports/documents; release information only to authorized individuals. Conduct investigations and gather evidence. Conduct interviews with relevant parties.

Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests' service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. jobs.description:
Job Description

California applicants: Please click here to review the Costco Applicant Privacy Notice.

The jobs listed are examples of the typical kinds of positions that Costco may hire for when openings exist. The listing does not mean that any positions are currently open or available at Costco.

Position Summary

Protects company assets from internal and external theft. Reviews individual warehouse inventory numbers and assists in creating / executing a plan of action to reduce shrink. Is familiar with various facets of operation that contribute to shrink and participates in instruction and training with affected employees. Observes and reports potential safety and security hazards. Investigates, detains suspects, completes reports, cooperates with local law enforcement, and testifies in court if necessary. Reports directly to the Warehouse Manager. Provides a high level of member service.

Job Duties

  • Walks the warehouse and perimeter up to 8 hours a day to monitor safety and security concerns. Pushes cart with merchandise and returns items to the floor. Maintains anonymity by shopping amongst members.
  • Follows and maintains knowledge of Costco procedures and applicable laws in performance of duties. Attends meetings and seminars regarding loss prevention.
  • Observes, detects, and investigates internal and external theft threats as well as safety concerns. Retrieves stolen items which shoplifters have concealed; may need to move product to access stolen items.
  • Detains and interviews shoplifters when warranted. Reports potential internal theft situations to the warehouse manager.
  • Prepares reports for internal use and for potential prosecution. Enters cases into case management system Nettrack.
  • Maintains evidence collected and reports files from investigations.
  • Testifies in court concerning theft investigations.
  • Communicates with other area Costco Loss Prevention Clerks and Security people of area businesses to exchange information about current, local theft threats.
  • Ensures proper cleanup and disposal of hazardous materials.
  • Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery.
  • Assists with department duties as necessary.
  • Assists in other departments of the warehouse as necessary.



For additional information about pay ranges, click here.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health benefits - medical/dental/vision/hearing aid/pharmacy/behavioral health/employee assistance, health care reimbursement account, dependent care assistance plan, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance, AD&D insurance, life insurance, 401(k), stock purchase plan to eligible employees.

Apart from any religious or disability considerations, open availability is needed to meet the needs of the business. If hired, you will be required to provide proof of authorization to work in the United States.
