jobs.description:
Grow with us...

Life at Starwood Hotels is based on a simple idea: the world is beautiful and we want to keep it that way. But we can’t do it alone. That’s why hiring thoughtful and inspiring Team Members and Leaders who understand that our people, collaboration, stellar service, and respect for nature are so important to us.

Main Duties

The Loss Prevention Officer is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment throughout the property by proactively identifying risks, enforcing safety and security policies, responding to incidents, and providing support to guests and team members. This role balances vigilance with hospitality, ensuring safety is upheld without compromising the guest experience.

General Duties

  • Patrol hotel property, both interior and exterior, to observe people, conditions, and activities, ensuring compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable laws.
  • Maintain fixed posts or conduct mobile patrols as assigned to monitor activity and prevent theft, vandalism, or unsafe behavior.
  • Enforce safety and security procedures to ensure a safe environment for guests, residents, visitors, and team members.
  • Monitor and control access to restricted areas, including back-of-house spaces.
  • Respond promptly to calls for service, assess situations, take appropriate action, and communicate status updates to management.
  • Perform crowd control and scene management during incidents, events, or emergencies.
  • Gather accurate and complete information related to incidents, accidents, or security concerns and prepare detailed reports.
  • Execute Lost & Found procedures in accordance with company standards.
  • Monitor employee and vendor access, report unauthorized access, and log vendors and visitors as required.
  • Escort guests, team members, and valuables as needed using the most efficient and discreet routes.
  • Respond to incidents involving disturbances, threats, or acts of violence in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.
  • Detain individuals when necessary and permitted, following established protocols.
  • Provide medical assistance, including First Aid, CPR, and AED use, within the scope of training until emergency responders arrive.
  • Maintain knowledge of the location and condition of emergency equipment and medical kits; report deficiencies promptly.
  • Assist with emergency evacuations and life safety procedures as required.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally via radio, phone, and in person, using proper radio etiquette and codes.
  • Maintain a professional, calm, and courteous demeanor at all times, regardless of external pressures.
  • Promote a positive guest experience while enforcing safety and security standards.
  • Look for opportunities to assist guests, colleagues, and other departments whenever possible.
  • Attend required training sessions and apply learned knowledge to daily operations.
  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; properly store flammable materials.
  • Ensure compliance with hotel policies, procedures, and standards with self and colleagues.
  • Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional.
  • Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information.
  • Embody the 1 Hotels Vision, Mission and Compass; deliver on Our Promise, provide Good-Natured Service and uphold our Brand Pillars.

Qualifications & Skills

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Prior experience in security, loss prevention, military, or law enforcement preferred.
  • Luxury hotel or resort experience strongly preferred.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • CPR, First Aid, and AED certification required (or ability to obtain).
  • Alcohol Awareness certification required (or ability to obtain).
  • Any required state or local security licenses must be obtained and maintained.
  • Must successfully complete company-required security training and annual assessments.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; additional languages a plus.
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to de-escalate situations calmly and professionally.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure in fast-paced environments.
  • Strong observation, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • High level of integrity, discretion, and confidentiality.
  • Proficiency with basic computer systems, security software, reporting tools, and mobile devices.

  • Ability to sit, kneel, bend, crouch, and climb stairs as required.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to respond quickly to emergencies and physically demanding situations.

Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.


Job Description

Warehouse Associates are accountable for accurately performing a combination of manual and automated tasks necessary for receipt, storage, transporting, picking, packing, shipping, staging, delivery etc. of product that may be hazardous, temperature sensitive, or of high value amid continuously demonstrating behaviors aligned with Abbvie’s attributes and values.

Responsibilities

  • Comply with all appropriate policies and procedures to successfully maintain training, safety, GxP, and governmental agency standards.
  • Ability to comprehend and accurately process paperwork in accordance with policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand.
  • Responsible for cross-training in multiple areas of the operation while maintaining a low level of quality mistakes.
  • Accurately receive and inspect inbound product/material for infestation, overages, shortages, and damages (OS&D).
  • Efficiently and correctly pick customer orders for shipment, ensuring that the correct number and type of product is picked.
  • Transfers and locates material/product to general storage areas or shipping locations.
  • Verify quantity, quality, labeling and address with the customer’s order to ensure outgoing shipments are complete and accurate.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED to ensure ability to accurately complete basic math calculations, read and understand training documents, product labeling and warehouse signage written in English.
  • Pass medical screening and background checks that may be conducted by local, state, and/or federal authorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

Andy Frain Services is on the lookout for a motivated and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager to play a key role in driving event operations across our premier Sports & Entertainment venues. You will primarily focus on Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this dynamic role, you will partner directly with the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead the security team, and ensure exceptional safety and experiences for fans, promoters, sponsors, and vendors.

Work Schedule Note: Flexibility is essential as this position involves a dynamic, event-driven schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the venue calendar.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Opportunities for leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader

Key Responsibilities

Event Operations & Venue Leadership

  • Act as the operational lead for smaller events and manage concurrent venue dates across Dallas.
  • Oversee event-day execution, ensuring that security requirements and client standards are met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and manage accurate post-event payroll and billing.
  • Serve as the primary lead in the Account Manager's absence.

Staffing, Onboarding & Development

  • Assist in the onboarding, training, scheduling, and management of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Conduct pre-event briefings for teams of varying sizes, from small groups to over 600 personnel.
  • Monitor monthly event metrics and assess staff performance indicators.
  • Coach and mentor supervisors and staff on personnel matters in accordance with company policy.

Logistics & Equipment Management

  • Oversee the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue equipment.
  • Prepare operational materials and documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of the operational needs.

Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations

  • Identify and address potential safety risks for guests and staff.
  • Regularly meet with venue clients to ensure security, emergency preparedness, and safety compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

jobs.via: via Women For Hire- Job Board
jobs.description:
Overview


Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.


Job Description


As a Security Officer Full Time Unarmed Patrol Clearance Required in Richardson, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Aero/Defense, and more. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer supporting an aerospace and defense location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and respond to security-related concerns. You will deliver exceptional customer service, communicate professionally, and support a caring culture built on teamwork and integrity. Join Allied Universal to contribute to an agile, reliable, and innovative team.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $19.16 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTime
Thur10:00 PM - 06:00 AM
Sat06:00 PM - 06:00 AM
Sun06:00 PM - 06:00 AM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to personnel, visitors, and vendors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities at an aerospace and defense location.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, access-control concerns, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following established site protocols.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of facilities, parking areas, access points, and perimeter locations to help identify and report unusual activity or conditions.
  • Monitor access to restricted areas, verify credentials as directed, and document visitor activity, incidents, and patrol observations.
  • Communicate professionally with site personnel and emergency responders, escalating security-related concerns through appropriate channels.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Possess at least 2 years of security-related experience.
  • Provide proof of a high school diploma or GED as required by the client.
  • Possess an active DoD Secret Clearance.
  • CPR certification is preferred.
  • Comfortably using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing


Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.title: Security Officer (Union) Mon- Fri 3pm-11pm
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Security Officer for ParkX Management ensures that the facility is run smoothly, safely, cleanly, and is a good experience for residents, tenants, and guests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete hourly patrol route of the property using the security system
  • Access control for guests, tenants and vendors
  • Ensure no property is being damaged
  • Conduct of routine foot patrols in and around building.
  • Perform other duties as assigned
  • Observation and reporting of safety
  • Issue Banning notices to rule violators
  • Maintain file for Ban Notices and notify management when necessary
  • Maintain the appearance of the two plaza kiosks
  • Enforce the “no dogs on the plaza” policy
  • Keep updated information (e.g., Kiss N Ride, Contact Phone #’s, Rules of Conduct) and communicate to guests as needed
  • Report any unknown work that is occurring at the property to management
  • If anyone parks illegally on the plaza, notify Park X, Commercial property management, and Residential property management immediately
  • Communicate to guests that we must keep the fire access areas accessible for fire trucks and ambulances
  • Close loading dock doors as needed
  • Report any concerns to management
  • Reston and Loudoun Station: Assist the Marketing team before, during, and after events as needed
  • Reston Station: Manage the valet; ensure that cars are not being parked on the plaza or on the down ramp
  • Reston Station: For Special event, ensure that the plaza marketing plan is followed
  • Reston Station: Manage traffic coming onto the plaza and keep it moving

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma
  • Must be certified security officer by the state of Virginia
  • Minimum of at least 1 year experience in customer-service related field
  • Valid driver's license without major violations
  • Flexibility to work after hours and weekends, as needed
  • Outgoing personality with ability to relate to diverse group of people and build/maintain strong relationships
  • Strong sense of urgency
  • Strong problem-solving, time management and communication skills
  • Must be highly credible and trustworthy, and operate with high degree of integrity
  • Must hold oneself and others accountable and strive for a high level of excellence
  • Must have a positive, can-do attitude and be able to fuel growth and innovation
  • Must be customer-focused and results-oriented
  • Must want to continuously learn and develop
  • Exceptional oral and written communication, active listening, and organizational skills
  • Ability to establish strong working relationships with others in team setting
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks with a strong attention to detail in a fast-paced environment
  • Self-directed and able to work independently, with minimal supervision

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • Required to stand for long periods and walk, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, bend, stretch, twist, and/or reach
  • Push, pull or lift up to 50 pounds
  • Continuous repetitive motions
  • Work under variable temperature conditions (or extreme heat or cold), under variable noise levels, outdoors/indoors, around fumes and/or hazards, around dust and/or mite hazards, around chemicals and bio-hazards

Benefits

Compensation:
Benefit Package: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K Match, Life Insurance

Career Development
- Opportunities for Advancement within our expanding portfolio
- Annual Professional Development Funds to fuel your growth

Employee Perks (to name a few):
- Free Parking and EV charging
- Parental Leave Program
- Enjoy a Friendly Work Environment that values collaboration

*Note benefits vary depending on the function of your role

The wage range listed for this position reflects a reasonable estimate and considers multiple factors that influence compensation decisions. These may include, but are not limited to, your skills, experience, training, licensure, certifications, and the specific needs of the organization. The posted range does not reflect adjustments for geographic differentials tied to where the role may be filled.

At Comstock, it is not typical for a new hire to start at or near the top of the posted range. Compensation is determined based on the unique circumstances of each candidate.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Any award under this program is subject to its rules and may depend on individual and organizational performance.

Virginia Compensation Range

$18 - $19USD

jobs.title: Event Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role
 Andy Frain Services is seeking a driven, detail-oriented Event Manager to assist in leading event operations across our premier Dallas-area Sports & Entertainment (S&E) venues with primary focus at Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this role, you will work directly alongside the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead front-line security personnel and supervisors, and deliver exceptional safety and guest experiences for every fan, promoter, sponsor, and vendor. Work Schedule Note: This position requires flexibility to work a dynamic, event-driven schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on venue calendars.

Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader
Key Responsibilities
 Event Operations & Venue Leadership
  • Serve as the operational lead for smaller events, Event Orders (EOs), and concurrent venue dates across Dallas locations.
  • Supervise event-day execution, ensuring client security needs and account standards are fully met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and coordinate accurate post-event payroll, time processing, and billing data.
  • Act as the primary lead or step in for the Account Manager in their absence.
Staffing, Onboarding & Development
  • Assist with the onboarding, training, scheduling, and distribution of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Deliver pre-event briefings and address large groups (ranging from small teams to 600+ personnel).
  • Evaluate monthly event metrics, staff performance, and employee performance indicators (call-offs, attendance, counseling notes).
  • Coach, mentor, and guide supervisors and staff through personnel issues in accordance with company policy.
Logistics & Equipment Management
  • Manage the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue radios, scanners, and ISS devices.
  • Prepare operational materials, shift rosters, and briefing documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit formal equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of operational needs.
Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations
  • Proactively identify and mitigate safety risks for guests, staff, and venue assets.
  • Meet regularly with venue clients to address security, emergency preparedness, and site safety protocols.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

jobs.title: Stock Inventory Associate
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

As a Fortune 50 company with over 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and a leader in American retail. Working at Target provides the opportunity to help families experience the joy of everyday life. We are deeply committed to supporting our communities, investing in the places we live, work, and play. Our team values relationships, fosters talent growth, and thrives together as one. At our core, we prioritize care, growth, and success together.

Roles and Duties:

  • Adhere to all safety policies and protocols to establish a safe work environment.
  • Engage in safety training programs to enhance your performance capabilities in a swiftly moving warehouse environment.
  • Handle the packaging, transportation, and distribution of goods for consumers and stores.
  • Ensure the meticulous management of products for retail fulfillment and customer drop-offs.
  • Ensure the smooth transportation of goods and effective inventory handling throughout the warehouse.
  • Make sure your workspace is clutter-free, organized, and clean at all times.
  • Timely attendance at work is crucial, along with accurately completing tasks as scheduled.
  • Work on addressing issues to foster continuous operational improvements.
  • Express a proactive and polite attitude when carrying out responsibilities independently or as a team member.

Requirements:

  • Able to frequently lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs.
  • Able to occasionally lift and carry items up to 60 lbs.
  • Proficiency in maintaining an upright position, navigating, applying force, dragging, crouching, flexing, and extending during working hours.
  • Sustain a positive and professional approach whether in a team or independent work setting.
  • Core math competencies that entail counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Competency in accurately comprehending and interpreting information found on labels, tickets, and other product-related documents.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in operating computer systems or handheld devices with minimal supervision following appropriate training.
  • Proficient in expressing thoughts verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to understand, converse in, and interpret English to follow safety guidelines, policies, and instructions effectively.

Additional Requirements:

  • Proficient in following instructions and utilizing powered machinery safely (e.g., Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit-Down & Stand-Up Forklift).
  • Experienced in working safely at heights of up to 40 feet whenever necessary.
  • Experienced in operating effectively in temperature-managed environments, such as refrigerators and freezers, over long periods.

Benefits:

Target team members may qualify for a comprehensive benefits package, subject to plan terms and employment eligibility. Employees also receive a 10% Target discount, plus an extra 20% off select wellness products, including fruits, vegetables, healthy foods, activewear, and tobacco cessation products.

Note:

Based on business needs and role requirements within Warehouse Operations, candidates may be considered for either a Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate position. The specific job responsibilities for each role are outlined in the application process.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

Andy Frain Services is on the lookout for a motivated and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager to play a key role in driving event operations across our premier Sports & Entertainment venues. You will primarily focus on Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this dynamic role, you will partner directly with the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead the security team, and ensure exceptional safety and experiences for fans, promoters, sponsors, and vendors.

Work Schedule Note: Flexibility is essential as this position involves a dynamic, event-driven schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the venue calendar.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Opportunities for leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader

Key Responsibilities

Event Operations & Venue Leadership

  • Act as the operational lead for smaller events and manage concurrent venue dates across Dallas.
  • Oversee event-day execution, ensuring that security requirements and client standards are met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and manage accurate post-event payroll and billing.
  • Serve as the primary lead in the Account Manager's absence.

Staffing, Onboarding & Development

  • Assist in the onboarding, training, scheduling, and management of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Conduct pre-event briefings for teams of varying sizes, from small groups to over 600 personnel.
  • Monitor monthly event metrics and assess staff performance indicators.
  • Coach and mentor supervisors and staff on personnel matters in accordance with company policy.

Logistics & Equipment Management

  • Oversee the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue equipment.
  • Prepare operational materials and documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of the operational needs.

Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations

  • Identify and address potential safety risks for guests and staff.
  • Regularly meet with venue clients to ensure security, emergency preparedness, and safety compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

jobs.description:
Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment

Alice & Wonder | Chicago, IL 60642
Starting at $17.50/hour

About the Role

Alice & Wonder is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Warehouse Associate to join our Chicago warehouse team.

This position is primarily responsible for picking, packing, tagging, and preparing merchandise for our retail stores and online customers.

We're looking for someone who works efficiently, pays attention to the little details, and enjoys being part of a fast-moving team. You'll spend your day working with our products—picking merchandise, tagging clothing, preparing store transfers, packing online orders, checking product quality, and making sure orders leave our warehouse accurately and looking great.

Accuracy and productivity are the two biggest priorities in this role.

What You'll Do

Picking, Packing & Store Fulfillment

  • Pick merchandise accurately for store transfers and customer orders
  • Scan, pack, and prepare inventory transfers for our retail locations
  • Verify styles, sizes, colors, and quantities before orders are completed
  • Keep orders organized throughout the fulfillment process
  • Help ensure stores receive the right merchandise on time

Online Order Fulfillment

  • Pick and pack online customer orders accurately and efficiently
  • Inspect merchandise before packing to ensure it meets our quality standards
  • Prepare packages for shipment
  • Make sure orders are neat, accurate, and presentation-ready
  • Gift-wrap customer orders when requested

Tagging & Product Preparation

  • Tag and label clothing, accessories, and other incoming merchandise
  • Prepare new merchandise so it is ready for our stores and customers
  • Organize product by style, size, or designated inventory location
  • Identify damaged, defective, or incorrect merchandise
  • Communicate product or inventory discrepancies to the Warehouse Lead

Warehouse Support

  • Help count and verify incoming merchandise
  • Assist with inventory counts as needed
  • Restock and organize picking and packing areas
  • Keep your workstation and surrounding warehouse areas clean and organized
  • Work closely with warehouse, shipping, retail, and other teams
  • Pitch in with other warehouse tasks when needed

What We're Looking For

You could be a great fit if you:

  • Are dependable and consistently show up on time
  • Have strong attention to detail
  • Can work quickly without sacrificing accuracy
  • Are organized and like keeping things in the right place
  • Are comfortable working on your feet throughout your shift
  • Can follow established processes and instructions
  • Work well independently and as part of a team
  • Are comfortable doing repetitive tasks such as picking, packing, folding, tagging, and labeling merchandise
  • Take pride in sending out an accurate, well-presented order
  • Bring a positive attitude and are willing to help wherever needed

Previous retail, warehouse, inventory, stockroom, picking/packing, or fulfillment experience is helpful, but not required. We're happy to train the right person who is dependable, motivated, and willing to learn.

Physical Requirements

This is an active warehouse position that requires standing and moving throughout the workday.

The position regularly requires:

  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Bending, reaching, and moving around warehouse work areas
  • Picking merchandise from inventory locations
  • Packing, folding, tagging, and handling merchandise throughout the day
  • Lifting and carrying boxes weighing up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation

What Success Looks Like

Get the orders right and get them done.

Our stores receive the correct merchandise. Online customers receive the correct orders. Clothing gets tagged properly. Product is checked before it leaves the warehouse. Orders are completed efficiently, accurately, and on time.

You're someone the team can depend on to consistently get the details right.

About Alice & Wonder

Alice & Wonder is a Chicago-based retail company offering fun, unique, and affordable apparel, accessories, gifts, and more.

We're a growing local business with a hardworking, team-oriented environment. We move quickly, help each other out, and believe you can get a lot done while still having fun at work.

We're looking for people who want to be part of the team and contribute to what we're building.

  • Fun, energetic work atmosphere
  • Team-oriented environment
  • Opportunity to learn different parts of a growing retail business
  • Employee growth opportunities

jobs.title: Public Safety Officer Part-Time
jobs.description:
Position Summary 


The Public Safety Officer reports to their assigned Commander-Supervisor. The Public Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of  Lake Forest College designated areas, or community. This role involves protecting students, staff, property, and resources by patrolling, monitoring, and enforcing policies and laws to maintain a secure environment.  


The primary purpose of the Public Safety Officer role is to ensure a safe environment, prevent unauthorized or illegal activities, and support the campus and community by upholding safety standards. This role helps foster a secure and welcoming environment for employees, residents, and visitors. 


The Public Safety Officer patrols assigned areas, responds to emergencies, and enforces rules and regulations. The officer works with the public to provide assistance and ensure a safe environment, upholding professional standards and collaborating with law enforcement as needed. 


Key Responsibilities 


●    Safety Patrols: Conduct routine patrols to deter, observe, and report incidents or safety hazards.


●    Emergency Response: Respond swiftly to emergencies, alarms, and accidents, providing first aid or coordinating with emergency services when necessary.


●    Access Control: Monitor and manage access points to prevent unauthorized entry and ensure security protocols are followed.


●    Incident Investigation: Conduct preliminary investigations, gather information, and report findings by following the chain of command: Commander/Supervisors and in extenuating circumstances notify the Public Safety Director.


●    Public Interaction: Assist and provide information to the public and support community outreach and education on safety practices.


●    Law Enforcement: Ability to communicate and team work with local organizations such as: fire department, police department, city officials and other relevant local authorities.


●    Record Keeping: Maintain accurate logs and reports on patrols, incidents, and daily activities.


●    Vehicle Upkeep:  Responsible for inspecting squad vehicles for each shift member. Ensure that trash is picked up, surfaces are wiped down, and any items left behind are removed. Vehicles will need to remain clean and in orderly conditions. Encourage officers to take pictures, if they observe non-compliance and to report it to the supervisor immediately.  


●    Follow proper vehicle/squad maintenance scheduling. Facilitate information to the Pub Safe accounts payable contact to search for proper billing / invoices / statements to process services payments.


●    Other tasks as assigned.


Working Conditions


●    This is a full-time, non-exempt position with a standard workweek of 32 hours.


●    Officers must be available to workday, evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts, as assigned, to support a 24/7 campus safety operation.


●    The position requires working both indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions, including inclement weather such as rain, snow, and extreme temperatures.


●    Duties may involve extended periods of standing, walking, patrolling on foot or in a vehicle, climbing stairs, and responding quickly to emergency situations.


●    Officers must maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all interactions with students, faculty, staff, and visitors.


Key Skills and Competencies


●    Communication Skills: Clear verbal and written communication abilities.


●    Observation Skills: Keen attention to detail for identifying suspicious activities or hazards.


●    Problem-Solving: Ability to assess situations quickly and make effective decisions under pressure.


●    Conflict Resolution: Skilled in de-escalating situations and managing confrontations calmly.


●    Physical Fitness: Capable of performing physically demanding tasks, such as patrolling, lifting, or restraining individuals.


Requirements


●    Education: High school diploma or equivalent; an associate degree preferred.


●    Coordination role experience prefferred.


●    Ability to collaborate with the team by stepping in to cover any shifts, when needed.


●    Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, GPS tracking, route planning tools, calendaring and internet navigation proficient.


●    Knowledge: Local/state transportation regulations and safety standards.


Physical Requirements


●    Mobility: Frequent walking, standing, and occasional running.


●    Strength: Ability to lift objects or assist individuals in distress.


●    Endurance: Maintain performance during long shifts and in various weather conditions.


Knowledge Requirements


●    Basic knowledge of relevant laws and legal procedures.


●    Safety Protocols: Familiarity with security and emergency response procedures.


●    First Aid and CPR: Knowledge of basic first aid and life-saving techniques.


Coordination and Cooperation Responsibilities


●    Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work with other departments for seamless security and emergency support.


●    Local Cooperation: Coordinate with law enforcement, fire departments, and emergency medical services when needed.


Record and Reporting Responsibilities


●    Detailed Reporting: Write accurate, comprehensive reports on daily activities, incidents, and investigations.


●    Data Management: Maintain security logs and records to support organizational transparency and accountability.


Preferred Qualities


●    Integrity: High ethical standards and reliability.


●    Dependability: Punctuality and accountability in fulfilling job duties.


●    Community Focused: A genuine commitment to public safety on campus and community well-being.


●    Calm Under Pressure: Stays composed in stressful or emergency situations.


Compensation and Benefits:


Part Time 24 hours per week


Hourly Rate of Pay $22.00 per hour


If you are interested in learning more about employment at Lake Forest College, please visit Working at Lake Forest | Lake Forest College.


Benefits information is located at: www.lakeforest.edu/offices-and-departments/human-resources/employee-benefits

jobs.title: Armed Security Officer- 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
As an S&C Electric team member, you’ll work on projects that have real-world impact. You’ll help transform the grid for resilient and reliable power worldwide. S&C has more than a 100-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee-owned since 2012. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively.

Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner!

Hours

4:00 pm – 12:30 am

    Compensation

    At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices. The estimated annual base salary range for this position is $49,040 - $61,300. Individual pay within this salary range is determined by several compensable factors, including performance, knowledge, job-related skills and experience, and relevant education or training. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual incentive plan (AIP), subject to eligibility criteria.

    Join Our Team as a Security Officer!

    S&C Electric Company is seeking a dynamic individual to coordinate our security function. As a Security Officer, you’ll be crucial in ensuring smooth operations and supporting our diverse team. Officers perform duties in three main categories, including patrolling the S&C Ridge Boulevard Industrial Campus facility, working in the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), and operating the security gatehouses.

    Key Responsibilities:

    • Utilize strong, written communication skills by creating clear and accurate incident and field activity reports in a timely manner.
    • Conduct and document events/ investigations with close attention to detail; gather and summarize statements and facts for records.
    • Perform routine and scheduled patrols of the S&C Campus to: regulate traffic and parking, ensure team member safety, respond to emergencies/incidents.
    • Act as first responders to critical and emergent situations including: medical emergencies, fires, hazardous material releases/spills, unauthorized personnel on campus, confined space rescues, severe weather, and building evacuations.
    • Certify and maintain required certification in the use of self-contained breathing apparatus and/or respirators.
    • Monitor fire, building supervisory, high-voltage supply, intrusion alarm, and closed-circuit video systems while assigned to the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC).
    • Monitor entry/exit and access to S&C Campus, with attention to detail for guiding team members, vehicles, visitors, and contractors. Maintain accurate logs and records of all commercial-related entrants.
    • Issue temporary identification badges and parking permits to authorized individuals.
    • Coordinate logistics of commercial deliveries and shipments from the GSOC.
    • Operate communication systems by serving as radio dispatchers and telephone switchboard operators during off-hours.
    • Directly identifying and addressing safety, trespassing and workplace violence concerns, which may include, but is not limited to, the detaining of threatening individuals for police resolution.
    • Safely remove unauthorized individuals from the campus using various de-escalation techniques.
    • Maintaining licensing and certifications for essential training and equipment necessary to perform job duties. (PERC, FOID, DL)
    • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
    • Attend in-person or virtual meetings as requested or required.
    • Communicate effectively and respectfully with others.
    • Drive a car or other vehicle.
    • Understand and comply with all applicable Company policies and rules.
      • Other responsibilities as assigned.

    What you’ll Need To Succeed:

    • High School diploma or acceptable General Educational Development (GED), some college preferred.
    • Illinois Driver’s License and Illinois Firearms Owner’s Identification Card.
    • Good verbal and written communication skills; proficiency with personal computers.
    • State of Illinois Security Officer 40-Hour Training Program for armed security
    • A Permanent Employee Registration Card (PERC) and ability to successfully obtain the Firearm Authorization Card (FAC) issued from the State of Illinois, Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.
    • 4 years of security or related background. Industrial security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills
    • Strong computer and technological skills
    • Conflict resolution skills
    • De-escalation and high stress management skills
    • Understanding laws and regulations pertaining to armed security work
      • Understanding signals of distress or impairment in others

    Preferred:

    • Associates Degree in Security, Criminal Justice, Law Enforcement, or related field.
    • Any advanced National Incident Management System (NIMS) training.
    • Handcuffing certification.
      • De-escalation training i.e., Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI) or Crisis Intervention (CIT) Training certifications

    Major Physical Demands:

    • Frequently required to stand and perform tasks for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.
    • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position and perform desk-based for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.
    • Frequently required to walk moderate distances up to [1-2 miles on campus while patrolling] [frequency – e.g., multiple times each day]
    • Occasionally required to solo lift and/or carry items ranging in weight from 5 to 40 lb, and team lift and carry items or other team members to safety, exercising sound judgment to employ manual handling or machine lifts where required and risk assessments, if appropriate.
    • Occasionally required to position self to perform tasks involving but not limited to reaching, twisting, rotating, and pushing/pulling.
    • Occasionally required to use hand-eye coordination to control both hands and arms for a full range of motion to operate equipment/machinery/power tools/office productivity equipment.
    • Frequently ascending or descending ladders/stairs/scaffolding/ramps/poles.
    • Frequently required to observe details at close range, including depth perception, peripheral vision, and the ability to differentiate between colors.
    • Continuously required to talk and hear in person and by phone/conference calls.
      • Frequently required to travel (up to 10%) and work extended hours when necessary.

All employees and applicants will be considered without regard to age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation to complete the application, please email us at TAsupport@sandc.com .

jobs.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic team as a Package Handler and become an essential part of our fast-paced warehouse operations! In this energetic role, you will be responsible for efficiently handling, loading, unloading, and organizing packages to ensure timely delivery and smooth logistics flow. Your proactive approach and attention to detail will help maintain safety standards and optimize warehouse productivity. This paid position offers a fantastic opportunity to develop your skills in warehouse distribution, heavy equipment operation, and inventory management while contributing to a thriving logistics environment.

Duties

  • Safely load and unload packages using appropriate equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, clamp trucks, and RF scanners
  • Accurately pick, pack, and prepare orders for shipment following specified procedures
  • Operate heavy equipment including cranes and material handling equipment to move large or heavy items efficiently
  • Maintain organized storage areas by stacking pallets and managing inventory with precision using inventory management systems
  • Follow safety protocols in accordance with OSHA regulations to prevent accidents and ensure a secure working environment
  • Assist with shipping and receiving tasks, verifying shipments against documentation and inspecting packages for damage or discrepancies
  • Support warehouse operations by performing manual handling tasks such as heavy lifting and load & unload activities

Requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to operate material handling equipment including forklifts, clamp trucks, pallet jacks, and cranes; certifications are a plus
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, shipping & receiving procedures, and materials handling techniques
  • Basic math skills for counting, measuring, and verifying quantities accurately
  • Experience with RF scanners or other warehouse technology tools is advantageous
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks involving heavy lifting safely and efficiently
  • Knowledge of safety protocols aligned with OSHA standards to promote a safe work environment
  • Warehouse experience or supervisor experience is beneficial for growth opportunities in the role

jobs.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic warehouse team as a Forklift Operator and Warehouse Worker, where you'll play a vital role in maintaining efficient warehouse operations. This energetic position offers the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art equipment, support inventory management, and ensure the safe handling of materials. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about safety and precision, this is your chance to contribute to a thriving logistics operation that values your skills and dedication.

Responsibilities

  • Operate various types of material handling equipment including forklifts, reach trucks, Hi-Lo, clamp trucks, pallet jacks, and barcode scanners to load, unload, and move products safely and efficiently.
  • Perform order picking using manual methods or order picker equipment to fulfill customer orders accurately and promptly.
  • Manage inventory by conducting regular stock counts, updating warehouse management systems (WMS), and ensuring proper storage of materials.
  • Assist with shipping and receiving tasks by verifying shipments against documentation, preparing goods for dispatch, and maintaining accurate inbound/outbound logs.
  • Conduct routine equipment inspections and perform basic repairs or coordinate maintenance to ensure all machinery operates safely according to OSHA standards.
  • Follow warehouse safety protocols including OSHA regulations, forklift safety standards, manual handling procedures, and heavy equipment operation guidelines to prevent accidents.
  • Support warehouse distribution activities by organizing storage areas, optimizing space utilization, and ensuring compliance with safety standards in production environments.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience operating forklifts (including reach trucks, Hi-Lo, clamp trucks) and other material handling equipment such as pallet jacks and lift trucks.
  • Strong understanding of warehouse management systems (WMS), barcode scanning for logistics, shipping & receiving procedures, and inventory management practices.
  • Knowledge of warehouse safety standards including OSHA regulations related to forklift operation, manual handling, heavy lifting, and general warehouse safety protocols.
  • Ability to perform heavy lifting consistently while adhering to manual handling best practices.
  • Basic math skills for inventory counts and order accuracy verification.
  • Prior experience in warehouse operations or distribution centers is highly preferred; warehouse supervisor experience is a plus.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational skills for managing multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Join us in creating a safe, efficient, and energetic workplace where your skills make a real difference!

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Guard Full Time Unarmed Patrol Observer in Houston, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Government, and more. As an unarmed Patrol Officer at a government location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and support a welcoming environment for employees and visitors. You will provide exceptional customer service, communicate clearly, and respond to security-related concerns with professionalism. Join Allied Universal’s agile, reliable, innovative team, where a caring culture, teamwork, and integrity put people first.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $16.38 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon10:00 AM - 06:00 PMTue12:00 PM - 08:00 PMWed10:00 AM - 06:00 PMThur10:00 AM - 06:00 PM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to visitors, employees, and members of the public at a government location by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Respond to incidents, public concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, notifying appropriate site contacts and/or emergency services as directed.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of government buildings, grounds, parking areas, and perimeter locations to help to deter unauthorized activity and report observed hazards or irregular conditions.
  • Monitor access points and visitor activity, verify authorization as required by site procedures, and maintain accurate activity, incident, and patrol documentation.
  • Support a professional and orderly environment by providing directions, assisting with public-facing inquiries, and following established protocols for government operations.

Minimum Requirements

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. jobs.description:
At Graphic Packaging International, we produce the paper cup that held your coffee this morning, the basket that transported those bottles of craft beer you enjoyed last weekend, and the microwave tray that heated your gourmet meal last night. We’re one of the largest manufacturers of paperboard and paper-based packaging for some of the world’s most recognized brands of food, beverage, foodservice, household, personal care and pet products. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, we are collaborative, diverse, innovative individuals who create inspired packaging while giving back to our communities.

With over 25,000 employees working in more than 130 locations worldwide, we strive to be environmentally responsible in our industry and in the communities where we operate. We are committed to workplace diversity and offer compensation and benefits programs that are among the industry’s best to reward the talented people who make our company successful.

If this sounds like something you would like to be a part of, we’d love to hear from you.

A World of Difference. Made Possible.

OPPORTUNITY: We are a Food service folding carton manufacturing operation seeking candidates to join our Chicago IL team. We’re recruiting for multiple positions so be sure you review all of our job postings. This job posting is for a Shipping – Receiving associate with a pay range of $21.91 to $25.36 /hour plus shift differential and progressive pay increases. We continually encourage our employees to advance their careers through on the job training and job progression through our strong promotion from within program. We offer a wide array of benefits including, but not limited to, Paid Vacation & Holidays, optional Health, Dental, and Life Insurance, including health spending accounts and a progressive healthy lifestyle program, as well as 401-K with a company matching component and standard supplemental company contributions. Employees may voluntarily elect Pet Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance Programs, Purchasing Power, Tuition Reimbursement, Aflac, Lifelock Identity Protection, and Hyatt Legal Services. Tobacco Cessation and Employee Assistance/Referral Program, Uniform Service, Safety Shoe, and Safety Prescription-Eyewear benefits are also available.

JOB SUMMARY: The person who occupies this position is responsible for shipping, receiving coordinating traffic, warehousing inventories, communications and producing product and any other items as they relate to shipping out of or being received into the plant and warehouse locations.

JOB FUNCTIONS: Job functions include, but are not limited to the following.

A shipping material handler will spend approximately 70% of working shift on a forklift and 30% doing other shipping duties.

  • Know, understand and follow all plant and department safety requirements.
  • Maintain a safe and clean environment inside and outside of the facility.
  • Maintain equipment and do all required safety checks and cleanings as required.
  • Wrap loads and insure quality standards and checks are being completed this is insuring packing, wrapping, labeling and information is correct on outbound shipment of product.
  • Ship and Receive all product in and out of the plant location.
  • Insure all manifests, invoices, orders, shipping documentation, and forms are accurate.
  • Examine documents to insure outbound and incoming contents are accurate with paperwork of the shipment.
  • Prepare documents such as work orders, bills of ladings, packing slips and shipping orders.
  • Shuttle product from the facility to outside warehousing as need with accurate billing and documentation for accurate inventories.
  • Record shipping data such as damages, rejected trailers, discrepancies for reporting, accounting and recordkeeping purposes.
  • Determine shipping methods and procedures for safe shipment based on the material using shipping knowledge and procedures.
  • Deliver or rout incoming material or equipment to the appropriate departments.
  • Confer and correspond with representatives to rectify problems such as shortage of material, late trucks, quality issues and nonconformance to specifications. This will include but is not limited to the warehouse, other shifts, production departments, corporate transportation, quality departments, safety manager or any supervision of the plant.
  • Communicating with Supervisors, Peers and Subordinates to insure all issues are communicated properly.
  • Store, maintain and monitor shipping materials and supplies used for shipping.
  • Contact corporate shipping (TMS) or supervision when needed to insure scheduled inbound and outbound reach their destinations as scheduled to meet the needs of the customer and our facilities.
  • Compute weights and pallet amounts to insure trailers are loaded properly and not detained over the road.
  • Load product on shipments and shuttles to insure scheduled load times are being met by our facility and the warehouse along with scheduled delivery time of product.
  • Process customer returns and validate all incoming product.
  • Use, know and understand all computer programs and technical skills used at the facility in the shipping and inventory function.
  • Pull PO from file, sign and verify physical delivery of goods.
  • Pull packing slip from goods and validate receipt.
  • Audit packing slip against PO to determine if delivery received is complete
  • Unpack deliveries; verify product received against PO item and quantity. Receive items in SAP. Pull PO (or reprint) and assemble w/packing slip for GR for 3-way filing.
  • Process chemical deliveries consist with established protocol.
  • Act as the backup for all plant subcontracting.
  • Backfill material handler position (breaks, lunches, vacations etc.)

Background / Experience / Skills

  • Manufacturing experience preferred
  • Must have physical coordination to operate forklift.

Description

Cargo Physical Security Specialist – Aviation Security Company

ORD International Airport- Chicago, IL

Global Elite Group- Providing world-class aviation security through innovation and people committed to excellence.

Our unarmed security officers are in the forefront of homeland security, safeguarding infrastructure and ensuring seamless and secure operations in many of the largest and busiest airports in the country.

Connect with a specialized recruiter today and learn how you can join the team that is setting the standard for ensuring seamless and secure operations in the physical cargo security sector with unmatched quality and attention to detail.

Global is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Benefits :

  • $25.00 per hour - flexible per diem/part time schedule – possibility for periods with full time hours with open availability
  • Paid training - opportunity to become a subject matter expert within a world class internationally recognized training program in a federally regulated industry
  • Excellent opportunity for retired or former law enforcement or military

The successful candidate will be:

  • Security minded
  • Able to communicate effectively with colleagues, clients, and other airport employees

Position Overview:

A Cargo Physical Security Specialist focuses on safeguarding cargo during transport, storage, and handling. Their responsibilities typically include:

Monitoring, Surveillance, and Risk Assessment

  • Evaluate and take measures to mitigate risks to cargo security, such as theft, tampering, or loss.
  • Oversee cargo loading, unloading, and transit to ensure compliance with security standards.
  • Use technology and systems to monitor cargo movements.
  • Identify and respond to suspicious activities or breaches.
  • Follow all security protocols tailored to the client's needs and the environment.

Incident Management and Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to industry regulations (e.g., TSA, Customs, and Border Protection standards).
  • Maintain records of incidents, audits, and compliance measures.
  • Respond to security incidents, such as theft, vandalism, or loss of cargo.
  • Leverage training and experience to effectively manage and address all situations encountered during duty.

Collaboration and Coordination

  • Provide timely updates on movements, potential or actual risks, and incidents to the GEG Special Operations Command Center and client partner as needed.
  • Work with logistics teams, customs officials, and transport companies to ensure secure operations.
  • Liaise with regulatory agencies to stay updated on security guidelines and threats.
Qualifications

Qualifications :

  • Must be at least 21 years old

  • Must have a valid State Security License

jobs.description:
Yard & Warehouse Laborer – Tire Recycling

K&S Tire Recycling is hiring dependable, hardworking individuals to join our yard and warehouse team in Chicago Heights, IL.

This is a hands-on, physically demanding position for someone who is comfortable working in an industrial environment and wants steady work with an established, growing company.

What You’ll Do

As a Yard & Warehouse Laborer, you will help keep tires and other recyclable materials moving safely and efficiently throughout our facility.

Daily Responsibilities Include

  • Load and unload tires from trucks, trailers, and containers
  • Move tires by hand and with hand trucks/dollies
  • Sort, stack, organize, and stage tires
  • Grade and inspect used tires based on condition and quality
  • Move and sort other scrap and recyclable materials
  • Maintain organized tire and material storage areas
  • Assist with general warehouse and yard operations
  • Perform general cleanup and housekeeping throughout the facility
  • Work safely around forklifts, loaders, trucks, conveyors, and other moving industrial machinery
  • Follow company safety procedures and supervisor instructions
  • Perform other general labor duties as needed

Requirements

Physical Requirements

This is an active, physical job. Applicants must be able to:

  • Regularly lift, carry, push, and move materials weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Handle and move tires repeatedly throughout the workday
  • Stand, walk, bend, reach, push, pull, and lift for extended periods
  • Work both indoors and outdoors
  • Work in varying temperatures and weather conditions
  • Work safely in an active industrial environment around moving vehicles and machinery

What We’re Looking For

We Are Looking For People Who

  • Are dependable and show up to work on time
  • Are willing and able to perform physical labor throughout the shift
  • Have a strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Can follow directions and safety procedures
  • Work well as part of a team
  • Take pride in keeping their work area clean and organized
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-paced industrial environment

Minimum 1 year warehouse, tire, recycling, automotive, construction, landscaping, manufacturing, or general labor experience is required.

Benefits

Why Work With K&S Tire Recycling?

K&S Tire Recycling is a growing tire recycling company serving customers throughout the Midwest. Our operation keeps millions of pounds of tires and recyclable materials out of landfills and puts those materials back to productive use.

We value employees who are reliable, safety-conscious, hardworking, and willing to learn.

We offer accrued sick/vacation time.

We have 1st and 2nd shift positions available.

Compensation is $16-$18 per Hour USD

Find your future at Fastenal! Our distribution center is hiring energetic, team oriented individuals to work in our fast pace warehouse! Fastenal Company is committed to environmental protection and to providing a safe and healthy workplace for all employees. We strive to integrate EHS & Sustainability considerations into all our business decisions, plans, and operations. Working as Full-time Customer Site Warehouse Support, you will facilitate the movement of product through our customer site. This is an entry-level position based out of our branch located at 1800 W Devon Ave, Chicago, IL 60660.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
The duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:
o Operating computer programs and wireless hand held devices

If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and are looking to make your mark as part of an elite growth company, you won't find a better fit than Fastenal.

Job Summary

We are seeking a vigilant and dedicated Unarmed Security Officer to uphold safety and security across our premises. In this dynamic role, you will be the first line of defense, ensuring a secure environment through proactive surveillance, access control, and customer service. Your presence will help maintain order, prevent incidents, and foster a safe atmosphere for staff, visitors, and property. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your security expertise while contributing to a safe community.

Duties

  • Monitor surveillance systems such as CCTV to detect suspicious activity and ensure property security.
  • Conduct regular patrols of the premises, including buildings, parking lots, and restricted areas to identify potential security threats.
  • Control access points using access control systems, verifying identities and authorizations of employees, visitors, and contractors.
  • Respond promptly to emergency situations following established procedures, including fire alarms or medical emergencies.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security breaches, accidents, or unusual occurrences for record-keeping and future reference.
  • Perform background checks on new personnel or visitors as part of security screening processes.
  • Assist with conflict de-escalation and conflict management to maintain a peaceful environment while adhering to security regulations.

Skills

  • Strong surveillance skills with experience operating CCTV and other monitoring equipment.
  • Knowledge of law enforcement procedures and emergency response protocols.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks safely, including heavy lifting when necessary.
  • Excellent customer service skills with a professional demeanor when interacting with the public.
  • Proficiency in incident report writing with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Familiarity with security tools such as Taser devices (non-lethal), AEDs (Automated External Defibrillators), and fire extinguishers.
  • Understanding of physical security measures including patrolling techniques and access control systems.
  • Ability to perform first aid procedures including CPR and AED operation confidently.
  • Experience in performing background checks and ensuring compliance with security regulations.
  • Strong conflict de-escalation skills combined with effective communication for conflict management situations.

Join us as a Unarmed Security Officer and become an integral part of maintaining a safe, secure environment where safety is our top priority!

Embark on this seasonal journey where your expertise makes a real difference! We value energetic professionals committed to safety and community well-being. Join us in creating a secure environment that allows everyone to enjoy the festivities confidently.

jobs.title: Warehouse Assistant 2 - Seasonal
jobs.description:
Position Overview | The Big Picture

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for moving, storing, covering, and preparing props and furniture for warehouse storage or into bins for delivery. The Warehouse Assistant reports to the Warehouse Manager and may take direction from the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Warehouse Lead.


Our Mission Values | Our Commitments

Each employee works together to strive to create the best design company by improving communication, showing genuine care for each other and the company, focusing on delivering quality, and demonstrating professionalism through personal excellence, with a shared passion, dedication, and commitment to providing exceptional value to our clients.

Traits for Success | #hardworker
  • Safety-minded
  • Team player.
  • Great Listener.
  • Steady worker.
  • Good with hands.


Essential Duties | What You’ll Do – The Fun Stuff

  • Learns inventory and pull sheets to successfully fill event orders.
  • Prepares props and furniture for events to include but not limited to: wrapping fabric and vinyl, drilling holes, nailing, hammering, hand and spray painting, polishing, cleaning and staining.
  • Wraps furniture and props for delivery; unwraps inventory as needed.
  • Cleans and sweeps work space to ensure workspace is organized, safe and free from obstacles and debris.
  • Warehouse Assistant levels 2 and 3 perform increasingly more complex and detailed prop and warehouse work and require less supervision.

Other Duties and Safety Requirements | There’s More!
  • Complies with all department and company safety guidelines, procedures, and rules.
  • Mentors safe work practices to co-workers and team.
  • Completes all safety training as directed and within established timelines.
  • Interfaces professionally with all people, internal and external, in a kind and respectful manner.
  • Tracks and enters time and assigns hours and tasks to appropriate events and jobs in time and attendance system.
  • Completes all Human Resources and Payroll tasks and notifications through the Employee Self Service Online Portal on a weekly basis, as directed and within established timelines.
  • Assists in other departments as needed and directed.
  • May perform other duties as required.

Qualifications | What You Need to Bring
  • Ability to understand, read and speak simple English.
  • Good verbal communication skills to communicate successfully with the Warehouse team.
  • Ability to interpret pull sheets.
  • Familiarity with proper packing methods is helpful.
  • Must be able to provide the following tools for use during the work shift: wire cutter and utility knife.
  • Good knowledge and ability to use tools and equipment that may include: hammer, screwdriver, hand drill, tape measure, dollies, and 8 foot and 12 foot ladders.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules to include evenings and weekends.

Physical and Work Environment Requirements | What it is Like in the Shop
  • Ability to stand, kneel, crouch, bend and reach during entire work shift.
  • Able to walk 30% of the work shift.
  • Ability to work with hands and arms during entire shift.
  • Must be able to move and climb ladders without accommodation.
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push and pull 30-40 lbs. throughout the shift. Occasionally may move up to and over 100 lbs. with assistance.
  • Ability to handle fragile items safely.
  • Must have 20/20 vision with correction.
  • Must be able to tolerate cold, heat and humid conditions.
  • May be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, and chemicals throughout the work shift.
  • Ability to tolerate moderate noise.


Pay & Benefits | What You’ll Receive

  • Hourly wage: $18.00 to $22.00 based on experience.
  • Overtime pay will be provided for hours worked beyond 40 in a workweek at 1.5x the regular rate of pay, in compliance with Illinois labor laws.
  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options available full-time.
  • Retirement Plan: 401(k) plan with company matching.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): In compliance with Illinois State Law.
  • Training & Development: Opportunities for skill development and career advancement.

Other Benefits

  • Flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend availability.
  • Safe and supportive work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:
Kehoe Designs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description:
Entry-Level Security Officer – Training ProvidedJob Description

ORN Security Solutions is looking for dependable people who are interested in starting a career in the private security industry.

No previous security experience is required.

In fact, we're specifically interested in people who are willing to learn. If you've thought about working in security but didn't know how to get started, this may be a good opportunity to get your foot in the door.

This is an entry-level position starting at $14.00 per hour. Both full-time and part-time schedules are available.

We want to be upfront about the starting wage. We're looking for people who want an opportunity to learn the profession, gain real-world experience, and potentially advance into positions with greater responsibility as they gain experience and additional licensing.

What You'll Do

This is a professional security position. Depending on your assigned shift, responsibilities may include:

  • Monitoring entrances and access points
  • Observing activity on the property
  • Conducting routine foot or property patrols as assigned
  • Helping maintain a safe and orderly environment
  • Professionally interacting with employees, visitors and members of the public
  • Identifying and reporting unusual or suspicious activity
  • Completing basic written activity and incident reports when necessary
  • Following site procedures and instructions
  • Contacting supervisors or emergency services when appropriate

This is not a law-enforcement position. We emphasize observation, professionalism, communication, documentation and good judgment.

What We're Looking For

Experience isn't our biggest concern. Reliability is.

We're looking for people who:

  • Show up when they're scheduled
  • Arrive on time
  • Have reliable transportation
  • Can communicate professionally
  • Can remain alert and attentive during a shift
  • Are comfortable working independently
  • Can follow instructions and established procedures
  • Are willing to learn
  • Take pride in their appearance and professionalism
  • Can meet the requirements to work legally in the Texas private security industry

New to Security? That's Okay.

Everybody in this industry started somewhere.

We're a locally owned DFW security company, and we're willing to work with the right people who have the attitude and reliability we're looking for.

We'll help you understand the job, learn professional security practices, and gain actual experience in the field. For employees interested in making security a career, there may also be opportunities to pursue additional training, licensing and greater responsibility as our company grows.

We would rather find a dependable person with the right attitude and teach them than hire someone with years of experience who doesn't take the job seriously.

Position Details

Pay: $14.00 per hour
Job Types: Full-time and Part-time
Location: Dallas, Texas
Experience: No previous security experience required

About ORN Security Solutions

ORN Security Solutions is a locally owned Dallas-Fort Worth security company providing professional security and patrol services throughout the area.

We believe good security starts with dependable people, professional conduct and doing the job the right way.

If you're looking for an opportunity to enter the security profession and you're willing to show up, learn and work, we'd like to hear from you.

ORN Security Solutions
Defend. Deter. Deliver.

What You Will Do

Under general supervision and according to established policies and procedures, provides unarmed uniformed security/safety related services. The services performed support the department’s mission to provide high quality service and to protect persons and property from harm. May also perform duties of bicycle patrol officer.

  • Patrols assigned areas of facilities and grounds on foot or in motorized vehicle according to established schedule and investigates unusual occurrences.
  • Reports incidents or apparent potential loss of Hospital, employee, patient or visitor property through fire, theft or vandalism and if necessary, involve police and provide assistance during police investigation.
  • Responds to all service calls in a timely, safe, professional and courteous manner.
  • Welcomes our customers to the Hospital. Provides timely and accurate directions to patients and visitors to insure they understand how to get to any location on Hospital Grounds. Whenever possible, help individual(s) with escort to their destination.
  • Directs vehicle traffic in and around hospital facilities to prevent congestion. Ensures areas such as loading docks and ambulance unloading zones are cleared of unauthorized vehicles at all times. Issues parking citations to improperly parked vehicles and maintains record of citations.
  • Following established procedures, physically restrains unruly patients and/or visitors and individuals posing a threat to themselves, visitors, hospital employees and/or property and if necessary, involves police in removing visitors and provides assistance including court testimony.
  • Administers appropriate control systems to protect patient and employee valuables and hospital equipment and supplies, and monitors handling of lost and found items.
  • Checks to ensure hospital doors and windows are securely locked and inspects equipment, alarms, fire extinguisher and other equipment to ensure same are properly working. Notifies appropriate personnel of problems, as necessary.
  • Investigates and documents thefts, accidents and other incidents in order to obtain related evidence necessary to determine individuals involved. Carefully prepares required documentation to insure neatness, accuracy and completeness.
