jobs.title: Warehouse Loader
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Target believes in fostering healthy and collaborative relationships, which aids its success as a team. The company's core purpose is reflected in its values, which guide its operations and underline how it functions, cares, grows, and succeeds.

Roles and Duties:

  • Respect and observe all safety regulations and policies to foster a safe and secure working environment for everyone.
  • Enhance your safety skills by attending safety training seminars that offer training on how to work safely in a rapid-paced warehouse setting.
  • Help ensure customer satisfaction and timely delivery by packing, loading, and shipping merchandise to retail stores and guests.
  • Ensure correct processing of merchandise at all times to ensure prompt dispatch to our stores and shoppers.
  • Perform warehouse tasks expeditiously and without endangering the safety of yourself or others while handling freight and inventory.
  • A well-organized workspace can help improve your work-life balance and enhance overall job satisfaction.
  • Be punctual in reporting to work and complete job duties as directed with accuracy and within the given timeline.
  • Collaboration is key to effective problem solving. Bringing together diverse perspectives and areas of expertise can lead to innovative solutions that can drive continuous improvement
  • Sustains a genial and cooperative attitude when working on tasks alone or with fellow team members.

Requirements:

  • Able to bear the weight of items weighing between 35-50 pounds several times during a workday.
  • Capable of transporting goods weighing up to 60 pounds intermittently during working hours.
  • Perform a wide range of physical movements such as standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching during shifts.
  • Exude a positive and respectful disposition whether working autonomously or in a team setting.
  • Adequately skilled in performing simple mathematics tasks, specifically, counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Demonstrating the ability to effectively read and interpret product labels, tickets, and other documentation.
  • With proper training, one can become self-sufficient in the operation of computer systems and handheld devices.
  • The ability to communicate well is highly valued by employers across all industries, making it essential to hone your skills in this area
  • Safe and efficient work practices require a competent understanding of safety policies and instructions, which necessitates a certain level of proficiency in reading, speaking, and comprehending English.

Additional Requirements:

  • Adroit at operating all powered equipment safely while complying with safety procedures, including but not limited to Scissor Lift, Pallet Rider, Sit Down & Standup Forklift, and capable of working at heights of up to 40ft.
  • Perform duties on a mezzanine, which could be as high as 40 ft, if applicable to the job at hand
  • Comfortable and knowledgeable about operating in varying temperature environments, including refrigeration and freezing units, throughout the work period.

Benefits:

Eligible Target associates may enroll in a comprehensive benefits package, with access to the respective plans that comply with specific terms and employment requirements.

Note:

In order to match business needs and expectations for the Warehouse Operations position, your suitability will be evaluated for the role of either Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate in accordance with your responses to the questionnaire and assessment given as part of the application process. More in-depth information regarding the particular job responsibilities for each of these positions can be found through the links at the end of this page.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a vigilant and dedicated Unarmed Security Officer to uphold safety and security across our premises. In this dynamic role, you will be the first line of defense, ensuring a secure environment through proactive surveillance, access control, and customer service. Your presence will help maintain order, prevent incidents, and foster a safe atmosphere for staff, visitors, and property. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your security expertise while contributing to a safe community.

Duties

  • Monitor surveillance systems such as CCTV to detect suspicious activity and ensure property security.
  • Conduct regular patrols of the premises, including buildings, parking lots, and restricted areas to identify potential security threats.
  • Control access points using access control systems, verifying identities and authorizations of employees, visitors, and contractors.
  • Respond promptly to emergency situations following established procedures, including fire alarms or medical emergencies.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security breaches, accidents, or unusual occurrences for record-keeping and future reference.
  • Perform background checks on new personnel or visitors as part of security screening processes.
  • Assist with conflict de-escalation and conflict management to maintain a peaceful environment while adhering to security regulations.

Skills

  • Strong surveillance skills with experience operating CCTV and other monitoring equipment.
  • Knowledge of law enforcement procedures and emergency response protocols.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks safely, including heavy lifting when necessary.
  • Excellent customer service skills with a professional demeanor when interacting with the public.
  • Proficiency in incident report writing with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Familiarity with security tools such as Taser devices (non-lethal), AEDs (Automated External Defibrillators), and fire extinguishers.
  • Understanding of physical security measures including patrolling techniques and access control systems.
  • Ability to perform first aid procedures including CPR and AED operation confidently.
  • Experience in performing background checks and ensuring compliance with security regulations.
  • Strong conflict de-escalation skills combined with effective communication for conflict management situations.

Join us as a Unarmed Security Officer and become an integral part of maintaining a safe, secure environment where safety is our top priority!

Embark on this seasonal journey where your expertise makes a real difference! We value energetic professionals committed to safety and community well-being. Join us in creating a secure environment that allows everyone to enjoy the festivities confidently.

Pay: Up to $45.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Austin Officers Come Join our Team!

Overview

Founded in 1973, Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. is a leading US-owned security company, providing integrated security solutions to government and commercial customers on four continents. Inter-Con remains under family ownership and control and operates as the industry leader in the field of customized, high-requirement security solutions. Inter-Con employs over 25,000 security personnel worldwide, trained and managed by a team of professionals with unsurpassed military, law enforcement, and security experience. Inter-Con is Everywhere Security Matters.

Why Work at Inter-Con?

Passion: Inter-Con is a thriving company that is passionate about its products and people. Joining the Inter-Con family is an opportunity for growth and career advancement in an environment that truly cares for its employees. By joining the Inter-Con family, you’re working with the best to build a safer future.

People: Inter-Con is more than a company, it’s an alumni base. We believe in positioning the right people in the right place to help them achieve their long-term aspirations for career growth. We have transitioned thousands of officers into successful careers in law enforcement, government services, foreign affairs and many more. Your career success drives our success.

Benefits: Inter-Con offers excellent full-time and part-time benefits that include: flexible scheduling to accommodate lifestyle commitments, vacation, sick leave, medical, dental, sponsorship for Top Secret Clearance, comprehensive training, discounts on higher education and much more.

Partner with us to begin a journey that begins with a commitment and leads to a career of a lifetime. Stand out. Be proud. Be Inter-Con!

Employment Opportunity

Sometimes the threat to life, destruction of critical infrastructure or damage to the environment is so severe that a specially trained and equipped security force is needed. When that happens, Inter-Con turns to its Security Officers. As part of this elite team you will secure some of our most vital assets. You will be trained in enhanced security procedures and be exposed to cutting edge technology. The qualifications are high and the training is rigorous, but if you make it you’ll join one of the most exclusive clubs in the Inter-Con family.

Specific benefits include:

  • Recognition and Reward Programs.
  • Training and Career Development.
  • Opportunities for Medical, dental, Holidays, vacation and sick, and 401 (k) retirement plan.
  • Uniform and equipment provided
  • Additional benefits vary depending on position.

Employment Opportunity

At Inter-Con we take pride in providing customized security solutions for our clients. To us, that means the right officer in the right place and at the right time. In many cases our clients desire a softer security plan that meets their values and needs, but where high value people and assets are involved, others may prefer a more obvious security presence. As an Unarmed Security Officer, you will be part of a highly trained security team that supports critical facilities and infrastructure, public venues that required an enhanced presence and personal protective services. As an Unarmed Security Officer, you are an integral part of the broad spectrum of specialized security services Inter-Con provides its clients every day.

Job Description

Requirements shall include, but not be limited to, ensuring that only authorized personnel are on premises, verification of parking permits for parking on bus yard, direct traffic for the delivery of products to shipping and receiving and assistance in the evacuation of the bus yard in case of an emergency the back-up security personnel.

Security Personnel shall be ever vigilant to detect and report any persons attempting to gain unauthorized access to the property.

Front Lobby Duties. Post 3 Security Personnel will be responsible for issuing, retrieving, and monitoring badges for all Client employees, temporary employees, contractors, and visitors. Post 3 will provide security assistance and manage activities of the front lobby and assist in security support for confrontational situations with customers.

Security Personnel will be responsible for issuing, retrieving, and monitoring badges for all Client employees, temporary employees, contractors, and visitors. Post 4 will provide security assistance and monitoring of all activities of personnel entering and exiting the facility. Post 4 will provide security assistance and manage activities of the front lobby and assist in security support for confrontational situations with customers. Post 4 duties shall include but not limited to: (1) greeting customers, employees, contractors, and visitors, (2)signing customers in and out in appropriate logs, (3) contacting departments for arrival of visitors, (4) assisting in the evacuation of the building in case of an emergency, (5) contact account manager or the PSA to unlock doors when requested by employees, (6) assist the public, and (7) monitoring of security camera systems

Job Requirements

  • Must be 21 yrs or older
  • Must be US citizen or Resident
  • Must pass background check and physical/drug screening
  • Must have a valid Security License as required by the State of Texas
  • Must have at least two (2) years in one of the following: law enforcement, military or facility security
  • Must have a High School diploma or GED
  • Security personnel must possess capability of operating a computer with basic data input skills, for example, sending, receiving emails.
  • Be literate in the English language to the extent of reading and understanding printed regulations, written verbal Orders, and instructions and writing of reports

Work Environment and Schedule

  • Job operates in client sites which could be indoors or outdoors.
  • Position requires prolonged standing and walking, in the performance of daily security activities.
  • Open availability Nights, Weekends, Holidays and overtime as directed(overtime occurs).
  • Work various shifts and Holidays as assigned.

Veterans

Inter-Con is passionate about hiring veterans. In fact, we’ve hired thousands of veterans over the years and plan to keep hiring as many as we can. If you are veteran in search of a rewarding career among a team that holds an affinity for those who served as well as values your success and growth within our organization, please take a moment to review our website for all our extensive opportunities. Visit www.icsecurity.com/careers/for more information.

Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Life doesn't always follow a fixed schedule. That's why we created the Security Officer - Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Patrol Communications in Fort Worth, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $20.00 / Hour

DayTimeMon10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It's all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

  • Respond to incidents, access concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of the facility, loading areas, parking areas, and perimeter to help to deter unauthorized activity.
  • Monitor access points and report unusual conditions, hazards, maintenance concerns, and policy violations to appropriate personnel.
  • Complete required activity logs, incident reports, and other documentation in accordance with Allied Universal and site procedures.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Have at least 1 year of security-related experience.
  • Experience with alarm panels is preferred.
  • Experience with access control and badge systems is preferred.
  • Comfort using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.

About Inner Valor

At Inner Valor, we deliver hospitality-driven security for large-scale festivals and high-profile events. Our officers are not simply present—they are engaged, observant, and proactive, creating a safe environment while enhancing the guest experience.

Position Summary

We are seeking high-performing Event Security Officers who demonstrate strong judgment, professional presence, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, high-attendance environments.

This role is best suited for individuals who take pride in their work, communicate confidently, and can anticipate and address issues before they escalate.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute access control operations, including ID verification and credential enforcement, with consistency and professionalism
  • Conduct security screenings, including bag checks and handheld or walk through metal detector procedures, in accordance with site protocols
  • Maintain situational awareness across large crowds, identifying risks early
  • Support safe and efficient guest flow, including entry, exit, and restricted areas
  • Apply clear communication and de-escalation techniques when addressing issues
  • Respond decisively to incidents, disturbances, and emergency situations
  • Represent Inner Valor with a polished, customer-focused presence at all times
What Sets You Apart

We are looking for individuals who demonstrate:

  • Strong awareness, attention to detail, and decision-making ability
  • The ability to remain calm, composed, and professional under pressure
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • A team-first mindset with a high level of accountability
  • Reliability—you show up early, prepared, and ready to perform
Minimum Qualifications:
  • 18+ years old with a high school diploma or GED
  • Ability to work long shifts (8-12+ hour shifts) in dynamic environments
  • Reliable transportation to various event locations across Chicago and the suburbs
  • Exceptional customer service and communication skills
  • Comfortable working in outdoor event environments
  • Must pass background check and drug test
Preferred Qualifications:
  • PERC card & 20-hour Basic Security Training certification
  • Experience in event security, hospitality, military, or law enforcement
  • CPR/First Aid certification
  • Prior experience working large-scale events or high-attendance venues
Physical & Mental Requirement:

This role requires sustained physical presence, environmental adaptability, and continuous alertness in dynamic event settings. Responsibilities include:

  • Remaining on your feet for extended periods (8–12+ hours), including standing, walking, and active monitoring
  • Working outdoors for prolonged durations in varying weather conditions (heat, sun, wind, rain, and other environmental factors)
  • Operating effectively in crowded, high-noise environments, including entry points and screening areas
  • Maintaining constant situational awareness, attention to detail, and focus throughout the duration of the shift
  • Communicating clearly and effectively with guests and team members in fast-paced and sometimes stressful conditions
  • Navigating dense crowds, restricted areas, stairs, and uneven terrain as required by the event site
  • Responding quickly to incidents, including rapid movement over short distances when necessary
  • Occasionally lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling up to 25 pounds

Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Access Control Driver in Fort Worth, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Logistics & Distribution, and more. As an Access Control Officer at a logistics and distribution location, you will manage entry points, verify credentials, monitor activity, and provide exceptional customer service to employees, visitors, and drivers. Conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and use communication and computer-based tools to support operations. This driving position requires a valid driver's license in accordance with Allied Universal policy. Join a caring, innovative team built on teamwork and integrity.

Position Type: Full Time

jobs.description:
Employment Opportunity

At Inter-Con we take pride in providing customized security solutions for our clients. To us, that means the right officer in the right place and at the right time. In many cases our clients desire a softer security plan that meets their values and needs, but where high value people and assets are involved, others may prefer a more obvious security presence. As an Unarmed Security Officer, you will be part of a highly trained security team that supports critical facilities and infrastructure, public venues that required an enhanced presence and personal protective services. You’ll be trained by our team of highly qualified firearms instructors in safe weapons handling and marksmanship. As an Unarmed Security Officer, you are an integral part of the broad spectrum of specialized security services Inter-Con provides its clients every day.


Specific benefits include:

Competitive Pay

Recognition and Reward Programs.

Training and Career Development.

Opportunities for Medical, dental, Holidays, vacation and sick, and 401 (k) retirement plan.

Uniform and equipment provided

Additional benefits vary depending on position.

Security personnel are to be certified and trained and will be assigned a variety of standing, sitting and walking posts.


Expected Responsibilities:

Document all physical security breaches/incidents and actions taken in response.

Monitor life safety equipment and note any deficiencies in writing to Security Management. This equipment includes automated external defibrillators (AED), crash doors, fire extinguishers, first aid kits, duress alarms, or any other equipment identified by Client.

Respond to all alarm conditions and any other indication of suspicious activities.

Meet and greet all tenants, sign-in visitors and contractors.

Respond effectively to all calls for assistance.

Must be sensitive to client’s culture and strive to maintain a positive client brand image.

Treat Client’s employees, invitee’s, and guest with the utmost courtesy and respect.


Qualifications:

A Current guard card license as required by State or local law.

Must pass a 12-panel drug test prior to placement.

Must pass a criminal history check (based on fingerprints where permitted by law) independent of state professional certification requirements.

Must undergo employment verification check back to age 18.

Must undergo motor vehicle record checks.

Must be 21 years or older.

May be required to perform emergency duties which require physical exertion such as: standing or walking for an entire shift, climbing stairs, lifting, carrying objects up to 75 lbs., and running.


Education and Experience:


High school diploma or equivalent; possession of a college degree is highly desirable.

Speak, read, and write English.

All assigned personnel should be of high integrity and possess exemplary security skills and judgment.

Assigned personnel should possess above average computer skills and must hold all necessary and required licenses, permits and certifications required by the States and/or Countries of assignment to perform security officer duties.


Inter-Con Overview

Founded in 1973, Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. is a leading US-owned security company, providing integrated security solutions to government and commercial customers on four continents. Inter-Con remains under family ownership and control and operates as the industry leader in the field of customized, high-requirement security solutions. Inter-Con employs over 35,000 security personnel world-wide, trained and managed by a team of professionals with unsurpassed military, law enforcement, and security experience. Inter-Con is Everywhere Security Matters.


Why Work at Inter-Con?

Passion: Inter-Con is a thriving company that is passionate about its products and people. Joining the Inter-Con family is an opportunity for growth and career advancement in an environment that truly cares for its employees. By joining the Inter-Con family, you’re working with the best to build a safer future.

People: Inter-Con is more than a company, it’s an alumni base. We believe in positioning the right people in the right place to help them achieve their long-term aspirations for career growth. We have transitioned thousands of officers into successful careers in law enforcement, government agencies, foreign affairs and many more. Your career success drives our success.

Benefits: Inter-Con offers excellent benefits that include flexible scheduling to accommodate lifestyle commitments, vacation, sick leave, medical, dental, comprehensive training, discounts on higher education and much more.

Partner with us to begin a journey that begins with a commitment and leads to a career of a lifetime. Stand out. Be proud. Be Inter-Con!


Veterans

Inter-Con is passionate about hiring veterans. In fact, we’ve hired thousands of veterans over the years and plan to keep hiring as many as we can. If you are veteran in search of a rewarding career among a team that holds an affinity for those who served as well as values your success and growth within our organization, please take a moment to review our website for all our extensive opportunities. Visit www.icsecurity.com/careers/ for more information.

jobs.title: Security Officer (Part Time)
jobs.description:
Security Officer (Part Time)

Would you like to be part of a team that keeps the cast, crew, celebrity guests and co-workers at The Walt Disney Company safe and secure? Our Security Officers do it all, from working special events like Disney shows to regular perimeter checks of our buildings and offices. If you thrive in an environment where no two days are exactly alike, and where professionalism and precision are valued, apply today to join us!

As a Security Officer, you’d be part of a well-trained, cohesive team that provides 24/7 protection for co-workers and guests at our buildings and at special events. Your mission? To protect Disney property and safeguard our people!

Every day as a Security Officer is different! Depending on your shift, on any given day you might:

  • Greet visitors, check company IDs, and provide temporary IDs at building entrances

  • Evaluate and screen the audience line at live TV shows

  • Be a security presence at movie premiers, live performances, events, or private parties

  • Patrol hallways and building perimeters to spot safety issues or irregularities

  • Fill out the logbook precisely and completely

  • Answer questions asked by visitors and employees in a friendly, professional way

  • Use your know-how and training to diffuse a tense situation

  • Respond to medical or fire incidents, and work directly with local first responders

  • Assist private security details brought by celebrities, sports stars, politicians and visiting dignitaries – even the President has been known to stop by

  • Control messenger flow and package delivery

  • Utilize technology to report and document incidents and manage information flow

  • Perform walk-through evaluation at off-site events

Here’s what you will need to be successful in the job:

  • 1 year of corporate security, law enforcement or military experience

  • Excellent communication skills, including fluent written and spoken English, and strong command of basic English grammar

  • Ability to make quick decisions using your training and common sense

  • The knack for talking to people in a friendly way that gets results

  • A “team” orientation and willingness to collaborate

  • Physical ability to perform all aspects of the job and be outside in all weather; and

  • Flexible workdays/hours (this is a “shift work” role) and ability to work some overtime

It would be a plus if you also have these skills:

  • Valid Security Guard license issued by your state

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

  • Experience working under pressure

  • Ability to take command and diplomatically control difficult situations

Education is important to us, here is what we are looking for:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required

  • Associate degree or higher preferred

Some of the perks we offer include:

  • Taking part in ongoing learning on subjects such as CPR, Imminent Threat Assessment and First Aid training.

  • Attending a movie screening or television taping, enjoying the full array of benefits offered by The Walt Disney Company including paid time off, 401K participation, a retirement savings plan, discounts on a wide variety of offerings, medical/dental/vision insurance and educational reimbursement-just to name a few!

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Manager - Chicago
jobs.description:
Imagine working for a company that measures its success based off the growth of its colleagues, a company that invests in its future by investing in you. Little Caesars is a company where our colleagues make an impact.

Your Mission

In this role, you will maintain restaurant compliance to security and safety policies and procedures through regular on-site evaluations. Responds to incidents of crime, which occur in the area and participates with local law enforcement agencies in the investigation of such incidents.

How You'll Make an Impact:

  • Visits restaurants and documents the results of the visit in order to monitor compliance to safety and security policies and procedures. Review results with Regional Director of Loss Prevention, Market Director, and Area Supervisor.
  • Responds to incidents of crime reported/possible internal issues, coordinates investigations and provides support for colleagues and customers.
  • Investigates incidents in a timely manner. Prepares criminal loss report and investigation summary and informs Regional Director of Loss Prevention. Submits criminal loss weekly and period end reports to the Regional Director of Loss Prevention, Market Directors and Zone Vice President.
  • Follows up on incidents by providing assistance to colleagues in the criminal justice process and maintains contact with colleagues and agencies as necessary to complete investigation.
  • Maintains accurate documents on all investigations until file is completed and incident is closed.
  • Recovers restitution’s voluntarily or through court order.
  • Attends manager meetings and coordinates monthly classroom instruction sessions with Recruiter/Trainer in order to present Loss Prevention programs.
  • Investigates foreign object reports and documents findings and communicates with Risk Management.
  • Investigates and enforces all cash management related issues.
  • Conducts regular market visits.
  • Investigates other incidents as directed i.e. sexual harassment, accidents and etc.
Who You Are:
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of five (5) years' experience in multi-unit retail or restaurant loss prevention manager role or five (5) plus years' experience with public law enforcement agency.
  • Strong working knowledge of criminal and civil codes dealing with private sector security policies and procedures.
  • The ability to travel extensively (up to 75%).
  • Strong supervisory and training ability.
  • Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience and/or training in the field of interview and interrogation.
  • Proof of and maintain a valid operator’s license, automobile insurance as a primary driver, as well as a reliable means of transportation to carry out essential job functions, in accordance with company policy and procedures.
  • Must pass a criminal background check in accordance with company policy and periodically checked thereafter.
  • Must be willing and able to work evening and weekends.
  • Must possess a valid credit card in own name.
  • Be available and on call 24 hours a day.
What Will Make You Stand Out:
  • Bachelor’s degree in security management or criminal justice.
  • Demonstrated supervisory and training ability.
  • Working knowledge of retail/restaurant point-of-sale systems.
  • College level coursework and professional training certifications in security management or criminal justice.
  • Experience in restaurant operations and management.
Working Conditions:
  • Exposure to travel elements airplane and automobile.

Description: Provides physical security for a university building. Pursuant to the State of Texas Executive Order No. GA‑48, this position researches, works on, or has access to critical infrastructure and requires the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the university infrastructure.

The position requires personnel to be routinely reviewed to determine whether a criminal history or continuous connections to a foreign adversary might prevent the employee from maintaining the security or integrity of the infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Unlocks and locks doors and checks all floors for unsecured doors.
  • Monitors entry into the building and maintains sign‑in/out log.
  • Monitors security cameras and radio traffic; alerts proper personnel of camera malfunctions.
  • Answers the telephone and greets visitors; provides information and directions.
  • Provides immediate contact with the university's police department in case of an emergency; prepares incident reports.
  • May accept parcel packages and deliver them to designated floors or staff.
  • May monitor and control entry into a gated parking lot.
  • Patrols assigned areas to check for criminal activity, rule violations, and irregularities.
  • Performs other job‑related duties assigned.
M&Q: Requires a basic knowledge of grammar, spelling, punctuation, and simple mathematical functions such as percentages and ratios. This may normally be acquired through a high school diploma or GED.

No experience is required.

Requires a valid Texas Driver's License.

Requirements

  • Must be able to work nights, weekends, and overtime assignments.
  • Must be proficient with using a computer and Microsoft Office suite.
  • Must pass a Criminal History and valid TX Driver’s License check prior to an interview.
  • Must pass Background Investigation prior to employment.
  • Must pass a pre‑employment drug screening.
UHPD requires all applicants to complete the criminal history fields on their application. Applicants with incomplete criminal history fields will not be considered for a position.

Required information includes

  • DOB
  • Driver’s license
  • Last 4 digits of SSN
Veterans are strongly encouraged to apply and will receive preference in employment over other applicants for the same position who do not have a greater qualification. Military experience will only be considered if it includes Military Police or Security‑related responsibilities in your job functions. (Please attach a copy of your DD‑214.)

Salary will be based on years of experience.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (accrual increases with service years)
  • Sick leave accrual
  • Comprehensive free medical coverage for employees (premiums apply for family members)
  • Great optional benefits to enhance your medical coverage
  • Many on‑campus / off‑campus employee perks

Physical & Environmental Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities and functions of the job and are not meant to be all inclusive. While performing this job the staff member shall:

Environmental: The employee may be exposed to inclement weather conditions and has extensive public contact with student, faculty, and staff.

Employees are required to work various assigned shifts, including days, evenings, nights, and weekends, and may be required to remain at their post for an additional shift. All staff are essential personnel and are required to report to work during inclement weather.

Physical: Primary functions require sufficient physical ability to work in a law‑enforcement setting and an office setting; restrain or subdue individuals; walk, stand, sit, or run for extended periods of time; occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; occasionally climb and balance; ability to operate and use specialized law‑enforcement tools and equipment.

All positions at the University of Houston‑System are security‑sensitive and will require a criminal history check.

The University of Houston System and its universities are Equal Opportunity Institutions. Everyone is encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Security Advisor Houston, Texas
jobs.description:
Chevron is accepting online applications for the position of Security Advisor located in Houston, TX through 08/10/2026 at 11:59 p.m. (Central Time).

Chevron Corporation is one of the world’s leading integrated energy companies with subsidiaries that conduct business across the globe. The company’s success is driven by the ingenuity and commitment of thousands of employees who operate across the energy spectrum. Chevron explores for, produces, and transports crude oil and natural gas; refines, markets, and distributes transportation fuels and other energy products and services; manufactures and sells petrochemical products; generates power and produces geothermal energy; and develops and commercializes the energy resources of the future, including biofuels and other renewables.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

  • Conduct complex investigations to protect Chevron’s people, assets, information, and interests. Investigations may include but are not limited to allegations of fraud, conflict of interest, misuse of company assets, policy violations, intellectual property loss and theft.
  • Prepare investigative reports and brief senior management and company legal representatives on investigative findings.
  • Develop and assesses threat information, in coordination with the geopolitical risk team, to determine impact on company staff and operations.
  • Provide security and risk management advice to company leadership. Conduct security risk and management assessments at designated company facilities and recommend risk-based security measures to protect company personnel and assets; support emergency planning and response; provide integrated security assistance to enable the safe and secure execution of major business decisions, projects, and base business.
  • Advise on and implement best-practice and cost-effective risk-based security policies and procedures.
  • Develop and maintain working relationships and liaison with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies and peer private sector security professionals.
  • Provide executive protection for senior company officers when required.
  • Participate in the planning and execution of security services for special events and other major company activities.
  • Perform other duties as determined by Global Security management.
  • Role requires regular travel and time away from the office (approximately 25%).
  • This position requires occasional international travel.
  • This position requires occasional work outside of normal business hours.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in law enforcement and/or corporate security
  • Proven experience conducting complex investigations.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated initiative and a self-starter, with proven ability to lead and motivate.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and concisely, both verbally and in writing, with experienced presentation ability. Capable and comfortable in presentations to high level executives and government officials.
  • Must have a valid US passport or is able to obtain one shortly after being hired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working for a U.S. federal law enforcement agency or working as a member of a U.S. federal law enforcement agency task force.
  • Experience conducting investigations with national security implications.
  • Current U.S. Government security clearance or have held a US. Government security clearance during the past 5 years.
  • International work-related experience
  • Foreign language ability

Relocation Options:

Relocation will be considered.

International Considerations:
Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

Houston, Texas

jobs.title: Security Officer/Driver at La Rabida Children's Hospital Chicago, IL
jobs.description:
Security Officer/Driver job at La Rabida Children's Hospital. Chicago, IL.

La Rabida Children’s Hospital provides specialized, family-centered health care to children with medically complex conditions, disabilities, and chronic illness. Through expertise, compassion, and advocacy we help children and their families reach their fullest potential, regardless of their ability to pay.

Our not-for-profit hospital, licensed for 49 beds, helps transition children from neonatal or pediatric intensive care to home, by providing medical, rehabilitative and developmental care, and by training families to continue treatments and manage the necessary equipment in the home. La Rabida also provides extensive rehabilitation for those recovering from wounds or burns and treatment for exacerbations of chronic conditions.

The hospital’s enhanced pediatric patient-centered medical home provides primary care to children with complex medical conditions and their siblings. Children with medical homes elsewhere come to La Rabida for specialty services. La Rabida offers a wide range of specialty services provided to children with sickle cell disease, diabetes, and many others.

Children are supported in their emotional and developmental growth, particularly in cases where such growth has been interrupted by accident or disease.

Finally, La Rabida provides forensic and treatment services for children exposed to abuse and neglect, comprehensive assessments for youth in care, early intervention for children between 0 and 3 years of age. Care coordination services for medically complex children are also provided for those who are covered by a health plan and receive care from providers in Cook County

Job Description

The Security Officer/Driver patrols and maintains surveillance of the Hospital, both internally and externally, to ensure the physical safety of our employees and the patients we serve. The Security Officer/Driver additionally services patients, visitors, and staff through verbal interaction and vehicular transportation. The percentage of time spent in each capacity varies according to days and shifts worked, as well as shuttle and transportation needs.

Security Officer (35 - 85%)

  • Patrols internal and external building: hallways, secure and open doors, patrol parking areas
Driver (35 - 85%)
  • Operates shuttle service to and from the University of Chicago (Hourly shuttles between 7:30am - 5:30pm, weekdays only and excluding holidays). Also provides US Postal pick-up (weekdays only and excluding holidays)
  • Provides special transportation services: patient transports to off-site healthcare facilities, donation pick-up, vehicle maintenance, and various trips as requested
Information Desk Operations (10%)
  • Greets and directs visitors
  • Issue visitor's passes
  • Communication command station for Security and Transportation Drivers
  • Triage Emergency Room patients
  • Monitors life safety systems
  • Answers Incoming Calls
  • Internal Paging
  • Maintains presence as primary attendant console lunch/break
Camera and door surveillance equipment (5%)
  • View Camera monitor and change tape
  • Inspection Door printouts

Qualifications

  • High School diploma/GED Required
  • Customer Service background. Prefer at least two years experience as a Security Officer in healthcare environment
  • 20-hour basic Security Training Program Certification (Certification waived for current/previous Security/Law Enforcement Officers)
  • Valid State Driver's License - No major driving violations in past year
  • Must maintain valid driver's license while employed in this position
  • Knowledge of basic security operation

Additional Information

La Rabida Children’s Hospital is very proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer La Rabida is a place unlike any other.

We understand the needs of families with children dealing with the most serious or complicated of conditions. With teams of the best healthcare providers in Chicago, we give continuous, comprehensive care, education, and support, helping families face their unique obstacles head-on.

La Rabida Children’s Hospital is very proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Safety and Security Officer - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Description

Our most important asset is our people. Who we are, what we do, how we do it and why we are passionate are all centerpieces of why we succeed.

We are proud to be recognized:

  • Among America’s Best Midsize Employers by Forbes in 2021, 2022 and 2024
  • As a Chicago Tribune Top Workplace for four consecutive years (2021-2025)

This role will operate onsite 5 days week, Monday – Friday. The 2nd shift hours are 2pm – 10pm.

Role Summary

As the Safety and Security Officer, you will be responsible for ensuring a safe and secure work environment for employees, contractors, and visitors at Fellowes U.S. facilities. The Safety and Security Officer will proactively focus on hazard identification, safety observations, and safety and security inspections. Additionally, the position will utilize safety and security systems and respond to, investigate, and document any incidents that occur on company property, while protecting employees, company property, and assets.

In This Role, You Will

  • Complete safety inspections, safe work observations, and safety audits to identify safe and unsafe workplace conditions and behaviors.
  • Incident response for injuries, accidents, property damage, security incidents, weather events, and facility evacuations.
  • Complete incident reports for safety and security events.
  • Navigate and monitor safety and security systems to include fire alarm & fire suppression, access control program, visitor management software, security alarm system, ESS database/safety software, and CCTV systems.
  • Conduct internal and external tours of the facility to ensure physical security.
  • Provide excellent customer service and facility access for employees, contractors, and visitors.
  • Process deliveries, interoffice mail, BOL’s, property passes, and safety and security supply inventories.
  • Serve as an on-site point of contact for fire department, police department, and safety/security vendors when necessary.
  • Collaborate with other members of the Environmental, Safety, and Security Department, along with other areas of the business to help drive continuous improvement and awareness in the areas of safety and security.
  • Maintain security records, equipment reports, inspections, key control records, and visitor logs.
  • Conduct drug & alcohol screens.
  • Provide additional support for special events and meetings.
  • Escalate safety and security incidents to the Senior Environmental, Safety, and Security Specialist, as needed.

What You Bring to the Team

  • At least 3 years experience in a security or safety role preferably in a corporate/warehouse/manufacturing environment.
  • Familiarity with safety and security systems and equipment.
  • Basic understanding of security and safety concepts, methodologies, and requirements.
  • High school diploma is required. A degree in Criminal/Social Justice or Occupational Health and Safety preferred.
  • Ability to safety operate a company van and powered industrial equipment.
  • Understand and follow Security Department Standard Operating Procedures and Emergency Response Plans.
  • Maintain certification in first aid, CPR, and AED’s.
  • Proficient in Windows based programs and applications.
  • Ability to adapt to a quickly changing and sometimes fast-paced environment.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information, while demonstrating integrity and professionalism.
  • Lead and influence without direct authority.
  • Flexibility to work overtime occasionally, as needed.

The hiring range for this position in Itasca, IL starts at $20-22hr. The shift differential is $.60/hr. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills and experience, among other factors. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits may be provided, dependent on the level and position offered. An overview of our benefits offering is available here: Fellowes Benefits Overview.

Fellowes Brands - A Family Business Since 1917

jobs.title: Regional Security Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description

Regional Security Specialist

Job Summary

The Regional Senior Security Manager (RAM) assumes a multifaceted role responsible for the seamless management of guard service operations and security-related functions based in Austin, TX. The RAM will support client operations in Austin, TX. This entails fostering client satisfaction, resolving conflicts, and overseeing various operational aspects, including scheduling, staffing, billing, training, and compliance.

Why Securitas?

Joining Securitas means being part of a global leader committed to excellence and innovation. We offer a unique environment that nurtures individual growth and rewards performance. You will be part of a team that values integrity, vigilance, and helpfulness, making a real difference in the communities we serve.

If you are ready to take on this challenging and rewarding role and be part of a performance-driven culture of purpose, execution, and belonging, we want to hear from you. Be part of our journey to make the world a safer place.

Benefits

Securitas will offer a starting salary of $85,000-$92,000, in addition to a full benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 10 accrued vacation days, 4 floating holidays, and 6 sick days
  • 401K

Key Responsibilities

  • Core Values and Client Relations:
  • Exemplify Securitas’ Core Values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for the client, ensuring high-quality services and client satisfaction.
  • Service Quality and Compliance:
  • Continuously assess service quality and proactively address issues.
  • Develop and implement training programs and ensure compliance with regulations.
  • Establish and maintain performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Global Coordination and Networking:
  • Collaborate with the Global Program Manager (GPM) to align with global security objectives and initiatives.
  • Identify and utilize networking opportunities for standardizing processes and service delivery.
  • Staff Development and Management:
  • Oversee staff development, provide feedback and coaching.
  • Ensure proper scheduling, staffing, and cost efficiencies.
  • Administer resolutions to issues and discipline as needed.
  • Operational and Financial Oversight:
  • Manage invoice and payment processes, including expenditures.
  • Collaborate on policy and procedure management.
  • Monitor client credits and adjust as necessary.
  • Communication and Coordination:
  • Maintain ongoing communication with all stakeholders.
  • Prepare, develop, and deliver dynamic quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
  • Perform any additional duties as assigned by the Global Program Manager.

Education/Experience

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in security industry-related fields or business management.
  • Must have 3+ years’ experience of direct supervisory or management experience.
  • Previous law enforcement experience preferred.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.

Key Competencies

  • Strong security and business management experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of security operations and procedures.
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills.
  • Strong financial experience.
  • Ability to interpret, track, and maintain schedules, metrics, and performance indicators.
  • Budget planning and forecasting experience.
  • Capacity to maintain composure and professionalism in unusual circumstances.
  • Adaptability to rapidly changing environments or assignments.
  • Proficiency in computer skills, particularly Microsoft Office and data visualization tools.
  • Strong team collaboration and client-centric mindset.

If joining our management team sounds like the right fit for you, please click apply today!

Company Website: https://www.securitasinc.com

Securitas is committed to equal opportunity employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

#AF-SSTA

Regional Security Specialist / Securitas Security / AUSTIN TX / TXDPS License # B03944

About Us

Securitas employees come from all walks of life, bringing with them a variety of distinctive skills and perspectives. United through our common purpose, we provide the security needed to safeguard our clients' assets and people. Our core values - Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness - are represented by the three red dots in the Securitas logo. If you live by these values, we’re looking for you to join the Securitas team.

Benefits Include

  • Retirement plan
  • Employer-provided medical and dental coverage
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Voluntary life and disability insurance
  • Employee assistance plan
  • Securitas Saves discount program
  • Paid holidays
  • Paid time away from work

Additionally, some populations may have the availability of accessing earned wages on a daily basis, prior to payday. Restrictions and fees may apply.

Certain waiting periods may also apply. Paid time away from work may be available either through a combination of vacation and sick time or under a PTO policy, depending on local requirements. Benefits may be different for union members.

About The Team

Our Company Mission:

Securitas’ mission is to protect homes, workplaces, and communities by providing the security services they need to protect their assets, safeguard their people, and maintain their ability to generate profits.

Our Values

Securitas’ core values - Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness - are the foundation for our employees to build trust with customers, colleagues, and the surrounding community.

Integrity

Securitas employees are honest and trusted by customers to safeguard their premises and valuables. We don’t compromise on integrity and create an open forum for our employees and customers to voice opinions, report improprieties, and share information.

Vigilance

Seeing, hearing, and evaluating. A Securitas employee is always attentive and often notices things that others don’t. Their vigilance is necessary in order to be aware of potential risks or incidents that may take place on our customers’ premises.

Helpfulness

As part of an on-going effort to ensure safety, Securitas employees are always ready to help if an incident occurs that requires intervention regardless of whether or not it is directly related to their job.

Job Summary
We are seeking a vigilant and proactive Security Officer to join our team and ensure the safety and security of our premises, staff, and visitors. As a Security Officer, you will be responsible for monitoring access points, conducting surveillance, and responding swiftly to any incidents or emergencies. Your role is vital in maintaining a secure environment where everyone can work confidently and comfortably. This position offers an engaging opportunity for individuals with a strong sense of responsibility, excellent conflict management skills, and a passion for safeguarding assets.

Duties

  • Control access to the facility by verifying credentials of employees, visitors, contractors, and vendors.
  • Conduct regular surveillance using CCTV systems to monitor activity across the premises and identify potential security threats.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, incidents, or emergencies, coordinating with law enforcement or emergency services as needed.
  • Perform routine patrols inside and outside the facility to detect suspicious activity or safety hazards.
  • Manage conflict situations professionally, de-escalating disputes and ensuring safety for all parties involved.
  • Maintain detailed incident reports, shift logs, and security records accurately and promptly.
  • Assist in loss prevention efforts by monitoring for theft or vandalism and implementing preventative measures.

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of security protocols and procedures with experience in surveillance systems such as CCTV.
  • Excellent conflict management skills with the ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • First aid certification and CPR training to respond effectively during medical emergencies.
  • Ability to perform physical patrols, stand or walk for extended periods, and respond quickly in emergency situations.
  • Familiarity with loss prevention strategies to protect company assets effectively.
  • Effective communication skills for clear reporting and interaction with team members, visitors, and emergency responders. Join us in creating a safe environment where everyone feels protected! We value energetic individuals who are committed to maintaining high standards of security while fostering a positive atmosphere for all stakeholders.

  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Retirement plan
  • Vision insurance

jobs.description:
Job Opening: 66393
Opening Date: August 7, 2026
Closing Date: August 21, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. (ET)
Job Title Security Specialist - Associate Chief Security Officer (ACSO) Full Performance Level GS-13 Division San Antonio Field Office Location San Antonio, TX Working Hours Hours may vary based on the needs of the Division. Job Type Full Time/Permanent Who May Apply Current, permanent FBI employees Number of Positions Available 1 Questions Email: mblong2@fbi.gov and tehamilton@fbi.gov Salary GS-13: $108,001.00-$140,403.00
Additional selections may be made from this announcement to fill positions within the same division when the position includes substantially the same duties, responsibilities, and qualifications.
KEY REQUIREMENTS
  • Must be a current, permanent FBI employee
  • Must be able to obtain an SCI clearance
  • Some travel may be required
  • Selectee will be required to complete form FD-887, Request for Access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI)
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The work requires regular and recurring physical exertion, such as long periods of standing, walking, bending, stooping, reaching, crawling and similar activities. The ACSO engages in such exertions when, for example, they assist in the inspection of office buildings or industrial facilities. Performance of work may take place in attics, crawlspaces, walls, ceilings, and other limited access spaces, in rough terrain or in construction sites. The work may regularly involve lifting and carrying moderately heavy objects of 50 pounds or less. The work may require some common characteristics and abilities of physical agility and dexterity to work in confined spaces.
WORK ENVIRONMENT
The work is performed in settings in which there is regular and recurring exposure to moderate discomforts and unpleasantness, such as high levels of noise, high temperatures in confined spaces, or adverse weather conditions. The employee may be required to use protective clothing or gear such as masks, gowns, coats, boots, googles, gloves, or shields.
MAJOR DUTIES
  • Serves as the local ACSO to handle facets of security policy administration, primarily personnel and physical security. Will assist the Chief Security Officer (CSO) in all security assigned functions to include areas such as Communication Security (COMSEC), Continuity of Operations (COOP), Occupant Emergency Program (OEP), and Industrial and Information Security.
  • Provides direct support and service to the administration of the FBI Security Program by participating in the direction, from inception to completion, of complex security clearance access.
  • Provides briefings, trainings, leadership, advice, and guidance related to personnel security reporting requirements.
  • Establishes and implements local security procedural systems; and where appropriate, interprets, designs, develops, evaluates, and sometimes installs protection systems and devices to combat malicious interference.
  • Independently plans, schedules, coordinates, facilitates, and monitors the effectiveness of the operation of security programs.
  • Assists in the inspection of office buildings or industrial facilities, large military complexes, or remote sites.
  • May serve as the OEP Coordinator, participate in a Facility Security Committee (FSC), or serve as a CSO in the absence of the CSO.
QUALIFICATIONS & EVALUATIONS
Please ensure that your specialized experience and requirements are clearly identifiable in your resume. Your application will be evaluated using the FBI's Candidate Rating Procedures. Your resume and supporting documents will be reviewed to verify that you meet the job qualifications listed in this announcement. Applicants must meet the qualification requirements by the closing date of this announcement.
If you are found minimally qualified, your application will move forward to additional phases of the review process.
The first five competencies will be used in a Structured Resume Review to objectively evaluate applicant resumes. Do not provide a separate narrative written statement. Rather you must describe in your resume how your past work experience demonstrates that you possess the competencies identified below. Your resume should demonstrate that you possess the following competencies.
Competencies:
  • Analytic Thinking
  • Communication
  • Flexibility
  • Initiative
  • Physical Security
  • Security
Specialized Experience (SE)
GS-13: Applicant must possess at least one (1) year of SE equivalent to the GS-12 grade level. SE is defined as follows:
  • Performed security and administration work in two or more functional security areas - Personnel Security, Physical Security, COOP, OEP, Information Security, COMSEC, and Industrial Security.
  • Provided leadership by developing and implementing training, assigning work, developing deadlines, and identifying resources needed to complete a project.
  • Participated in audits and inspections of secure areas and made recommendations to management on policy and procedure changes being implemented to improve security.
  • Prepared and presented comprehensive and concise written reports to brief management on a variety of complex security assessment investigations.
  • Ensured compliance with current policy and security-based directives.
Education
Education may not be substituted for specialized experience at the GS 13 level.
HOW TO APPLY
For detailed instructions related to applying, uploading documents, withdrawing an application or updating your application, please review instructions on How to Apply. If applying online is a hardship, please use the contact information listed in the vacancy announcement prior to the closing date for assistance.
REQUIRED DOCUMENTS
To apply to this position, interested applicants must provide a complete application package by the closing date which includes:
  1. Utilizing the Resume Builder, outline your relevant work experience and associated start and end dates. Uploaded resumes will not be reviewed or used for qualification purposes.
  2. Other supporting documents (if applicable):
    • College transcripts, if qualifying based on education or if there is a positive education requirement
    • Memorandum for Record (MFR): Work performed outside assigned duties (that would not normally be documented on a SF-50, i. e., back-up duties), has to be documented in detail by an immediate supervisor in order to receive full credit for amount of time worked in that position. If no documentation is furnished no credit will be given for time worked in that position. The following notations must be specified in the documentation:
      • Percent of time worked in the particular position (cannot conflict with main duties)
      • The month/year work began
        Frequency worked (i.e., daily, monthly, etc.)
      • Specific duties performed
Attach the Memorandum for Record to your application in the "Cover Letters and Attachments" section of My Career Tools on the Careers Home page. Please upload the attachment as type "Other."

RESPONSIBILITIES
* Conduct training for new cadets and provide ongoing in-service training for Security Services staff.
* Provide leadership to lower ranking Security Officers through counseling, mentorship, and ongoing training resources.
* Perform supervisory duties when a Supervisor is absent.
* Schedule and direct work assignments for lower ranking Security Officers.
* Enforce Medical Center policies, guidelines, and procedures, serving as the source of authority.
* Perform on‑foot patrols of Medical Center campuses as directed by the Director of Security or designate.
* Report safety and fire hazards observed on routine patrols and inspections; identify violations of the Joint Commission, OSHA, NFPA, and local Fire Code.
* Maintain constant communications with the Security Control Center.
* Assist clinical staff with psychiatric patient restraint, monitor and mitigate combative patients, escort patients during clinical transport, and observe patients under medical or psychiatric restrictions.
* Perform emergency responses, including distress calls, panic alarms, fire and disaster response, and support on-site emergencies such as bomb threats, patient abduction, weapon incidents, and hazardous materials.
* Physically intervene to remove unauthorized persons from hospital property, intervene with disruptive adults, confront individuals suspected of criminal acts, substance use, or disorderly conduct.
* Operate locks or unlock specified entrances/exits and perform access control duties at assigned posts.
* Ensure only authorized personnel are admitted; confront unauthorized persons for questions, routing, or detainment as appropriate.
* Dispatch Security Control room operations using Computer‑Aided‑Dispatch systems, monitor CCTV, radio transmissions, alarm consoles, and customer phone calls.
* Utilize incident report software to complete reports, maintain records, and assist the department with data collection.
* Apart from the above duties, appear in court on behalf of the Medical Center to enforce prosecution of individuals for assault or criminal trespass.
* Direct traffic on campus property and control parking, enforce parking guidelines for visitors, contractors, and employees.
* Serve as a resource of information for patients, parents, visitors, and employees, escorting them as needed.
* Secure lost and found items and maintain logs of received items.
* Enhance personal professional growth and maintain currency in the security field through voluntary participation in educational programs and departmental training sessions.
* Operate the hospital shuttle vehicle when required, ensuring safe compliance with all traffic laws.
* Consistently demonstrate customer service values and goals, adhering to service principles with a focus on innovation, excellence, and teamwork to serve patients, families, co‑workers, and others.
QUALIFICATIONS
* High school diploma or equivalent (required).
* Minimum of three years of security experience, preferably in a hospital setting.
* Valid Illinois Driver’s License.
* International Association for Hospital Security and Safety (IAHSS) supervisory training certification (required).
* Good verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with strong English reading, writing, and comprehension.
* Computer literate with working knowledge of Windows‑based software applications and typing ability.
* Excellent customer service skills.
Compensation: Pay Range $21.00 – $32.55 per hour.
The range reflects minimum and maximum targets for the position and is regularly reviewed to align with market conditions.
BENEFITS
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Employer‑paid group term life and disability insurance.
* Employer contribution toward Health Savings Account.
* Flexible Spending Accounts.
* Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
* 403(b) retirement plan with a 5% employer match.
* Various voluntary benefits, including supplemental life, AD&D, and disability coverage, critical illness, accident and hospital indemnity coverage.
* Tuition assistance.
* Student loan servicing and support.
* Adoption benefits.
* Backup childcare and eldercare.
* Employee assistance program and other specialized behavioral health services for employees and family members.
* Discount on services at Lurie Children’s facilities.
* Discount purchasing program.
Equal Employment Opportunity: Lurie Children’s and its affiliates are equal employment opportunity employers.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, order of protection status, protected genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Type: Seasonal

WHAT WE PROVIDE:

This is a seasonal overnight Security Officer position at Six Flags Fiesta Texas, in San Antonio, TX. It features a competitive hourly rate of $14.75 (with an additional $1 per hour for working the hours between 12am-8am) with perks such as: Free entry to any Six Flags Park for all employees and a guest with each visit, additional complimentary tickets for friends and family, discount on food and merchandise for all employees, flexible scheduling, Dayforce Wallet access for earned wage access, and bi-weekly pay.


Join the exhilarating world of Six Flags Fiesta Texas as an Overnight Security Officer, where you'll be the fearless protector of our vibrant park! With your State of Texas Level 2 license, you'll embark on thrilling patrols, ensuring the safety and security of our premises. From swiftly responding to security incidents to expertly screening guests at the front gate, you'll be at the heart of our security operations, upholding our commitment to excellence. With every assignment tackled with precision and passion, you'll play a pivotal role in creating unforgettable experiences for our guests and maintaining the highest standards of safety throughout the park.

HOW YOU WILL DO IT:

  • Gate Security: Employ meticulous verification processes to ensure only authorized personnel and vehicles access the park, verifying identification and passes with precision.
  • Confidentiality: Demonstrate unwavering commitment to confidentiality by carefully safeguarding sensitive information encountered during patrols or incidents, upholding the trust placed in you.
  • Rapid Response: Be ready to spring into action at a moment's notice, responding promptly and decisively to security-related incidents within the park to mitigate risks and ensure the safety of guests and staff.
  • Documentation: Utilize your exceptional communication skills to write clear, concise, and comprehensive reports detailing incidents and the actions taken, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  • Law Enforcement Compliance: Execute your duties with a firm commitment to upholding local, state, and federal laws on park property, ensuring a safe and compliant environment for all.
  • Asset Protection: Exercise vigilance and proactive measures to safeguard company assets, property, and facilities against potential threats and illegal activities, acting as a steadfast guardian of the park's resources.
  • Traffic Control (as required): Assume control of traffic operations with precision and efficiency, managing vehicular flow and ensuring the safety of guests during peak times and special events.
  • Patrol Proficiency: Conduct thorough and systematic vehicle and bike patrols throughout the park, covering all areas to detect and deter potential security threats effectively.
  • Collaborative Approach: Foster strong partnerships with on-duty law enforcement personnel, facilitating seamless cooperation and coordination in maintaining park security and responding to incidents.
  • Dispatch Operations (as needed): Demonstrate proficiency in managing communications and resources as a dispatch operator when required, orchestrating responses and resolutions during emergencies with skill and composure.
  • Task Completion: Embrace a proactive attitude towards task completion, readily taking on any additional assignments delegated by management with dedication and efficiency.
  • Policy Adherence: Adhere strictly to Six Flags Fiesta Texas handbook policies at all times, setting the standard for professionalism and conduct while ensuring compliance with park regulations and protocols.

About the Role

As Loss Prevention Officer, you will improve company profitability by executing company programs around external theft deterrence and internal investigations to drive shortage reduction. You will influence associates to increase awareness of external theft and internal investigations.

What You’ll Do

Job Summary

To provide skilled administrative, operational, and program support related to police and security services for new programs and campus events as the University Police Department's Event Coordinator. Requires the ability to comprehend and implement policies and procedures, show strong initiative and work independently or with a group to make decisions relative to routine office operations. Requires the ability to exercise judgment within areas of delegated responsibility. Requires the ability to make sound decisions within university guidelines as well as initiative to suggest changes or updates.

Minimum Education and Experience

High school diploma or GED and a minimum of thirty (30) semester hours from an accredited college or university. One (1) year of continuous employment, part time or full time, as a police guard, dispatcher, telecommunications operator, other qualifying positions or other related experience with a component institution of the University of Texas System, as determined by the Chief of Police. Personal computer, calculator. Normal office conditions, occasional travel. Proficiency and accuracy in all phases of duties performed. Requires ability to develop a thorough knowledge of University structure, policies, rules and procedures and of appropriate business practices and techniques. Must possess a valid Texas driver's license and be eligible to drive a University owned and/or leased motor vehicle. Must successfully pass a thorough background investigation.

Preferred Education and Experience

Other Qualifications

To the extent this position requires the holder to research, work on, or have access to critical infrastructure as defined in Section 117.001(2) of the Texas Business and Commerce Code, the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the critical infrastructure is a minimum qualification to be hired and to continue to be employed in the position.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Maintain a schedule of pending campus events
  • Coordinate with key university managers on special event risk assessments
  • Coordinate and implement law enforcement/security functions
  • Communicate and brief operational plans with institution partners
  • Ensure appropriate safety and security measures are addressed and in place prior to major events on campus


Training Will Be Provided in the following, but not limited to:
  • National Incident Management System (NIMS)/Incident Command System (ICS)
  • Institution/Department Emergency Plans
  • Special Event Planning and Operations and Risk Assessment


Work with the department intelligence officer to monitor intelligence sources for relevant information that may affect the assessment rating and/or planning elements. If the risk assessment changes before the event, you will ensure the information is communicated appropriately to relevant institutional partners and necessary changes are made to account for the increased or decreased risk. Be able to communicate through the chain of command, the event plan as well as brief the officers involved.

Most of the work will be performed in normal office conditions, however outside activities/events could require your attendance. Must be able to adapt to university structure, policy, rules and regulations and be able to perform the job duties within those parameters. Must possess a valid Texas driver's license and be eligible to drive a university owned and/or leased motor vehicle. Must successfully pass a thorough background investigation.
