jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Dispatch Incident Intake in Richardson, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Commercial Real Estate, and more. As a Dispatch Officer at a commercial real estate location, you will coordinate communications, monitor security-related activity, document incidents, and support timely responses to calls for service. You will help maintain an organized environment while delivering exceptional customer service to tenants, visitors, and team members. Join Allied Universal, where agility, reliability, innovation, teamwork, caring, and integrity guide every shift.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $20.00 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTimeMon10:00 PM - 06:00 AMTue10:00 PM - 06:00 AMWed10:00 PM - 06:00 AMThur10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSun10:00 PM - 06:00 AM What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to tenants, visitors, employees, and/or vendors by carrying out site-specific procedures, access-control protocols, and emergency response activities at a commercial real estate location.
  • Monitor and dispatch security-related personnel to alarms, service requests, incidents, and critical situations, maintaining clear communication through radios, phones, and/or dispatch systems.
  • Receive, document, prioritize, and relay calls for assistance, maintenance-related concerns, and security-related incidents in a calm, problem-solving manner.
  • Maintain accurate dispatch logs, incident reports, visitor information, key and/or access-control records, and other site documentation in accordance with Allied Universal and location procedures.
  • Monitor cameras, alarms, and building systems as assigned, report unusual activity, and coordinate appropriate response personnel.
Minimum Requirements:
  • Have at least one year of security-related experience.
  • Be at least 21 years of age.
  • CPR/First Aid certification is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Access control and badge experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21 years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.
Why Join Us:
  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.title: Overnight Security Guard
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Monitor and patrol hotel property to ensure the safety of guests and employees to protect all hotel assets. Maintain a safe and secure environment by performing protective and enforcement functions in a courteous and restrained manner in coping with emergencies, undesired conduct, disturbances and threats to life and property.
Essential Job Functions

This description is a summary of primary responsibilities and qualifications. The job description is not intended to include all duties or qualifications that may be required now or in the future. The Hotel operates 24 hours a day and 7 days a week, so operational demands require variations in shift days, starting times, and hours worked in a week.
  • Spend majority of shift on foot patrol, walking, climbing stairs of the interior and perimeter of the hotel to observe and identify potential security and safety risks or undesirable conditions.
  • Requires verbal communication using pager and two-way radio, bending, stooping and kneeling as in performing CPR.
  • Maintain order in the hotel, dealing with the welfare of guests, e.g., assisting with door lock problems, coordinate expedient response to emergency conditions such as fire, fire or safety hazards and threats to life and/or property in a calm, rational and persuasive manner. Handle undesired conduct, violations of hotel policy and civil laws as warranted for the security and safety of hotel guests, employees, patrons and property. Requires grasping, lifting and or carrying or otherwise moving persons, packages, luggage, wheelchairs and safety equipment using manual dexterity of hands.
  • Answer security telephone and safety hotline calls and respond in a timely manner based on priority.
  • Use a clear, concise English-speaking voice, listen with empathy, provide accurate information and document legibly all appropriate incident information.
  • Memorize and monitor life safety system installed at property including layout of entire building, alarm pull stations, location of fire extinguisher and sprinklers.
  • Receive, record and store lost and found items. Research and respond to inquirers from guests concerning status of items.
  • Escort guests and employees as required to parking lots, provide same for employees carrying house banks.
  • Adheres to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follows safety and security procedures and rules.
  • Knows department fire prevention and emergency procedures.
  • Utilizes protective equipment.
  • Reports unsafe conditions to management.
  • Reports accidents, injuries, near-misses, property damage or loss to management.
  • Provides for a safe work environment by following all safety and security procedures and rules.
  • All team members must maintain a neat, clean and well-groomed appearance. (Specific standards outlined in team member handbook).
  • Assists other Front Desk Personnel when needed.
  • Perform any related duties as requested by management.


Qualifications
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

The Hotel may consider equivalent combination of acceptable education and experience providing the knowledge, skills and abilities cited below, when applicable.
  • Any combination of education and experience equivalent to graduation from high school or any other combination of education, training or experience that provides the required knowledge skills and abilities. High school diploma preferred.
  • Prior law enforcement or other military experience preferred.
  • Thorough knowledge of the layout of the building, function rooms, and some knowledge of the city and surrounding areas.
  • Ability to effectively deal with internal and external customers, some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact and diplomacy to defuse anger and collect accurate information.
  • Ability to listen effectively, speak, read and write English clearly to ascertain and document important information.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, sometimes under pressure, while remaining flexible and efficient while maintaining a pleasant cheerful demeanor.
  • Ability to follow written and or verbal instructions.
  • Ability to operate a computer, printer, copier, and telephone. Physical Demands
  • Ability to stand, walk and/or sit and continuously perform essential job functions for duration of shift.
  • Hearing and visual ability to observe and detect signs of emergency situations.
  • Ability to climb stairs and/or ladders at a rapid pace.
  • Perform tasks requiring bending, stooping, kneeling, and walking significant distances between and within buildings on the property.
  • Lifting up to 25 pounds.
  • Frequent twisting, bending, stooping, reaching, standing, walking, talking, hearing, seeing and smiling.

Benefits
  • 401(k)
  • Room Discounts
  • Employee Food and Beverage Discounts

Overview








Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, life insurance, a retirement plan, employee assistance programs, company discounts, and other perks, depending on the position and eligibility.

Job Description








As a Security Professional - Armed Retail Patrols PT in Austin, TX , you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Retail/Malls, and more.

Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you'll use our exclusive Claim a Shift platform to view and Pick up open shifts based on your availability-giving you the freedom to build a schedule that works for you, while gaining valuable site experience across various industries. Whether you're looking to supplement your income or take the first step toward a full-time role, this position offers unmatched access to hands-on experience and growth opportunities. As a Patrol Armed Officer with Allied Universal, you will play a key role in helping to deter security-related incidents at a bustling retail location. Your responsibilities will include conducting routine patrols, maintaining a visible presence, and providing outstanding customer service to all visitors and staff. This armed post offers the opportunity to engage with the public while upholding our values of integrity, teamwork, and reliability. Join a team that puts people first and is committed to creating a secure and welcoming environment through innovation and care.

Position Type: Part Time

Pay Rate: $26.50 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTimeWed02:45 PM - 11:30 PMThur03:15 PM - 11:30 PM

What You'll Do:

    Use our proprietary scheduling platform to claim open shifts at client sites

  • Support operations across a range of environments including commercial real estate, healthcare, and education
  • Receive site-specific training and guidance from experienced teams
  • Deliver consistent, professional security presence and customer service
  • Be ready to fill in at short notice when urgent needs arise

Responsibilities:

  • Provide customer service to clients and visitors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and responding to emergency situations as appropriate.
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, maintaining professionalism at all times.
  • Conduct regular and random armed patrols throughout the retail location and its perimeter to help to deter unauthorized activity and promote a secure environment.
  • Monitor entrances, exits, and other key areas within the retail environment to help to deter theft, vandalism, and/or other prohibited activities.
  • Document and report all security-related incidents, observations, and activities according to Allied Universal and site-specific protocols.
  • Collaborate with local law enforcement and/or emergency services as needed during incidents or emergencies.
  • Maintain a visible presence throughout the location to provide reassurance to clients, employees, and visitors.

What We're Looking For:

  • Availability across various days and shifts
  • Reliability and ability to adapt to different post assignments
  • A desire to gain broad experience and grow within the company
  • Interest in transitioning into full-time roles when available

Minimum Requirements:

  • Have at least three years of combined law enforcement, military, or security-related experience or possess a college degree.
  • Be at least 21 years of age.
  • Hold a Level III armed certification for Texas.
  • Possess a handcuffing certification, which is preferred.
  • Hold a CPR certification, which is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Flexible Scheduling: Choose from a variety of open shifts that align with your availability and lifestyle.
  • Career Growth: Clear path to full-time roles and ongoing advancement through paid training programs.
  • Smart Tools: Access exclusive technology for real-time shift visibility and claiming.
  • Full-Time Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k) plans, and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees.
  • Employee Perks: Enjoy discounts at restaurants, entertainment venues, and more through our perks program.

Allied Universal®, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

As a Security Guard Part Time Unarmed Walking Patrol in Chicago, IL, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Education, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As a Patrol Officer at a dynamic educational location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help discourage incidents, and support a welcoming environment for students, staff, and visitors. You will provide outstanding customer service, communicate clearly, and respond to security-related concerns with professionalism. Join Allied Universal's agile, reliable, innovative team, where a caring culture, teamwork, and integrity guide every shift.

Position Type: Part Time

Pay Rate: $19.50 / Hour

Job Schedule:
Day Time Wed 04:00 PM - 02:00 AM Thur 04:00 PM - 02:00 AM
What You'll Do:
  • Provide customer service to students, faculty, staff, visitors, and campus guests while carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of academic buildings, residence areas, common spaces, parking areas, and surrounding campus grounds to help identify and report unusual activity, hazards, and maintenance concerns.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established campus protocols and contacting appropriate personnel as needed.
  • Monitor access points and assist with visitor direction, access control procedures, and enforcement of site-specific rules and regulations.
  • Prepare clear, accurate reports and maintain communication with Allied Universal leadership and campus representatives regarding incidents, observations, and shift activities.

Minimum Requirements:
  • Proof of a high school diploma or GED is required by the client.
  • Be at least 21 years of age.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:
  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.


Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com .

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices .

jobs.title: Copy of Experienced Level III Commissioned Security Officer (School Campus Assignment)
jobs.description:
Overview

Valor Force (#C19105) is a private security and investigations company committed to providing a quality product with exceptional service. Our motto is simple, "Put the needs of our clients first." Our services are customized to meet and exceed the needs of our clients as we are trained to protect while maintaining a professional work ethic, ensuring our clients are safe. We are a security company that protects with integrity and excellence. Corporate events, security consultation, church services, and personal protection are a few of the areas where we provide Valor protection.

1485 Richardson Dr., Suite 170

Richardson, TX 75080

Job Skills / Requirements

About the Opportunity

We are seeking professional, disciplined, and experienced Level III Commissioned Security Officers to support school-based safety and protection. This role is ideal for officers who take pride in their appearance, communication, and tactical readiness — and who want to work in a mission-driven environment that values professionalism and leadership.

If you want to make a meaningful impact on campus safety while working alongside educators, families, and law enforcement, this is the position for you.

What You’ll Do

As a commissioned officer assigned to a school campus, you will:

  • Serve as a visible, trusted security presence for students and staff
  • Conduct interior and exterior patrols
  • Respond to incidents, disturbances, and emergencies
  • Maintain strong communication and de-escalation standards
  • Prepare accurate and timely incident and daily activity reports
  • Partner closely with school administrators and local law enforcement
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and situational awareness
  • Uphold the highest standards of professionalism and accountability

This is a position where your demeanor and decision-making matter as much as your tactical skill set

Minimum Requirements

To be considered, candidates must have:

  • Active Texas DPS Level III Commissioned License
  • 21+ years of age
  • High School diploma or GED
  • Valid Texas driver’s license
  • Reliable transportation and a working mobile phone
  • Strong firearm handling and safety proficiency
  • Ability to pass background screening and physical fitness assessment
  • Strong writing, communication, and observation skills
  • Ability to work independently with professionalism and integrity

Disqualifiers (No Exceptions)

  • Felony conviction within 10 years
  • Class A Misdemeanor within 5 years
  • Class B Misdemeanor within 2 years
  • Any domestic/family violence conviction
  • Any open charges or deferred adjudication for felony or Class A/B misdemeanor

Required Duty Gear (Officer-Provided)

  • Service-caliber duty firearm (Glock, SIG Sauer, S&W, H&K — 9mm/.40/.45)
  • Level III retention holster no dropdown or thigh holster
  • Full duty belt setup
  • OD Green tactical pants
  • Flashlight, handcuffs, and other standard duty accessories

Preferred Experience

We strongly value applicants with:

  • Prior military or law enforcement background
  • Previous school security or SRO-style experience
  • Advanced firearm proficiency
  • Demonstrated report writing excellence
  • Strong interpersonal, conflict-resolution, and leadership skills

Schedule & Physical Standards

  • Must be able to work all shifts, including weekends or holidays if required
  • Must maintain a clean-cut, professional appearance
  • Ability to walk, stand, run, climb, or sit for extended periods

WE LOVE OUR WORK.

BRING US YOUR BEST.

jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description:
The MFAH is an organization that is more than 100 years old and ranks nationally among the top 10 art museums in exhibition space, memberships, endowments, and attendance. The MFAH is a multifaceted institution comprising multiple gallery buildings, a sculpture garden, two art schools, and two house-museums for decorative arts. The encyclopedic collection numbers more than 65,000 works of art in a wide range of media. As an employer, MFAH offers a supportive, collegial and inclusive work environment and a competitive benefits package.

The MFAH is currently seeking a dependable, protection professional with demonstrated leadership skills and a strong sense of integrity. The Security Manager plays the critical role of leading a team of Security Officers who are tasked with protecting objects on display and maintaining order in their assigned galleries or those assigned to maintain order, reduce injury, assist visitors, and reduce property loss at the Museum.

Position Available:

Title:                                                      Security Manager

Reports to:                                         Assistant Head of Security - Galleries 

Classification:                                     Exempt

Schedule:                                            40-hour work week  (Wed-Sun but they will be required to work on Monday holidays and occasionally on other days as well as an overnight position Friday through Tuesday. 

Overtime:                                           No

Work Location:                                 All MFAH Facilities

Salary:                                                $49,490/yr

Job Summary:

The Security Manager reports directly to the Assistant Head of Security Galleries and is responsible for providing day-to-day leadership to a team of security officers. 

As the first level of management, the Security Manager is the face of the department to guests, volunteers, and staff. In this role, you will oversee teams of security officers who are responsible for ensuring both the physical security of the facilities and its assets, as well as the safety of all occupants the protection of Museum gallery spaces, the objects therein and the safety of all occupants by observing, reporting, and responding to activities within their assigned galleries.

Leadership Responsibilities:

  • Provide direct leadership to team of up to 20 Security Officers
  • Conduct roll call, take attendance and make daily post assignments
  • Counsel Security Officers, both verbally and in writing, related to job performance
  • Partner with the AHSO to complete performance evaluations
  • Complete written reports on security- and safety-related incidents
  • Conduct individual and group training sessions on security related topics
  • Conduct Security briefings and orientations for new Security team members as needed
  • Implement museum and security department policies and procedures fairly and consistently
  • Mentor, train, and develop staff.
  • Maintain a visible presence in assigned galleries to provide leadership and assist Museum guests.
  • Create a detailed end-of-shift report containing relevant daily information to share with incoming Security Manager(s) and Security Officers to ensure all shifts are informed of museum activities and incidents

General Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for coordinating and supervising the daily operations of the MFAH’s Security Officers; this includes daily report writing, security officer scheduling, performance management, payroll processing and the completion of comprehensive incident reports
  • Ensure security officers maintain a neat and tidy appearance at all times in accordance with established security department guidelines and carry required equipment
  • Accountable for the personal safety of all occupants of any MFAH-owned facilities and ensures the protection of all MFAH-owned assets
  • Verifies all third-parties (such as caterers, vendors, contractors, and other affiliates) follow MFAH Security policies and procedures and is able to apply corrective measures as necessary
  • Interact with guests to give directions, provide information and consistently enforce museum rules
  • Thoroughly and routinely conducts the MFAH Security opening and closing procedures for all MFAH-owned properties, ensuring that all facilities remain secure
  • Serves as a member of the museum emergency response team, this position is designated as an Essential Employee and may be required to report to work, or to remain at work, during inclement weather or other emergency situations
  • Provides guidance, solutions, and resources for all MFAH staff, and its affiliates, in relation to Security procedural issues or incidents and ensures the adherence of all MFAH Security procedures, processes, and policies
  • Appropriately escalates Security issues and work performance issues to the proper personnel as necessary
  • Ensure adherence to department procedures, processes, and policies
  • Maintains and fosters effective working relationships with individuals and departments across a variety of areas within the MFAH
  • Participate in department projects and initiatives and provide knowledge and leadership in cross-functional project teams
  • Act as a resource for staff on procedural questions and concerns; provide solutions and escalate certain issues to the appropriate personnel
  • Receive, address, and record accolades, comments and complaints from guests
  • Manages and monitors Security staffing to ensure an adequate level of security coverage is provided at all times
  • Issue and collect equipment such as uniforms, radios and keys
  • Ensure security officers understand and comply with post and special orders, department policies and operating procedures
  • Take charge of assigned areas during building evacuations and other emergencies; ensure that security officers are knowledgeable of emergency procedures

Skills, Knowledge, Abilities:

  • Strong customer service mindset with ability to interact with the public to analyze situations and anticipate needs of guests
  • Demonstrated track record of managing a diverse work force, including hiring, training and motivating staff
  • Must be proficient in English, both written and verbal communications skills
  • Present a neat and tidy appearance at all times in accordance with established security department guidelines
  • Ability to write clear concise preliminary investigative reports, interview witnesses, victims, etc.
  • Flexibility to work various shifts if needed and to work special events going past shifts schedule
  • Sound decision-making abilities
  • Ability to obtain and maintain First Responder, CPR and other related certifications on a yearly basis
  • Ability to administer First Aid and CPR, including carrying first aid equipment and assisting with lifting and moving victims, if required
  • Possess outstanding customer service skills and the ability to remain calm in the face of diverse and high stress encounters, i.e.: fire, medical emergency, extremely aggravated guests, and workplace violence situations
  • Possess basic computer skills and be able to learn software applications used by the department
  • Ability to use radios, telephones and other equipment that may be assigned
  • May be designated as “essential personnel” and required to report to work or remain at work during inclement weather or other emergency situations

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or five years of related experience

jobs.title: Security Officer (Flex) (Security)
jobs.description:
Overview

Join the guard company that specializes in Texas!

Our name says it all - GuardTexas. We have been committed to serving the great state of Texas since 1976, providing security officers to clients across industries including commercial real estate, construction, retail, and residential communities. Our private ownership and deep Texas roots give us the flexibility to plan and provide growth not found in smaller or international companies. We are a certified security guard trainer and train our hires free of charge to help you obtain your license.

Job Skills / Requirements

FLEX OFFICER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have an valid / active Level II or III Security License
  • Must be flexible with an open availability (Any day/shift)
  • At least 25 years old
  • Valid TX DL of 3 years
  • No "At Fault" accidents or tickets in the past 3 years
  • Must have reliable transportation.
  • Meet and maintain all requirements of LEVEL II licensing for Non-Commissioned Security Officers including passing a background check as required by the Texas PSB
  • Communicate effectively in English, orally and in writing
  • Visual acuity and hearing ability to observe and otherwise obtain information from all relevant sources
  • Ability to perform general physical activities that require considerable use of arms, legs, and/or moving the entire body, such as climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, stooping, sitting, standing for long periods of time, and handling of materials
  • This is a part time position with part time hours that could lead to a full time position. Hours will be determined at interview.

As a Private Security FLEX (or Flex Officer) you need to be a versatile security professional who provides security services across multiple client sites, often on an as-needed basis, and can be on-call with short notice. You will not have a set schedule typically. The flexibility to adapt to different locations and unpredictable schedules is a defining aspect of this role.

Core Duties:

Patrolling: Conducting regular foot or vehicle patrols to observe and secure assigned areas, ensuring all entry points are secure and monitoring for potential security threats.

Access Control: Controlling entry to a property by checking identification, verifying credentials, and enforcing security protocols for employees, visitors, and contractors.

Surveillance: Monitoring and operating surveillance equipment, such as CCTV cameras, to identify security risks and suspicious behavior.

Emergency Response: Promptly responding to security alarms, incidents, or emergencies, and taking appropriate actions to mitigate risks and ensure safety.

Reporting and Documentation: Writing detailed reports of observed incidents, actions taken, and any security breaches for internal use and client records.

Key Skills and Qualities:

Versatility: The ability to work across various client sites and adapt to different environments and security needs.

Flexibility: Readiness to work on-call or with short notice and cover different shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Observance and Vigilance: The ability to stay alert, notice unusual activities, and meticulously document observations.

Problem-Solving: Effectively assessing situations and making sound decisions under pressure to resolve security issues.

Communication: Clearly communicating with individuals, groups, and emergency services, both verbally and in writing.

Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with operating security systems, surveillance equipment, and communication devices like radios and computers.

Customer Service: Interacting professionally with clients, employees, and visitors, providing assistance and maintaining a positive presence.

What They Do:

Deter criminal activity: through their visible presence.

Protect people and property: from theft, vandalism, and other illegal activities.

Enforce rules and regulations: of the employer or client's property.

Verify credentials: and control access to secure areas.

Respond to alarms and emergencies, contacting police, fire, or ambulance services when necessary.

Education Requirements (All)

High School Diploma or Equivalent

Certification Requirements (All)

Non-commissioned Security Officer

Additional Information / Benefits

We offer a range of competitive benefits for our security officers:

  • Weekly paychecks with a no-fee pay card available that offers a range of free benefits
  • Additional pay for worked holidays
  • Access to credit union membership for you and your family
  • Insurance is available the first day of the month after 60 days of full time employment
  • After one year of full time employment, you qualify for paid vacation, reimbursement of uniform fees, and Company payment of PSB fees to maintain a current registration

Benefits: Life Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Paid Vacation

jobs.title: Security Officer
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Hillwood, a Perot Company, is a premier real estate investment and development company founded on a culture of integrity, respect, excellence and teamwork. The company is a full-service real estate developer, investor and advisor focused on developing opportunities for investors, partners and communities around the world. See additional details at www.hillwood.com.

Position Summary:

Hillwood is currently seeking a highly professional and disciplined Security Officer to join its in‑house security team at the corporate headquarters in Dallas, TX. This veteran‑friendly organization has built an elite security team responsible for providing protective services for the facility, associates, guests, and family. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, Hillwood supports continued education by supplementing tuition costs beyond available federal and state funding. This role is ideal for an individual seeking long‑term growth and professional development, with the opportunity to transition into additional roles across the Perot Companies over time.

Responsibilities:

Protective Services and Site Security:

  • Provide a safe and secure environment for associates, guests, and visitors by staffing various security posts and working assigned shifts.
  • Secure premises and protect personnel through routine patrols of buildings and surrounding property.
  • Maintain familiarity with high‑profile individuals and guests as required.
  • Transport high‑profile guests and personnel in support of protective operations.

Monitoring, Response and Investigation:

  • Monitor surveillance systems, access controls, and alarm systems.
  • Respond to alarms, calls for service, and emergency situations.
  • Investigate suspicious behavior, incidents, and potential security threats.
  • Document and report incidents, observations, and activities accurately and thoroughly.

Communication and Coordination:

  • Maintain effective communication with other security officers, supervisors, and internal staff.
  • Use radios, mobile devices, and other technology to support security operations.
  • Answer telephone calls and provide information during non‑business hours as required.
  • Coordinate and work closely with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies when necessary.

Training, Readiness and Professional Standards:

  • Maintain required firearm proficiency, emergency medical training, and other security‑related certifications.
  • Remain prepared to respond to unexpected emergency situations and special events.
  • Support team objectives and contribute to a disciplined, professional security culture.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to operate effectively in a structured environment with established procedures, protocols, and expectations.
  • Strong situational awareness and sound judgment with the ability to assess risk and respond appropriately to evolving situations.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, discipline, and composure when interacting with associates, guests, high‑profile individuals, and external partners.
  • Ability to follow post orders, policies, and directives while maintaining flexibility in dynamic or time‑sensitive situations.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly document incidents and observations.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also operating independently when assigned.
  • High level of integrity, discretion, and respect for confidentiality.
  • Comfort using radios, mobile devices, surveillance systems, and other security‑related technology.
  • Dependable, punctual, and able to maintain consistent performance across varying shifts and operational demands.

Education and Experience:

  • Hillwood actively supports continued education and encourages team members to pursue a college degree.
  • Prior U.S. military service strongly preferred.
  • Experience providing security services in U.S. embassies, government facilities, military installations, or similar high‑security environments.
  • Background in access control, patrol operations, surveillance, emergency response, or protective services highly desirable.

Physical Requirements:

  • Each officer will present themselves in a welcoming manner and conservative appearance.
  • Ability to maintain firearm proficiency, emergency medical and other security related training.
  • Maintain Texas Class C driver’s license and operate a motor vehicle and other equipment as needed.
  • Must maintain a Texas Department of Public Safety Level 4 security officer certification.
  • Maintain a clean and presentable appearance without facial hair.

Benefits Highlights:

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
  • Vacation time
  • Sick time
  • Holidays
  • Paid family caregiver leave
  • Mental health and wellness resources
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Tuition assistance
  • Additional programs to support Associates and their families

EEO Statement:

Hillwood is committed to providing Equal Opportunity in Employment, to all applicants and employees regardless of, race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, handicap, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate - 2nd Shift - Days Off: Tuesdays & Wednesdays
jobs.description:
Warehouse Associate - 2nd Shift

Warehouse associates will ensure the needs of both production and warehouse are met throughout their respective shifts by the timely and safe delivery, shipping, and receiving of produce and packaged goods.

Detailed Responsibilities

Receiving

  • Will apply glad hand lock and wheel chocks for any trailer to unload
  • Will assist FSQA and receivers with breakdown of pallets for quality checks and to transport to storage
  • When produce or packaged good are received in the associate will place produce/packaged goods into correct storage
  • Placed produce/packaging must be staged according to FIFO and in correct temperature storage location and remove any plastic from produce that needs to breathe
  • Notify leadership if any product is found to be out of correct location
  • Work on creating space for inbound loads
  • Ensure all storage pods are kept free of debris

Replenishing

  • Set floor for decanting and shipping lines per drop list and boxing call out
  • All packaging material is set for box team, shipping lines, and decanting area
  • Prior to production running completely out of product, the warehouse associate will bring out the requested material according to the production's count.
  • Answer call of any additional product needs for production
  • Move anything needed for production, warehouse, sanitation, or FSQA
  • Prior to leaving for any break, warehouse associates will check with the production team as well as make a visual check of produce/packaging in use to ensure the area is fully stocked before leaving production area.
  • Near the end of each shift remove any material from the drop zone as well as the return area that production will not use for the incoming shift. All product is returned to home location
  • Ensure all pallets in storage are front faced, leveled, and plastic removed
  • Warehouse associate is responsible for organization of assigned storage areas

Shipping

  • Check all trailers loaded on the shipping dock for trash or pine pallets, remove any items found that are not needed for completed shipments
  • Put on glad hand lock on trailer and chock wheels prior to being loaded
  • Using the load diagram form load trucks with completed pallets with management approval - full load 26 pallets
  • Once the trailer has been fully loaded, place a FedEx seal on the closed trailer door to signify ready for ship and put the serial number for the load seal on the load diagram form and we remove the glad hand lock. Turn in paperwork to leadership

Support other Warehouse functions

  • We are one team. Team members are expected to assist with completing any function needed for our company to deliver finished goods to the customer. This includes using any equipment certified on or assisting other departments to get the job done for the day.

General Responsibilities

  • Follow all safety procedures throughout execution of all tasks. This includes, but is not limited to, performing pre-shift equipment checks for all equipment used and wearing required PPE. Safety first!
  • Follow the facility GMPs and help enforce them throughout the facility.
  • Sign for all equipment needed to perform your duties. Ensure these are signed back in upon completion of shift.
  • Support the efforts of the company to maintain our food safety system (SQF) and quality programs. Quality always!
  • Be respectful of others. Team members are expected to carry themselves in a professional manner in all situations and at all times.

Qualifications

  • General high school degree, or equivalent, (e.g. GED). GED or High School diploma required
  • Willing to learn how to operate equipment needed to perform all warehouse duties including, but not limited to, manual and electric pallet jack and hand held scanners.
  • Able to lift up to 50lbs
  • Previous warehouse experience preferred

Additionally, we have been named a 2026 Training MVP by Training Magazine, marking the third consecutive year we have accepted this prestigious recognition. We also continue to be celebrated for our steady growth and stability on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.


At the heart of everything we do are our core values of honor, integrity, and trust. If you are searching for a rewarding career with a proactive security partner that protects some of the country’s leading organizations, we invite you to explore the possibilities at Sunstates Security. Join a successful, growing team where your talent is appreciated and have opportunities to advance your professional career.


HIRING IMMEDIATELY


Sunstates Security is hiring Armed Security Officers in the Austin, Texas area. All days and shifts are available! These positions offer a pay rate of $30.00/hr, with weekly pay.


Job Requirements

Requirements:

  • Level 4 Security License in hand
  • Active DoD security clearance preferred
  • U.S. Citizenship required
  • Former law enforcement or military highly preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of supervisory or leadership experience in a security, law enforcement, or military environment

  • Complete accurate hourly and daily activity and incident reports
  • Conduct periodic site security inspections and report deficiencies to management

Benefits

Industry-leading employee benefits that include weekly pay, 401k savings plan with a company match, affordable medical, dental & vision benefits, employee referral bonuses, paid time off, premium holiday pay, tuition reimbursement, and more – available for qualified candidates!

jobs.description:
Overview

Security Officer- Overnight (Texas Level 2 Certified)

Job Type: Seasonal
Pay Rate: $14.75/hr.
Category: Public Safety
Location: Six Flags Fiesta Texas in San Antonio, Texas

WHAT WE PROVIDE:

This is a seasonal overnight Security Officer position at Six Flags Fiesta Texas, in San Antonio, TX. It features a competitive hourly rate of $14.75 (with an additional $1 per hour for working the hours between 12am-8am) with perks such as: Free entry to any Six Flags Park for all employees and a guest with each visit, additional complimentary tickets for friends and family, discount on food and merchandise for all employees, flexible scheduling, Dayforce Wallet access for earned wage access, and bi-weekly pay.

Responsibilities

Join the exhilarating world of Six Flags Fiesta Texas as an Overnight Security Officer, where you'll be the fearless protector of our vibrant park! With your State of Texas Level 2 license, you'll embark on thrilling patrols, ensuring the safety and security of our premises. From swiftly responding to security incidents to expertly screening guests at the front gate, you'll be at the heart of our security operations, upholding our commitment to excellence. With every assignment tackled with precision and passion, you'll play a pivotal role in creating unforgettable experiences for our guests and maintaining the highest standards of safety throughout the park.

HOW YOU WILL DO IT:

  • Gate Security: Employ meticulous verification processes to ensure only authorized personnel and vehicles access the park, verifying identification and passes with precision.
  • Confidentiality: Demonstrate unwavering commitment to confidentiality by carefully safeguarding sensitive information encountered during patrols or incidents, upholding the trust placed in you.
  • Rapid Response: Be ready to spring into action at a moment's notice, responding promptly and decisively to security-related incidents within the park to mitigate risks and ensure the safety of guests and staff.
  • Documentation: Utilize your exceptional communication skills to write clear, concise, and comprehensive reports detailing incidents and the actions taken, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  • Law Enforcement Compliance: Execute your duties with a firm commitment to upholding local, state, and federal laws on park property, ensuring a safe and compliant environment for all.
  • Asset Protection: Exercise vigilance and proactive measures to safeguard company assets, property, and facilities against potential threats and illegal activities, acting as a steadfast guardian of the park's resources.
  • Traffic Control (as required): Assume control of traffic operations with precision and efficiency, managing vehicular flow and ensuring the safety of guests during peak times and special events.
  • Patrol Proficiency: Conduct thorough and systematic vehicle and bike patrols throughout the park, covering all areas to detect and deter potential security threats effectively.
  • Collaborative Approach: Foster strong partnerships with on-duty law enforcement personnel, facilitating seamless cooperation and coordination in maintaining park security and responding to incidents.
  • Dispatch Operations (as needed): Demonstrate proficiency in managing communications and resources as a dispatch operator when required, orchestrating responses and resolutions during emergencies with skill and composure.
  • Task Completion: Embrace a proactive attitude towards task completion, readily taking on any additional assignments delegated by management with dedication and efficiency.
  • Policy Adherence: Adhere strictly to Six Flags Fiesta Texas handbook policies at all times, setting the standard for professionalism and conduct while ensuring compliance with park regulations and protocols.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Must be available to work overnight from 12 A.M.- 8 A.M.
  • Must be a high school graduate or possess GED.
  • Must posses a valid Drivers License.
  • Must have a valid Texas Level 2 Security License.
  • Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods of time in South Texas Weather.
  • Must be willing and able to perform foot and bike patrols.
  • Must be willing and able to perform foot and bike patrols.
  • Must be able to climb a 50' tower.
  • Previous security related experience preferred.
  • Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Organized with the ability to multi-task.
  • Safety conscious, mature, reliable and dependable.
  • Outgoing and friendly demeanor.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both oral and written.
  • Must be able to work flexible shifts including but not limited to overtime, weekends and some holidays.

OTHER NOTES

  • May perform other duties beyond scope of above as necessary to support the park as a whole
  • Reports to the Public Safety Department Leadership

jobs.title: Field Training Officer PSOC
jobs.description:
About the role


As our Field Training Officer, you’ll lead a strategic 12-month initiative to strengthen how we train our PSOC teams across the account. You’ll assess current training needs, design role-based learning pathways, develop standardized content, and bring consistency to PSOC training worldwide. A central part of your work will be creating a brand-new onboarding program for Watch Officers and Watch Supervisors — everything from training objectives and curriculum structure to hands-on exercises, skills validation, and ongoing learning resources.


In addition, you will support our Mobile Security Operations program, providing broader training support across multiple sub-regions with increased travel.


You’ll report to the Field Training Manager and work side by side with PSOC Managers, Security Operations leadership, client stakeholders, and our global training teams. While you won’t have direct reports, you’ll have real influence over training strategy and operational excellence. The ideal person for this role blends strong instructional design skills with practical PSOC experience, and brings a structured, data-driven approach to everything they build.


What you’ll do


You’ll lead the design and rollout of a new PSOC onboarding program that reflects how our operations really work, the technical skills our teams need, and what our client expects. As the go-to expert for PSOC training, you’ll get out into the field — visiting sites, interviewing people, observing operations, and running assessments — to understand where the gaps are and turn what you learn into practical, structured learning solutions.


You’ll build and maintain training that uses a mix of delivery methods: online courses in our Learning Management System (LMS), instructor-led and virtual sessions, hands-on operational training, quick-reference job aids and performance support, and skills validation and certification programs. Your training will connect directly to the core PSOC systems and processes our teams rely on every day, including access control, video management systems (VMS), alarm monitoring platforms, incident management tools, and dispatch workflows.


Beyond building the program, you’ll measure how well it’s working through audits and performance metrics and use what you find to recommend ways to improve consistency, compliance, and operational performance. You’ll partner closely with PSOC leadership to strengthen onboarding, deepen technical capability, and keep learning long after day one — all while keeping stakeholders informed with regular updates, insights, and recommendations throughout the program. Once the PSOC initiative is complete, you’ll bring that same expertise to Mobile Security Operations, supporting onboarding, certification, and sustainment training across regions.


What you need to apply


You’ll be a great fit if you have an associate’s degree plus three or more years of relevant experience in security operations, training, or a related field or equivalent experience that shows you know your craft. You should have designed and delivered training in operational environments before, and you bring strong technical aptitude and a real knack for solving problems.


It’s a plus if you’ve worked in a Physical Security Operations Center, know your way around access control systems (such as Lenel), VMS, and alarm monitoring platforms, have built LMS-based learning content, or have led projects or program rollouts. You should be comfortable with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint), Teams, SharePoint, and Learning Management Systems. And because you’ll work closely with client representatives, operational leaders, and global teams, strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills are essential. Attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset are key to thriving in this role. You’ll need to excel at prioritizing tasks effectively and anticipate the needs of the team to stay ahead of the curve. You will need effective communication and a proactive, adaptable mindset in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.


This position involves travel (up to 50% of the time), so a passion for travel (and a valid passport) and the flexibility to accommodate domestic and international trips are a must. It will also require you to work nights and weekends on occasion, so you’ll need to be comfortable flexing your schedule when needed.


All applicants to this role must have reliable means of communication, reliable means of transportation (public or private) to get to/from work, the legal right to work in the country where the position is located, and the ability to speak, read and write in English proficiently.


What you’ll get


We offer more than just a job; we offer the chance to be part of a collaborative and supportive team where your contributions are valued and your growth matters. In this role, you will thrive in a dynamic environment while supporting a prestigious multinational client account. You will gain exposure to global operations and cross-regional collaboration, and you will have access to continuous learning, training programs, and career development opportunities designed to help you succeed.


The extra stuff


Candidates must be at least 18 years old, legally authorized to work in the job location, and willing to complete the company’s pre‑employment screening, including a background check and drug screening. This role may require evening, overnight, or weekend work, particularly during emergencies or high‑priority events. Work may occur in outdoor or inclement weather or environments requiring protective gear and heightened safety awareness. This position requires—with or without reasonable accommodation—the physical and mental ability to perform all essential job functions effectively. This includes maintaining composure under pressure while interacting with clients, authorities, executives, and staff; working independently without direct supervision; and managing multiple tasks simultaneously. The role involves regular use of a computer and keyboard, frequent lifting or moving of items up to 10 pounds, and occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds. Visual acuity for both near and far distances, as well as the ability to adjust focus, is required. The position may involve handling sensitive or confidential information and requires flexibility in scheduling to meet operational demands.

A central part of your work will be creating a brand-new onboarding program for Watch Officers and Watch Supervisors — everything from training objectives and curriculum structure to hands-on exercises, skills validation, and ongoing learning resources
In addition, you will support our Mobile Security Operations program, providing broader training support across multiple sub-regions with increased travel
You’ll report to the Field Training Manager and work side by side with PSOC Managers, Security Operations leadership, client stakeholders, and our global training teams
While you won’t have direct reports, you’ll have real influence over training strategy and operational excellence
The ideal person for this role blends strong instructional design skills with practical PSOC experience, and brings a structured, data-driven approach to everything they build
You’ll lead the design and rollout of a new PSOC onboarding program that reflects how our operations really work, the technical skills our teams need, and what our client expects

As the go-to expert for PSOC training, you’ll get out into the field — visiting sites, interviewing people, observing operations, and running assessments — to understand where the gaps are and turn what you learn into practical, structured learning solutions

You’ll build and maintain training that uses a mix of delivery methods: online courses in our Learning Management System (LMS), instructor-led and virtual sessions, hands-on operational training, quick-reference job aids and performance support, and skills validation and certification programs

Your training will connect directly to the core PSOC systems and processes our teams rely on every day, including access control, video management systems (VMS), alarm monitoring platforms, incident management tools, and dispatch workflows

Beyond building the program, you’ll measure how well it’s working through audits and performance metrics and use what you find to recommend ways to improve consistency, compliance, and operational performance

You’ll partner closely with PSOC leadership to strengthen onboarding, deepen technical capability, and keep learning long after day one — all while keeping stakeholders informed with regular updates, insights, and recommendations throughout the program
Once the PSOC initiative is complete, you’ll bring that same expertise to Mobile Security Operations, supporting onboarding, certification, and sustainment training across regions
Attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset are key to thriving in this role
It will also require you to work nights and weekends on occasion, so you’ll need to be comfortable flexing your schedule when needed
In this role, you will thrive in a dynamic environment while supporting a prestigious multinational client account

Job Summary

We are seeking a bilingual dedicated and energetic Janitorial Specialist to maintain cleanliness and safety within a busy warehouse environment. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the facility remains spotless, sanitized, and well-maintained, supporting a safe and efficient workspace for all team members. Your proactive approach to cleaning, equipment handling, and safety adherence will help uphold our high standards of sanitation and facility upkeep. This position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals with janitorial or custodial experience who thrive in fast-paced settings and take pride in their work.

Duties

  • Perform comprehensive cleaning tasks across the warehouse, including sweeping, mopping, dusting, and trash removal to maintain a tidy environment.
  • Operate various cleaning equipment such as floor buffers, scrubbers, and vacuums to ensure optimal floor care and sanitation.
  • Handle chemical agents safely by following proper chemical handling safety procedures, including mixing, storage, and disposal.
  • Conduct heavy lifting and manual handling of cleaning supplies, equipment, and waste materials while adhering to safe lifting practices.
  • Maintain sanitation standards by disinfecting high-touch surfaces and ensuring compliance with safety protocols at all times.
  • Support facilities maintenance activities such as minor repairs or reporting issues that require specialized attention.
  • Assist with industrial cleaning tasks including the use of specialized tools for large-scale cleaning projects in the warehouse setting.
  • Provide excellent customer service by responding promptly to cleaning requests or concerns from team members or supervisors.

Experience

  • Prior janitorial or custodial experience in a commercial or industrial setting is preferred.
  • Proven ability to operate cleaning equipment such as floor buffers and scrubbers effectively.
  • Knowledge of chemical agent handling safety procedures and sanitation standards.
  • Experience with heavy lifting and manual handling in a warehouse or facilities environment.
  • Familiarity with safety protocol adherence related to custodial work, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Background in facilities maintenance or industrial cleaning is advantageous.
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to maintaining high cleanliness standards in busy environments.

This is a GREAT part time or secondary job - it's an event-based schedule, so you can schedule yourself to work when you are able!

Support our stadium, arena, convention center, and theatre clients in their security needs and be an integral part of the facility's needs by observing and reporting activities and incidents, as well as providing security and safety to both the venue's property and personnel. Event Security must possess and maintain professional image and help make our clients' venues places where fans can have an unforgettable and safe experience.

  • Delivery of quality service and positive interaction with our customers is critical to the completion of all the tasks within this job description. The ability to greet all visitors, vendors, and employees while continuously maintaining the standards of excellence in presentation and professionalism. Customer Service is Every Employee's Job!

jobs.title: Security Technician (Data Centers) - Dallas, TX
jobs.description:
Convergint is looking for a full-time, enthusiastic, results driven and forward-thinking Security Technician to join our amazing culture. In this role, you will install, program, system start-up/check-out, certify, and customer train on assigned projects including small to large projects that vary in complexity. As a Security Technician, you are a part of a dynamic team that allows you to grow as Convergint grows.

For information about how we use your personal information, please see our Colleague & Applicant Privacy Notice, available on convergint.com/careers.

Who You Are

You have a passion for providing world-class service to customers, colleagues and communities. You are a person of integrity with a commitment to growth, accountability and delivering results. You want to join an organization with a positive culture that embraces equal opportunity and allows everyone to be the best version of themselves at work and home. You want to grow with us and deliver results as an exceptional Security Technician.

Who We Are

With 20-years of proven growth and exceptional performance, our mission is to be our customer’s best service provider. We realize the importance of diversity in achieving that goal. Our company was built upon a solid foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs which drive our unmatched culture, making us the #1 global, serviced-based systems integrator in the industry. We take great pride in protecting the lives and assets of our customers and their communities with the solutions we provide.

What you’ll do with “Our Training and Your Experience”

  • Convergint's greatest strength is our people! Every colleague is encouraged to participate in our Recruit Awesome People program, helping us grow Convergint by promoting our colleague-first culture and referring top talent to the Talent Acquisition Team and hiring managers.
  • Installs, programs, test, repairs, and services a variety of non-routine systems and equipment which may include security, fire alarm & life safety, and/or building automation. Colleague is key interface for the provision of technical support and training for the customer and as such is accountable for maximizing customer satisfaction. Refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.
  • Reads basic blueprints, schematics, manuals, and other specifications to determine installation procedures; Interprets manuals, schematics, and wiring diagrams, and repairs equipment, utilizing knowledge of electronics and using standard test instruments and hand tools.
  • Operates systems to demonstrate equipment, commission new systems, analyze performance and identify malfunctions. Writes a variety of non-routine programs for systems.
  • Acts as “our customer’s best service provider” at all times thereby ensuring Convergint Technologies is the customer’s first choice for service.
  • Consults with engineering personnel to resolve unusual problems in system operation, maintenance, and warranty work.
  • May advise management regarding customer satisfaction, product performance, installation techniques and standards as well as suggestions for product improvements.
  • Executes most of the technical aspects of multiple projects with varying timelines and budgets including programming, graphics development, start-up, certification testing, customer training, close-out documentation, and on-going technical support etc..
  • Identifies potential project risks, communicates to appropriate parties and assist in the development and implementation of strategies to minimize impact and to control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines.
  • Works closely with the Project Manager and/or Operations Manager and assists in the overall coordination of specific projects; makes recommendations regarding quality of work and potential changes in scope, and identifies ways to continuously improve customer satisfaction.
  • Using technical knowledge, skills and experience, acts as a mentor to less experienced staff. May supervise workers in testing, tuning, and adjusting equipment to obtain optimum operating performance.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested or required.

What You’ll Need

  • Exceptional customer focus and ability to work under pressure; ability to maintain awareness of and seek to meet the needs and wants of the customer without being prompted.
  • Solid technical skills and experience fire alarm systems, and/or electronic security systems.
  • Solid programming skills and proven ability to troubleshoot problems and look for solutions
  • To be a self-starter and work well with minimal supervision.
  • Solid mechanical and electrical aptitude (e.g. works with a variety of hand and power tools such as drill, screwdriver, wire stripper, hacksaw, crimper) and ability to read blueprints and drawings; solid math skills (for some positions, this may include calculating area, velocity, resistance, voltage, etc.).
  • Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Solid organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Advanced computer skills including familiarity with MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel) and proficient in other relevant applications.
  • A valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.
  • Ability to travel locally to jobsites on a regular basis. Minimal overnight travel may be required.

Company Benefits

Convergint fosters a supportive, accessible, and inclusive environment in which all individuals are able to realize their maximum potential within the company. We offer a variety of programs and exceptional benefits:

  • 10 Company Holidays and Paid Time Off starting at 13 days annually
  • Fun & Laughter Day Off
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Plan
  • Life insurance & Disability Plan
  • Wellness Program
  • 401K Matching Plan
  • Colleague Assistance Program
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Competitive salary and compensation plan
  • Vehicle reimbursement plan or company vehicle
  • Corporate Social Responsibility Day
  • Cell phone reimbursement (if applicable)
  • Paid parental leave

Requirements

Education: High School/GED or equivalent experience

Minimum Experience: 3-5 years relevant

Preferred Experience: (but not required):

  • Relevant field service
  • Certifications: Product-specific certifications, Industry-specific certifications and/or licenses, Software House, Lenel, Genetec, Avigilon, AMAG, Milestone or ONSSI, AXIS

Convergint is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Visit our Convergint careers site to learn more about the company and the exciting opportunities available.

jobs.description:
Job Posting Title

Production Lift Truck Driver 2nd Shift

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a reliable, safety-conscious Forklift Operator to support our manufacturing operations. The Forklift Operator is responsible for safely transporting materials throughout the facility to ensure uninterrupted production. This position plays a key role in maintaining inventory accuracy, supporting shipping and receiving operations, and meeting customer delivery requirements.

Job Description:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Safely operate forklifts in accordance with OSHA regulations and company policies.
  • Supply production lines with materials according to production schedules.
  • Stage materials for production, shipping, and storage.
  • Verify material quantities, labels, and locations before movement.
  • Utilize RF scanners, barcode systems, or warehouse management systems to complete inventory transactions.
  • Perform pre-shift inspections of forklifts and report equipment issues promptly.
  • Assist with inventory counts, cycle counts, and inventory reconciliation.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas.
  • Follow all safety, quality, environmental, and company policies.
  • Support Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to operate powered industrial equipment for extended periods.
  • Frequently stand, walk, bend, reach, and twist throughout the workday.
  • Lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Must meet vision and physical requirements necessary for safe forklift operation.

Required Skills and Education

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Minimum of one (1) year of forklift operating experience in a manufacturing, warehouse, or distribution environment.
  • Ability to obtain certification upon hire.
  • Basic computer skills and experience using RF scanners or inventory systems preferred.
  • Ability to read shipping documents, work orders, and inventory labels.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to workplace safety.
  • Ability to work overtime and weekends as business needs require.


About Dauch:

Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries - GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.


Dauch will not discriminate against any Associate or applicant for employment because of age, race, color, gender, religion, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic history or information, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, or other characteristic protected by law. For the Disabled Job Seeker: We offer reasonable accommodations for qualified disabled individuals who are applicants for employment. To request assistance or accommodations, please e-mail TalentAcquisition@aam.com. Dauch is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

jobs.title: Overnight Security Guard
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Monitor and patrol hotel property to ensure the safety of guests and employees to protect all hotel assets. Maintain a safe and secure environment by performing protective and enforcement functions in a courteous and restrained manner in coping with emergencies, undesired conduct, disturbances and threats to life and property.

Essential Job Functions

This description is a summary of primary responsibilities and qualifications. The job description is not intended to include all duties or qualifications that may be required now or in the future. The Hotel operates 24 hours a day and 7 days a week, so operational demands require variations in shift days, starting times, and hours worked in a week.

  • Spend majority of shift on foot patrol, walking, climbing stairs of the interior and perimeter of the hotel to observe and identify potential security and safety risks or undesirable conditions.
  • Requires verbal communication using pager and two-way radio, bending, stooping and kneeling as in performing CPR.
  • Maintain order in the hotel, dealing with the welfare of guests, e.g., assisting with door lock problems, coordinate expedient response to emergency conditions such as fire, fire or safety hazards and threats to life and/or property in a calm, rational and persuasive manner. Handle undesired conduct, violations of hotel policy and civil laws as warranted for the security and safety of hotel guests, employees, patrons and property. Requires grasping, lifting and or carrying or otherwise moving persons, packages, luggage, wheelchairs and safety equipment using manual dexterity of hands.
  • Answer security telephone and safety hotline calls and respond in a timely manner based on priority.
  • Use a clear, concise English-speaking voice, listen with empathy, provide accurate information and document legibly all appropriate incident information.
  • Memorize and monitor life safety system installed at property including layout of entire building, alarm pull stations, location of fire extinguisher and sprinklers.
  • Receive, record and store lost and found items. Research and respond to inquirers from guests concerning status of items.
  • Escort guests and employees as required to parking lots, provide same for employees carrying house banks.
  • Adheres to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follows safety and security procedures and rules.
  • Knows department fire prevention and emergency procedures.
  • Utilizes protective equipment.
  • Reports unsafe conditions to management.
  • Reports accidents, injuries, near-misses, property damage or loss to management.
  • Provides for a safe work environment by following all safety and security procedures and rules.
  • All team members must maintain a neat, clean and well-groomed appearance. (Specific standards outlined in team member handbook).
  • Assists other Front Desk Personnel when needed.
  • Perform any related duties as requested by management.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

The Hotel may consider equivalent combination of acceptable education and experience providing the knowledge, skills and abilities cited below, when applicable.

  • Any combination of education and experience equivalent to graduation from high school or any other combination of education, training or experience that provides the required knowledge skills and abilities. High school diploma preferred.
  • Prior law enforcement or other military experience preferred.
  • Thorough knowledge of the layout of the building, function rooms, and some knowledge of the city and surrounding areas.
  • Ability to effectively deal with internal and external customers, some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact and diplomacy to defuse anger and collect accurate information.
  • Ability to listen effectively, speak, read and write English clearly to ascertain and document important information.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, sometimes under pressure, while remaining flexible and efficient while maintaining a pleasant cheerful demeanor.
  • Ability to follow written and or verbal instructions.
  • Ability to operate a computer, printer, copier, and telephone. Physical Demands
  • Ability to stand, walk and/or sit and continuously perform essential job functions for duration of shift.
  • Hearing and visual ability to observe and detect signs of emergency situations.
  • Ability to climb stairs and/or ladders at a rapid pace.
  • Perform tasks requiring bending, stooping, kneeling, and walking significant distances between and within buildings on the property.
  • Lifting up to 25 pounds.
  • Frequent twisting, bending, stooping, reaching, standing, walking, talking, hearing, seeing and smiling.

Benefits

  • 401(k)
  • Room Discounts
  • Employee Food and Beverage Discounts
